ra༅༅/ /goms pa'i phyir/ /phyin chad gtsigs la dbab pa yod/ /khas blangs dam bca' len spyod na/ /bstan pa don gzhan ma lags te/ /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams la/ /rgyu 'bras dag par ma bsams na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzod pas/ /phra zhing phra ba'i rnam smin la/ /bag yod dran pas zin kyang 'tshal/ /'dod yoni skyon du ma bltas shing / /zhen pa nang nas ma log na/ /'khor ba'i btson ra mi sgrol bas/ /thams cad sgru mar shes pa'i blos/ /kun 'byung gnyen po bsten yang 'tshal/ /'gro drug drin can pha ma la/ /byas pa drin du migazo na/ /theg pa dman par gol ba'i skyoni/ /de phyir brtse ba chen po yis/ /byang chub sems la bslab kyang 'tshal/ /legs bshad de tsho smo spyod na/ /theg chen lam gyi rnal 'gror ma/ /'o skol ming sring lta spyod mthun/ /gnas skabs bgrod pa'i lam yang gcig /yon to phrin las mthar phyin pa'i/ /dag

pa mngon dga'i zhing khams der/ /'o skol 'dzom par gdon mi za/ /zhes pa'i don de dag rje btsun gyis mgur du bzhengs nas/ bka' stsal pa bzhin bzang ma rnams dus snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs pa shin tu rags pa yin pas/ cig car du gnyen po skye ba yang shin tu dka' bas/ rang rang so so'i rgyud tshod dang sbyor la ci rigs pa'i dam bca' khas longs shig ces gsungs pas/ bzhin bzang ma rnams kyis gserdzol pa/ rje btsun lags khyed thugs brtse ba chen pos mi bzod pa'i phyir las rgyu 'bras kyi don la ched du bskyar zhing nan tan du gsungs pa ngo mtshar che na yang / nged cag rnams kyis ni sngon dur khrod chen po sing ha la zhes bya ba der ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dang / ta ma la ri khrod ma dang / gtum mo sngo sangs ma la serdzogs pa zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / rnal 'gror ma bhi na badz+ra la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rje btsun ma 'ga' zhig la byang

ra༅༅/ /chub kyi sems kyi phan yon brjod pa dang / las dkar nag gi chos mang du thos pas/ da de tsam du gsung mi 'tshal gyis da lta ltas dang cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa mi sdag pa'i tshul stoni pa ltar 'dug na'ang khyed ri khrod nyul ba'i bsam gtan pa rnams la nyams kyi gdengs ci 'dug blta zhing rtogs pa'i bogs dbyung ba'i phyir dang / bka' bstan pa spyi'i bya ra btang ba'i slad du bstan pa ma lags pa zhe thag pa nas gnod 'gyur gyi las cung zad kyang mi bgyid par 'tshal bas ci nas kyang byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gnang bar zhu 'tshal zhes zhu ba 'bul du byung ba las/ der rje btsun gyis gnang ba mdzad de/ bka' stsal pa bzhin bzang ma rnams khyed 'di tsam du nan tan du bskyar zhing zhu ba 'bul ba la da ci'i phyir mi gnang bas/ ci 'gror pa'i mchod pa dang maṇ+ḍal shoms la phyag dang mchod pa gyis shig /kho bo sems bskyed pa'i yon zang zing gi dngos po gzhan mi

'dod pas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub re re nga la phul la so so rang rang gi ming nas brjod cig gsungs pa las/ khong cag rnams shin tu spro bzhin du bka' bsgo ba ltar bsgrubs te gral du 'khod nas rab tu gus pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te mdongs gsol ba/ lnga'i tshogs kyi dbus na gtso mor 'os pa zhig na re/ bdag ni 'di rnams kyi gtso mo lags te/ bdag gi ming ni bkra shis tshe ring ma zhes bgyi/ srid srung rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub 'bul ba lags serdzo zer skad/ gtso mo'i g.yas 'ordzogs kyi bud med gcig na re/ bdag gi ming ni mthing gi zhal bzang ma zhes balgi snang gsal spra'i dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ de'i g.yas logs na 'khod pa zhig na re/ bdag gi ming ni cod pan mgrin bzang ma zhes bgyi/ bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ gtso mo'i g.yon logs kyi bud med gcig na re/ bdag gi ming ni mi g.yo glang

ra༅༅/ /bzang ma zhes bgyi/ me g.yang zas kyi dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ yang de'i g.yon logs na 'khod pa zhig na re/ bdag gi ming ni gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma zhes brdzi rkang bzhi dud 'gro 'phel ba'i dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ der rje btsun gyis khong cag rnams la rim pa bzhin du skyabs 'gro dang so thar gyi sdom pa/ theg pa chen po'i 〉ni 'jug gi sems bskyed rnams tshul bzhin du phog nas/ sdom pa spyi'i go ba dang bslab bya rnams rgyas par bshad pa las/ 'jig rten mig bsgrar gyi ḍā ki ma de rnams rab tu dga' zhing ngo mtshar bas khong cag rnams na re/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas gsungs pa ltar rngo ma thogs kyang rjes su mthun par slob cing bka' rlas mi 'da' bar bgyid pa dang / /bka' drin nam yang mi brjed par 'tshal 'ordzo zhes byas pa drin du gzo ba'i tshig gi gtang rag btang nas/ rje btsun gyi zhabs spyi bor

blangs/ phyag dang bskerdzor ba lan grangs du mar byas nas nam mthong gi bar du rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phur/ de nas rgyang ring por sesgong ba dang / 'od du yal nas serdzong skad/ yang zla ba de'i phyi mar song ba'i tshe/ tshes bcu gcig gi nub mo sngon chad tho 'tsham du 'ongs pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad dregs pa can gyi sde dpon du gyur pa de rnams so so rang rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i 'khor dpung bu chung gi tshogs dang bcas pa dang / sme sha na 'jig rten mig bsgyar gyi ḍā ki ma rnams speg cing mdzes pa mi mo gzhen nu'i cha byad du bsgyur nas lhab lhub dar gyi gos dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang / dpung pa do shal phreng ba sil sil deng / se mo do la sogs pa'i chas kyis rab tu brgyan te/ bran dang ga〈snag 'khor du ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la lhags nas lha ma srin de rnams kyis bla ma rje btsun la me tog sna sbogs kyi char phab/ spos dang rol mo sna tshogs

ra༅༅/ /kyi mchod pa phul/ bza' ba dang bca' ba gya nom pa sna tshogs kyi spyan gzigs drangs nas/ rje btsun khyed rang gi thugs las byon pa'i rtogs tshad/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa mthar thug lam gyi bskyal sa 'di las med ces pa/ nges don gyi chos shig don 'dir tshogs pa'i lha ma srin rnams la gsung bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ de'i dus su rje btsun gyis rtogs tshad lta ba'i mgur/ gnas lugs nges done 'ba' zhig tu gdams pa 'di rnams yin gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/yongs bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams na/ /yul ya mtshan che ba'i ding ma brin/ /zong 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i tshong 'dus na/ /lha sman btsun mi la dpal mgon pa/ /spa brjid gangs kyi ༄la mo la/ /tshe g.yung drung brtan pa'i zur phud can/ /de mtshan snyan bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /ri na bun 'thibs kyi g.yon zur na/ /'brog sman g.yang gangs kyis bskor

ba de/ /sman lung chu dbar ma lags sam/ /gnas de na rtse gcig nyams len pa/ /nga mi la rnal 'gyor mi zer ram/ /mi nga la sngoni chad tho 'tsham zhing / /co 'dri bzhad gad byed pa de/ /khyed cag 'jig rten lha ma srin/ 8na tu dregs shing mi bsrun pa/ /rnal 'gyor yongs kyi drod nyul ba/ /de ring 'dir tshogs ma lags sam/ /mdang sang dgung zla snga ma la / /yid 'phrog bu mo mdzes ma lnga/ /bla med mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /ci 'dod dngos grub khas blangs nas/ /mi snang mkha' la 'phur nas thal/ /de yang ngo mtshar khyed cag lnga/ /dgung do nub dkar gsal zla mdangs la/ /sprul pa'i bud med bzhin bzang ma/ /gar bsgrur sgeg mo'i cha byad can/ /lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' dang / /do shal rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi/ /gtso mo khyod kyis mdongs gsol nas/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i lha ma srin/ /sde dang dpung dang dmag mi dang / /rigs mthun 'khor gyi tshogs bcas

ra༅༅/ /rnams/ /nam mkha' khengs pa'i mchod sprin dang / /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas dang / /sna tshogs rol mo phul nas kyang / /nges don dgongs pa zhu ba de/ /khyed snang srid lha 'dre ma lags sam/ /tshig de skad zlo na rna bar snyan/ /ngag bden pas bkrol na kun kyang nyan/ /da ca co ma zer glu 'di nyon/ /spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la/ /'dod pa'i byang chub sna tshogs yod/ /ngar 'dzin lta ba tha dad yod/ /de dag spyod tshul sna tshogs yodi/ /gzhi bdag tu lta ba shin tu mang / /khyed blo dman rnams kyi bsam pa dang / /bstun nas kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyis/ /thams cad yodi ces gsungs pa yin/ /don dam bden pa'i dbang du ni/ /bgegs pas sangs rgyas nyid kyang med/ /sgom pa po med bsgom bya med/ /bgrod bya sa dang lam rtags med/ /'bras bu sku dang ye shes med/ /de phyir mya ngan 'das pa med/ /ming dang tshig gis btags pa

tsam/ /khams gsum brtan dang g.yo bar bcas/ /gdod nas ma grub skye ba med/ /gzhi med lhan cig skyes pa med/ /las dang las kyi rnam smin med/ /de phyir 'khor ba'i ming yang med/ /mthar thug done la de ltar gda'/ /e ma sems can med gyur na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ci las byung / /rgyu med 'bras bu mi srid pas/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i dbang du ni/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /thams cad yod ces thub pas gsungs/ /yod pa dngos por snang ba dang / /med pa stong pa'i chos nyid gnyis/ /ngo bo dbyer med ro gcig pas/ /rang rig gzhan rig yode min te/ /thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong sems can ma mthong sangs rgyas mthong / /chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong / /de las snying rje shugs 'byung ste/ /stobes dang mi 'jigs gzungs la sogs/ /sangs rgyas yod tan

ra༅༅/ /gang yin pa/ /nor bu rin chen tshul du stsong / /de rnal 'gror nga yi rtogs tshad yin/ /khyed 'dir tshogs lha 'dre'i rna lam du/ /chos zab mo rbese— kyang bon sgra snyan/ /a bhi ra yi rgyal khams su/ /mkhas pa bas kyang blun po brin/ /dur khrod nyul ba'i wa spyang rnams/ /seng ge'i nga ros 'jigs shing skrag /'ga' zhig skal ldan yod srid na/ /'di don thos pas grol bar 'gyur/ /lar mi nga la dga' ba'i nyams shig skyes/ /bso dga' yo skyid do tho le rgyal/ /zhes pa'i mgur de skad gsungs nas de dag gi r+pā bshad pa/ spyir ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji sted cig gsungs pa de dag thams cad gdul bya gang zag gi blo ngo dang bstun nas theg pa sna tshogs su bstan pa yin rdzi mthar thug bskyal sa gcig las med/ gcig po de gzhi chos nyid ma bcos pa yin/ de yin lugs shes pas migrole te/ lam sbyangs pa

mngon du 'gyur dgos/ de la lam gyi ngo bo stong pa snying rje zung 'drug yin/ lam gyi bgrod tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji snyed cig yod kyang mdor hril gyis dril na thabs shes zung 'jug gam/ bden gnyis dbyer med du 'khyer 'tshal 'ordzo gsungs pas/ lha ma srin de rnams kyi nang nas sngar gyi sems bskyed byas pa'i ḍā ki ma lnga po de dag stan las langs nas g.yon phyogs su 'khod de mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas yod tan mthong tshul gyi bstod pa brjod pa/ dgung mkha' la 'od gsal shar gyi 'og /ri byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyud/ /dog sa rang bzhin gser gyi gdan/ /'brog sman g.yang babs pa'i sman lung na/ /sa byin gyis brlabs pa'i chu dbar du/ /da dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ /dka' ba spyod pa'i ngo mtshar can/ /rtog med bdud rtsi'i zas za zhing / /rang byung dri chu skom du 'thung / /sme gtsang ngo tsha med pa zhig /smyon pa lta bu'i brtul zhugs byed/ /mi khyed la nyams

༄ ༄/ /tshad bya ba'i phyir/ /lo stse ning pung sgra ra ba la/ /lpophyirna galko chu mdor phyin/ /sno seng ldeng tsher ma'i na.a+yo ྾ na/ /bag med stser bu'i cha byad kyis/ /rispyo nganabu mo phongs r+sā chi / d+kul tsār me long lta ba mthong / /bakho pa lus kyi rdzu'as gyi/ /zad par skye mched bstan nas kyang / /lus med stomakharathiyopa mthong / /de mthong ngo mtshar lho sto phyin/ /de rjesaston zla 'bring po la/ /sno mchong lung brag la sgom pa'i tshe/ /mato gzhag bsam gto yi du 'ongs/ / snonyi mazla pha gos r+sā zhing / khago dzime ski phreng bas brgyan/ khus la tha la r+ṣa rak+ta byugs/ /lag snyas gdugs dang rgyal mar+sā thogs/ gcan stan rgyal po zhin nalokyang / /nam mtsho waṃngasasu 'gro ba mtsha / /de sto mi snang yal nas thal/ /de la bar chad skabs marnyed/ /dus na ning stir glar ba la/ /o sa len+t+rasego kyi

dpa' bkong zhing / /ting 'dzin bar chod bya snyam pas/ /khyod rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gos rgyan zhing / /mgo la dug sprul thod du bcings/ /ral gri'i so la rgyab gtad nas/ /mdung rtse'i kha na skyil krung bcas/ /yid bzhin nor bu sgong du rtse/ /ri bo khyur mid za ba mthong / /de la ya mtshan the tshom skyes/ /khyed rig pa sems la dbang bsgyar bas/ /snang zhing mi snang sprul pa'i gzugs/ /sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i phyir/ /brgya byin lta bu'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /blo ya nga med cing bsnyems dang bral/ /som nyi re dz+rīgs spangs pa'i phyir/ /seng ge lta bu'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /mi skrag mi dngangs zhum pa med/ /bar chad rgol bas mi 'jigs phyir/ /glang chen lta bu'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /zhal mthong na dga' zhing ba spu g.yo/ /bltas shing reg pa tsam gyis kyang / /gzhan don bar chad sel ba'i phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /rje nam mkha'

lgeshe/ ོtshamasapas/maskisnguṭ+wāṃ~X tshi sbyi/dab/ṭ+wāṃbhi ༵ḍā yeng rnyir+sha ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃsdostu ༵ /lasna/sna ṭ+wāṃkāpa'i ༈ spragāḍi ṭ+wāṃs/ /bar go bdud kyiskabs ma lī// chad ma das tha 'asacad zhib/de'i/lamalabakod bkrashis dgungazlasnga/ma/la tham sa tom r+ṣa pa'irgyu yi/ga/zhi ri na zlon bstan naswā kyang / /gsung ngakyi bdan skya rjo dzo'e / /thadīgro ba'i dpalam smo rje btsunakhyo/da/ phyima'i dus su shar phyo ko/rdzi/ maphrodaga' zhesabya'i'ajig/rten/der sgyigu bak+ṣiṃ rdzu gh+ranakyi/ /sdu nar lam stas da ba' swān/tsha/ sablasa'og saste ngagi dpa/'bo/ḍakimarnamasadang ko ngam/rigs kyilha rnams kyi sa gdu gas/dang/ brang r+sā dzo sngad pa'/n+d+ra/rtswa kya~Xs su m+mu 'dra // / / 'a / / / / mya ma ral ma' sgra//mchad m+mums

pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /sngon nas bsu zhing shul mtshon te/ /mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs pa'i tshe/ /khyed kyi zhal mthong gsung thos pa/ /snang ba mi dang mi ma yin/ /nged cig gsor du gtogs pa rnams/ /phyi bzhin zhabs 'bring byed par shog /ces khyad par gyi yon tan mthong tshul dang / dag pa stsod lam gyi mjug bsdas pa'i glu de dag rje btsun la phul ba las/ yang rje btsun gyis thugs dgongs btang ba/ 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma 'di rnams mi bsrun zhing shin tu gdul bar dka' bas/ 4da rung dam la gdags shing gcigs la dbab dgos snyam nas/ bka' stsal pa bzhin bzang ma rnams khyed nga la de tsam du dad cing gus pas/ dus phyi ma la smone lam 'debs pa tshun chad kyigadung sems yod pa ngo mtshar che bas/ da ci gong du bstan pa yan chad rigs mchog tu gyur pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bgrod pa bstan pa yin la/ da khyad par du

ra༅༅/ /lam myur zhing thabs mang la dka' ba med par ston pa rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi dam tshig dang lung sbyin par bya yi/ khyed rnams kyi srogagi snying po re re nga la phulalaci 'gror ba'i mchod pa dang / gtor ma shoms shig ces gsungs pa las/ yang khong cig rnams rab tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur te/ mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams/ phyag dang bskor ba lan grangs du mar byas nas/ rang rang gi srog gi snying po re re mdongs gsol du phul te/ rje btsun gyi spyan lam du sngar gyi gral bzhin 'khod pa las/ der rje gas gyis khong cag la jo mo sgrol ma'i rig pa gto pa'i dbang bskur mdzad/ lha mo ku ru kul+le yi dam du phog /snying po bzlas pa'i lung rjes su gnang nas/ yang nan to du gdams te/ bka' stsal pa bzhin bzang ma rnams da phyin chad 'o skol 'dir tshogs pa rnams dam tshig gis bsdus pa'i dpon slob yin pas/ spyodi lam rnam bzhi las

dang bya ba ci byed kyang rtag tu bla ma spyi bor sgoms/ legs nyes gang byung yang skyabs dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs pa'i jo bo gzhan ma tshol/ phyi snod rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang yin la/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lha yin pas/ 'gro ba gang mthong yang mos shing 'dun par byed dgos rdzi gnod cing 'tshe ba dang gshe zhing tshul hrīr+shad par skad cig kyang byed mi rung bas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar gyis shig ces gsungs pa las/ mig bsgyar ma lngas gsol pa / rje btsun lags rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi lugs kyi dus myur du lam bgrode par sla zhing / thabs mang la dka' ba med par 'grub pa/ khyad par gyi dam chig gnang ba bka' drin che ba las nged cag ma dag pa'i 'gre rdzorgyud 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bag chags bostoms pa'i rgyun 'thug pa dang / khyad par du yang bud med skye ba dman zhing blo gros zhan

ra༅༅/ /pas/ rje btsun gyis gsung ba ltar rgyud la ma skyes kyang / bags kyis gzhol zhing bslab par bgyi'o/ /gzhan 'grerdzo rgyud sems can du gyur pa la yi —dam gyi lhar lta ba ma byung yang / gnod cing 'tshe ba las ldog pa dang / yul la nye bar gyur pa rnams la ni phan pa dang bde ba'i dngos po chi rigs pa'i sgo nas stong grogs bgyid cing / khyad par du yang rje btsun khyed kyi bka' 'khor rigs rgyud du gtogs pa thams cad la bsrung zhing bskyab pa dang / yongs su sba bar bgyid de sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen ci dang ci dbordzos pa thams cad kherdzo mo snacag 'bangs rnams kyis bsgrub par bgyi'o zhes khas blangs nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing ba〉snar ba lan mang du byas te bar snang la 'phur nas skusnang skad do/ /rje ras pa chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba dpal bzhad pa rdo rje la/ gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring mas dbu mdzad pa'i 'jig rten mig bsgyar gyi ḍā ki ma lngas theg pa mchog gi

sems bskyed pa'i don dris lan glur blangs pa rnams tshong 'dus ding ma brin gyi g.yon zur/ bkra shis dpal gyi mthon mthing ri'i rtse la skal ldan sbyangs pa can/ ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis sring mo bkra shis tshe ring ma nyid la dngos su nyams bsdur zhing 'dri rmed yang nas yang du byas pa las/ phyis rje btsun nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la lan gsum gcigs nas dgyes bzhin du gnang ba'i gsung don rnams dben gnas nyams dga' zhing grub pa brnyes pa'i sa 'om chung dpal gyi nags 'dabs su/ ngan rdzong stod pa bo dhi rā dza dang / rnal 'gror pa zhi ba 'edi gnyis kyis ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag skal ba dang ldan pa 'ga' dang 'ga'i don du/ gsung sgros la dbri bsnan lhag chad med par nan tan du byas te/ ngag brjod pa tshig gi phreng ba sdebs legs pa'i yi ger bkod pa bdud rtsi 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //na mo gu ru/ rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug lha yi

ra༅༅/ /lhas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa gtsug gi nor/ /sgra sgyar lo ts+tsha chen po yi/ /mdzes pa'i chu skyes ze'u 'gru can/ /phyag mthil mgo la reg mdzad de/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad gdams ngag gis/ /smin cing grol mdzad skal pa can/༄ /sgrub pa mthar phyin ras pa rje/ /dpal ldan bzhad pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /de rjes mdzes mas zhus pa'i len/ /'phrang sgrol gnad kyi bar do la/ /mi 'gyur gsal byed tshig gi gzungs/ /blo dman dran pa gso phyir bkod/ /rje mi las 'das pa'i grub thob chen po thog mar dbang bzhi bskur ba'i dus na dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i nang gi lha tshogs dang / phyi zhing skyong gi ḍā ki ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ rig ma bcu drug mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs par skad cig yud tsam gyis zhal gzigs shing de nyid kyi dus na bla ma dang ḍā gis rjes su gnang ba'i mtshan dpal bzhad pa rdo rje zhes bya gde nyid/ rje

'ordzo ts+tsha chen po'i gsung gis sgrub pa la nan tan du bskul ba'i phyir/ lus dka' thub kyi gdung ba sna tshogs dang bcas pas/ gsang sngags sgrub pa'i yon tan rten 'brel gyi che ba sna tshogs mthar phyung ste/ khams kyi lus 'di nyid la brten nas 'ja' tshon lta bu'i yid kyi sku nges par phyag rgya chen tho mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rje btsun skyes bu chen po de/ yul la ya mtshan che ba ding ma brin gyi shar phyogs/ kha bkra moni gyi mtha'/ sma sgordzod khum bu'i nub phyogs/ sprin sna 'dzings mthing nag 'khrigs pa'i 'og /gza' khyab 'drug nag po rgyu ba'i srang sgo/ gangs khyung mgo bkra shis sprin dkar lding ba'i g.yon mgul/ 'brog sman lung g.yu'i spang po ngos bzang la/ yul sa sman gyi dor pho long ris su btab pa/ bkra shis 'o ma'i chu so dang / bdud rtsi dngos grub kyi chu bo rnam gnyis dal gyis 'bab pa'i klung ngogs/ rang byung byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas/ chu dbar

ra༅༅/ /dpal gyi pho brang na/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa'i ngang las thugs g.yo ba med pare bzhugs pa las/ shing pho rta'i lo stod zla ra ba'i skar ma khrums stod dgung la bab pa'i mar ngor song tsa na tshong 'dus ding ma brin der rims dal chen po babs te/ nad kyi rigs su gyur pa 'grum bu dkar nag dang / rgyu rims khrag 'khru dang / tsha ba mun 'thibs dang / a nya ba li dang / bhi di pa li dang / k+ṣa na ar dza li dang / mun d+ngha dza li zhes bya ba la— sogs pa nad rnam pa sna tshogs pa byung nas mi phyugs mang po gum pa las/ zla ba de'i phyi ma ston zla 'bring por song ba'i tshes bcu gcig gi dgongs mo nyi ma dmar thag chod tsa na / bzang sdug 'od du chags pa'i bud med dar dkar gyi gos zung la mtshal gyi thig phran me lce ho thabs ris su bris pa/ mu ran rin po che sna lnga'i cha ga btab cing / gung khebs

stod la mu tig dar gyi chun 'phyangs ris su spras pa/ gong skor g.yu'i rdo rje mdo long ris 'phar non du btab pa/ gong chen la gser bya mjing bsnol ris su bris pa rgyan pa zhig 'ongs nas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ bskor ba lan bdun byas nas/ phyag dgu phrugs su 'tshal te/ rje btsun lags kho mo cag gi jo mo shin tu bro tsha bar gyur pas gangs pha gi'i mgul du gshegs 'tshal zer nas spyan 'dren du byung skad/ der rje btsun gyis da nyi ma phyi mor song 'dug pas ngas mi phyin/ de bas khyod rang yang do nub 'dir 'dug /sang snga dro rang cig gnyis ka 'grerdzogs la 'deng gsungs pas/ yang resna na re sa man+ta tsa ri rdzu 'phrul 'od kyi lam la gshegs pas tshegs ma mchis/ de ring cis kyang gshegs 'tshal zer skad/ rje btsun gyis de 'dra ba'i lam gang na yodi pa yin nga mi rgan yin pa la sngoni chad de 'dra ba'i lam mthong ma myong / phyogs gang na phar 'gro ba yin khyod kyis lam sna gyis shig

ra༅༅/ /gsungs pas/ mo'i 'dab nas snam bu dkar po zhig bton te bar snang la brkyang nas de'i kha na phar gshegs pas mchi'i zer/ der rje btsun gyi zhabs bzhag pa tsam gyis skad cig ma glog 'khyug pa'i yun tsam las ma 'od par phar phyin nas gda' skad pa la/ gangs rgyal mo mthoni mthing gi g.yoni mgul na dar dkar gyi gur la gser gyi yol ba bris pa/ mu men gyi choni thag brgyangs pa/ dung gi tshugs shing btsugs pa/ byi ru'i choni phur btab pa zhig gi nang na bud med bzang mo ral pa'i zar bus sting pa khad du bslebs pas lus g.yogs pa/ mig rtsa dmar 'jig ge ba zhig sngas nas mgo cung zad bteg ste/ rje btsun lags kho mo shin tu bro tsha bar gyur pas phyag bka' yis gnang 'tshal zer skad/ der rje btsun gyis mo la khyod rkyen ci'i phyir na/ dus nam gyi tshe nas ma bde/ da lta na lugs ji ltar na zhes zhib tu dris pa las/ mo na re kho mo bro tsha bar gyur ba'i

rkyen ni/ yulapa 'di'i phyugs rdzi rnams kyis kha ning dgrar kha dmar thab chen po shor nas/ thab kyi rlangs pa kho mo la phog pas de'i rkyen gyi kho mo bro tshal bar gyur to/ /dus ni khar sang ston zla ra ba'i mar ngo na mar cung zhig ma bde/ de nas ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gcig nas shin tu'ang ma bde bas rje btsun chen po spyan drangs pa lags/ kho mo'i kha rlangs phog pas yul 'dir yang mi nad sna tshogs brdol zhing rims nad kun tu 'khrugs pa de ltar lags so zer skad/ der rje btsun gyi thugs la 'o na kha ning nas kyi dal yams kyi bdag mo de mo yin par 'dug pas/ da su la yang phan gdags su mi rung ba 'dug pas da lta snga gong nas chad mdo byed dgos dgongs te/ slar mo la gsungs pa/ bzhin bzang ma khyod lacas chad ngas byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed/ yi dam lha'i bzlas lung phog /las rgyu 'bras kyi chos de tsam zhig bshad nas khyod dam la mi gnas/ chad la mi btsan pas

ra༅༅/ /ma bde ba bag tsam la bzod pa mi byed par/ ma nyes pa'i 'gro ba 'di tsam la gnod cing 'tshe ba byed pa khyod la dam tshig gi chad pa de tsam zhig 'ong yang thang la snga ma'i tshul la stosnas na khyod la cung zhig yid ma ches pas/ da res kyang yul bde'i dal yams gcod par khas len na ngas cung zhig phan nam blta/ khas mi len na da lta rang nga yang slar ldog la/ dam dred ma khyod la yang dam tshig gi chad pas bsdigs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa las/ mo rab tu skrag cing ha las te rje btsun gyi zhabs la 'jus nas nged sems can ma rig pa'i rang bzhin la 'khrul pa'i nad bag tsam 'byung du rung bas de skad mi gsung bar zhu/ spyir yang 'jig rten gtsang rigs kyi lha 'dre rigs mtho ba phal cher ni tshur la gnod pa ma bgyis na phar la 'tshe ba mi byed cing / sgos kyis kho mos ni bsam bzhin du rje btsun gyi bka' la brnyas pa dang / ched du dmigs te 'gro ba rnams la

gnod pa bgyis pa'am bgyid du stsal ba ma mchis te/ dper bgyis na dgrar zla tha chung la bkodi ma'i chu bo g.yos pas/ ngogs thams cad brlan par 'gyur ba de bzhin du kho mo cag gi rigs sam sde tshan du gtogs pa'i 'khor dang / yang g.yog sha za mo dang srin mor gyur pa sha la dga' zhing khrag la rol pa brgya phrag mang po yod pas de rnams kyis gnod cing 'tshe ba bgyis su bas rdzi de yang kho mo bde bar gyur na rje btsun gyi bka' nyan pas/ 'gro ba de rnams kyi bro nad khyed kyis sel bar bgyid pas/ ci nas kyang kho mo la da res thugs rjes gzigs 'tshal zhes zhu ba nan tan du 'bul du byung ba las/ der rje btsun gyis de ka'i nub mo nas yi ge brgya pa'i khrus chog nas bton/ bla ma dang darkani mchog la gasku(la ba mang du btab gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i 〉sna nas tshe bsring ba mdzad pas/ de'i nang par nas mal nas ldang zhing phyag 'tshal shes pa tsam du gyur to/ /de nas zhag bdun

ra༅༅/ /tsam du rig pa gtad cing byin gyis brlabs pa mdzad pas mo shin tu bde nas/ sngar bas kyang mdangs bzang zhing bkrag phun sum tshogs par gyur to/ /yang rje btsun gyis bka' stsalapa bzhin bzang ma khyod rab tu bde ba 'di rang yin gyis/ nga yul phyogs kyi mi rnams la phan pa byed du 'gro bas/ khyed rnams kyis mthun pa'i rdzas gang yin pa dang / rim gro dzo ltar byed lugs rnams nga la slos shig ces dris pa las/ rje btsun lags rten 'brel gyi che ba yin pa'i phyir kho mo bde ba rang gi mi rnams khad kyis bde bar 'gyur la/ 'on kyang myur du bde bar bzhed na/ nged cag 'jig rten pa'i ḍā ki ma spyi'i dam tshig yin pas gcig ma bde na kun mi bde zhing 'khrug par 'gyur la/ de las srid pa'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis gting g.yo zhing rgyab brten byed pa yin pas rim gro'i lugs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor gyi snying po can gyi gzungs mang du 'don pa

dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde zab mo'i gsung sgrog pa dang / bum pa'i chus bkru zhing grong khyer gyi khor yug tu mtshams bcad pa dang / dkar phud dang dmar phud la sogs pa la tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams la kha zas kyi rnam pa ci yod pas brgyan zhing bsngo ba mdzod dang / mi nad de dag myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro zhes zer ba las/ der rje btsun gyis brin gyi brag mkhar du byon nas yul mi rnams la nga'i rmi lam du byung bas dal yams 'di khyed rang gi jo mo la thab rlangs phog nas mi dgyes pa yod pa 'dra de g.yo 'gul byas nas srid pa'i lha 'dre kun 'khrugs nas yod par 'dug pas da rim gro'i byed lugs 'di ltar du gyis la nga can du yang phud bsdus la skyol zhig gsungs pa las/ yul pas kyang de ltar byas nas phud rnams la tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams te/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsolab btab/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad la gtor ma phul/ de nas srid pa'i

ra༅༅/ /lha 'dre thams cad la bsngo ba mdzad de/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa tsam gyis ring po ma thogs par dal yams chen po de chad par gyur to/ /de nas zla ba de zad pa'i nyi shu dgur song ba'i nyin par bkra shis tshe ring ma dpon g.yog lnga la 'khor sman dang yul lha'i tshogs kyis bsnyor ba mang po zhig rje btsun gyi drung du lhags te/ bza' ba dang bca' ba gya nom zhing ro phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i spyan gzigs mang pos rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa'i skyogs du ma bkang nas rje btsun la drangs te/ phyag dang bskor ba grangs med pa byas nas mdun drang por spyan lam na phar 'khod de 'jig rten mig bsgyur gyi ḍā ki ma spun lnga po de dag na re da res kho mo shi ba slong na ba gsos/ rje btsun khyed las bka' drin che ba med do zhes ngag snyan pa'i tshig glur blangs te phul ba/ ya gi nam mkha'i mthongs shig na/ /sprin sna 'dzings mthing nag 'khrigs pa de/ /rnga sgra klu yi rgyal po

des/ /skye 'gro bcud kyis gso ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sprin char 'beb pa'i rtags/ /char zam zim dal gyis 'bab pa de/ /sa gzhi drod gsher snyoms pa'i rtags/ /'brug sgra chem chem sgrog pa de/ /'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa'i skad/ /sprin de yis mtshon pa'i 'og rol na/ /gangs zur gsum dgung du rtse mtho ba/ /mgur chu shel gyi cod pan la/ /gza' skar 'od kyi phra bkod de/ /nyi zla shar gyi gzi mdangs can/ /de sman btsun nged kyi pho brang yin/ /gangs de la 'khris kyi g.yon mgul na/ /lding mdo shod shel gyi do ra la / /'ja' 'od kyi gur yol bres pa de/ /'brog ya mtshan che ba'i sman lung yin/ /'bru drug rtsi thog 'khrung pa'i sa/ /me tog tshon tshogs bkra ba'i gling / /sman gyi do ra gzigs mo snache/ /yul lha'i rtse bro dang re spretshe/ /khyad par sa gzhi byin chags pa/ /chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang na/ /mi ya mtshan can zhig bzhugs pa de/ /rje mi la rnal 'gyor ma lags

ra༅༅/ /sam/ /khyed sku tshe snga mar tshogs bsags pas/ /da lta mi lus rin chen thob/ /cung zad le lo mi mdzad de/ /'bral med bsam gtan bsgom pa'i phyir/ /skye med sems kyi don rtogs nas/ /'khrul 'khor lus la rang dbang thob/ /bar chad g.yeng bas mi 'jigs pas/ /ri bo lta bu'i rnal 'gror pa/ /rlung gi yon tan mthar phyin pas/ /gcer bu'i lus la gzi mdangs can/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa snatshogs kyis/ /'gro jon rdzogs mdzad skyes bu khyod/ /deng sang dus kyisnyigs ma la/ /gdong dmar yul du byon pa de/ /spyir rgyal khams yongs kyi rgyan du che/ /sgos bud med nged kyi dpal du shar/ /dus da res dgung tshes bcu gcig la/ /mi gtsang thab kyis nyer bslangs nas/ /'byung bzhi nad kyis thibs nyon byung / /nyon mongs gdug rtsub khong nas 'grugs/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su myong / /nang 'gyu ba rten dang de'u bral byung / /

de 'dra'i nyam thag gyur ba'i tshe/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /byin rlabs 'pho ba'i rjes gnang mdzad/ /dag pa sngags kyi khrus nas bton/ /skye 'chi med pa'i sems ngo sprad/ /nges shes rtogs pa 'phral du skyes/ /nad 'du ba rnam bzhi sprin ltar dengs/ /lus shing bal lta bur yang zhing bde/ /sems la rtogs pa sna tshogs shar/ /tshe dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad bzlog /drod mtha' nas yal ba rang sor chud/ /dbugs phyi nang chad pa slar yang mthud/ /gzhin rje'i pho nya skyengs su bcug /rje bka' drin che'o rnal 'gror pa / /'bangs skye gnas dman pa'i sgrib g.yogs kyis/ /snying brjed dran pa ngan na yang / /dus da res tshe srog mthud pa de/ /tshe 'di la brjed thabs yod ma mchis/ /sku skyabs drin lan bsab pa'i phyir/ /ci dgyes dngos grub 'bul ba dang / /ci gsung bka' las mi 'da' bas/ /dus 'di nas bzung ste mthar thug gi/ /bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /

ra༅༅/ /smon lam dag pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ /lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du/ /skad cig mi 'bral 'grogs gyur nas/ /khyod mngon par sangs rgyas gyur pa'i tshe/ /gzugs skus 'dul ba'i zhing khams der/ /lnga sde bzang po ji bzhin du/ /'khor gyi dang por gyur nas kyang / /thog ma'i bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /de 'thungs bdud rtsi'i yon tan gyis/ /chos kyi rgyal srid thob nas kyang / /mi shes rmongs pa'i 'gro rnams la/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sprin tshogs las/ /sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i char phab nas/ /'gro kun rab tu tshim gyur 3rdzog /ces pa sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring mas dbu mdzad kyi mig bsgrur ma lngas rje btsun chen po'i snyan du de skad gsol te/ dag pa smon lam du btab pa las/ yang rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la/ gnod sbyin mo 'di kun gyi da res kyi na ba gsos pa la 'di tsam gyi drin du gzo ba byed lugs kyis/ da gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs kyi

gdams ngag sna 'ga' tsam bstan na ba〉snam par nus sam/ dgongs nas bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma rnams khyed da res kyi na ba gserdzos pa 'di tsam la de skad zer na/ gsang sngags mngone sum gyi lam pa yin pas/ dus da res la tshang tshing srid pa'i gnas nas thoni zhing skye 'chi 'khor ba'i lam 'phrang brgal nas phyin chad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gtan nas mi myong ba'i gdams ngag yod na de khyod kyis bsgom par nus sam zhes brod pa bskyed pa'i mgur 'di skad du bzhengs pa/ shar khri gdugs nyi ma'i 'og shed na/ /sman lha ri bkra shis rtse mtho ba/ /khyung mgo shel gyi zur phud la/ /dmar thag gser gyi 'od 'phro zhing / /stod sprin dkar lding gi go lcog la/ /smad 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i cha ga btab/ /bar g.ya' spang g.yu yi smin khyugs la/ /na bun skyi bun 'thibs pa de/ /gangs mthon mthing rgyal mo ma lags sam/ /gangs de la pho brang rten bcas pa/ /bud med lus la ya mtshan

ra༅༅/ོ ri 'i/casna/ /mo baspyo rgyal mo bzhispya bzang mo/ /yi/ 'phrog snan pa'i glu len zhing /'a/ṭār+shasdug ༷ du kho~X pa de/ /smanabakra shikyi tsha ring ma~X gas sam/ /khyad da ras 'jags nga skrag rdzu myazlo / /yurdzu khadu nas ༷༵༵ba rin 3 bdan/ /lus la'abyung bkroḍi nad kyas gzar/'i/rims swā sdug bsngal skyad byābs do/ /ltags na bun lta bur swālal khaḍi/ /srag lortagasaya dī r+shaX ༵da /n+d+ra/ sngan chaḍi lakyi ngan zigs pa' nywa/ /da lta n+d+ram spyan da ltar myang / /da ngan spyad 'ad las snalakri n+d+ra / /na ragā dgrasab sa lasar+sāgaswā/༷/saXsas ma tha 'i/sna/rikau/da dad paspya sa ban g.yas pa la'i/ /ma ngas kyang snyang rjas ñcā nasabaslang /tsha/gsang sngags zlodan pa' byan rlabs kyas//'cha bdag bdud kyamagagabaskar/khis kya na rja' kha nas 'phrags/ /ltas ngan sdag pa g.yang du bslan//rkyan ngan bar chad ru bsgyar/ /da dga'

ru tshor ram bzhin bzang ma/ /lar byas pa shes pa dka' na yang / /rje bka' drin shin tu che'o zhes/ /ngag snyan pa'i tshig gis gtang rag btang / /glu de la nga yang brod pa skyes/ /da phyin chad nga zer nyan spyod na/ /thar med sdug bsngal chen po'i lam/ /rba rlabs can gyi chu bzhi dang / /bgrod dka' mi khom brgyad kyi gnas/ /tshang tshing srid pa'i nags tshal dang / /bdud bzhi'i jag pas 'ig pa'i sa/ /'jur med bar do gsum gyi 'phrang / /ya nga med par bsgral nas kyang / /rtag tu bde thob yangs pa'i lam/ /zhi ba rin chen gling de ru/ /phyin par khas len gdon mi za/ /mi nga zer ya mtshan mi che na/ /nga yi brgyud pa ngo mtshar che/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen nas/ /sgra sgrur lo ts+tsha yan chad du/ /bder gshegs sprul pa ma lags pa/ /gang zag brgyud pas bar ma chod/ /de phyir nga zer gtsigs su che/ /yul rgya gar dbus na sgra che ba/ /dpale nā ro mai tri bsnyad kyin

ra༅༅/ /gda'/ /khong snyan pas phyogs rnams khyab pa'i phyir/ /mtshan sngon chad khyed kyis thos te mchi/ /rje grub thob gnyis kyis byin rlabs pa/ /de lho brag —mar pa lo ts+tsha yin/ /pha sprul sku de yi zhabs drung du/ /lo drug zla mthong brgyad du bsdad/ /lus sku dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /rje gsungs pa'i bka' la tshad mar bzung / /thugs gting nas mnyes pa'i gnad ka des/ /rgyud zab mo dgyes pa'i rdo rje dang / /byin rlabs can gyi bde mchog dang / /snying po ma hā mā ya'i rgyud/ /dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i gsang 'dus dang / /bka' srung can gyi gdan bzhi dang / /sprul pa sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud/ /don mthar thug ston pa snying po'i skor/ /bka' rgya mtsho ltar zab rgyud 'grel las/ /bcud nor bu rin chen gting nas blangs/ /gnad zab dgu'i don snying phyung ba rnams/ /gser zhun ma lta bur dril nas kyang / /dbri bsnan lhag chad yodi re zhes/ /ḍā ki

dpang btsugs dbu bsnyung bzhes/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang / /pha bka' drin che bas sems la 'phreng / /drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /〉snam yun du bsring ba'i gnad ka des/ /rlung 'byung ba lnga la rang dbang thob/ /ro snyoms kyi spyod pa gdeng du gyur/ /nad 'du ba 'khrugs kyang nyam nga med/ /bu khyed kyang bde bar bzhed pa na / /mi nga zer nyon la nga phyir 'brongs/ /nga spyod ltos la nga bzhin sgoms/ /dus 'di la lam sna zin te mchi/ /tshe phyi ma phan chad rtag tu bde/ /da lta lus la nad mang zhing / /sems kyi tsha grang myong ba yang / /nyon mongs rgyu yi nyer len dang / /glo bur rkyen gyis mtshams sbyar nas/ /sngar byas las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /rang snang sgrib pa de ltar byung / /'di yang rmi lam skad cig tsam/ /de bas 'bum 'gyur bye ba yis/ /yun ring shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /na rag dpyal ba'i sdug bsngal yang / /don du snang ba skusnad ma yin/ /

ra༅༅/ /sdig sems bag chags 'khrul pa las/ /phyi rol sdug bsngal myong zhes pa/ /stoni pa sangs rgyas shāka thub la/ /rdo rje snying pos zhus pa'i lan/ /nges pa don gyi mdo nas gsungs/ /de phyir kun brtags 'khrul pa'i gzhi/ /thams cad sems su ma shes na/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dbang bsgyar yang / /de la bde ba yod ma yin/ /mnyam gzhag bzhi yi bsam gto la/ /bskal par gnas kyang dman pa'i lam/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi srid/ /de bas las dadza nyine mongs rdzi /sgrib g.yogs bag chags sbyang ba'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyun sgom zhing / /mthar phyin skye med r+pā la blta/ /'o skol da lta las kyi sa pa yin/ /le lo snyom las dor byas la/ /ga' 'grus chen po'i go bgos shing / /skad cig yud tsam ma yengs par/ /don myur du sgrubs shig skal bzang ma/ /srin mo sman btsun bzhin bzang ma/ /zhes tho zhib tu bshad pa'i

ra༅༅/ /sdig sems bag chags 'khrul pa las/ /phyi rol sdug bsngal myong zhes pa/ /stoni pa sangs rgyas shāka thub la/ /rdo rje snying pos zhus pa'i lan/ /nges pa don gyi mdo nas gsungs/ /de phyir kun brtags 'khrul pa'i gzhi/ /thams cad sems su ma shes na/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dbang bsgyar yang / /de la bde ba yod ma yin/ /mnyam gzhag bzhi yi bsam gto la/ /bskal par gnas kyang dman pa'i lam/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi srid/ /de bas las dadza nyine mongs rdzi /sgrib g.yogs bag chags sbyang ba'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyun sgom zhing / /mthar phyin skye med r+pā la blta/ /'o skol da lta las kyi sa pa yin/ /le lo snyom las dor byas la/ /ga' 'grus chen po'i go bgos shing / /skad cig yud tsam ma yengs par/ /don myur du sgrubs shig skal bzang ma/ /srin mo sman btsun bzhin bzang ma/ /zhes tho zhib tu bshad pa'i

glu de rnams trere bar gyis la khyad par du bstan pa myur du sgrubs shig ces gdams pa/ khyed kyi yid la 'bras bu sku bzhi zhes bya ba zhig 'ordzogs nas btsal du skurdzod snyam na yang / sangs rgyas zhes bya ba rgyud tha dad pa zhig gzhan nas btsal du med de/ 'o skol skye 'gro sems can du gyur pa la 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ bar do dag pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ skye ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ sku gsum ro gcig tha mi dad pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku de bzhi rang cag la rang chas su yod de ngo ma shes/ de ngo shes par byed pa la grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag zab mo bar ma chad pa dgos pa yin gsungs pas/ yang khong cag na re rje btsun lags/ kho mo cag gi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du byon pa'i dus su kha la rong sgor sngone bsu nas tho mtshams la phyin pas slar phyag rgya gnyan po'i zil 'og tu mnan te bka' 'bangs bgyid par gcigs la phab/ rang sngags srog gi snying po

ra༅༅/ /mdongs gsol du phul/ de'i dus na yang mdo sde rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang du thos/ yang rgya gar gyi dur khrod mun pa sgra sgrog zhes bya bar slob dpon phyogs kyi go cha dang / brtul zhugs spyod pa nag po zhabs las dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba thob cing / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos mang du thob/ de'i phyir na yang bka' gsang ba bstan pa'i snod du rung / khyad par da res kyi bro nad chen po 'dis kho mo 'jigs shing skrag pa nyams su myong ba'i phyir/ sems can dpyal ba'i sdug bsngal skad cig la yang bzod par mi nus te/ de bas na gong du gsungs pa'i ya nga ba de dag las skyob cing dag pa sku bzhi mngon 'gyur du ngo sprod par byed pa'i gdams pa de ring nyid du thugs la gdags 'tshal zhes zhu don glur phul ba/ dpal nam mkha' 'od kyi zhing khams na/ /sprin a ba gser mdog lding ba de/ /klu rgyal rigs gtsug na rin chen gli /ya mtshan rdzu

'phrul bkod pa yin/ /sprin de yi 'og na 'phyo lding ba/ /bar snang lha phran mi'am ci/ /lha min dri za'i bu mo rnams/ /sna tshogs 'dod yon longs spyod cing / /glu gar rtse 'jo shin tu dga'/ /sprin a ba ldings kyi 'og rol na/ /sman dog sa bkra shis ding ma zlodi/ /de phu ni lha gnyan gangs kyis bskor/ /mda' ni gtsang chab lum gnyan/ /bar g.yu yi spang po lding ma la/ /sman yul lha'i rtsed bro ltad mor che/ /lar sman lung shel gyi do ra de/ /'og klu yi bang mdzod yin pa'i phyir/ /rtsi bcud longs spyod 'byung ba'i sa/ /rkang bzhi dud 'gro 'phel ba yin/ /'brog de na dben gnas nyams dga' ba/ /chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang yode/ /gnas de na skyes mchogo ya mtshan can/ /mdzes pa'i sku lus rin po che/ /mthong dang thos pa tsam gyis kyang / /'grokun sgrib pa sbyong mdzad cing / /phyag rgya sku yi bkod pa yis/ /sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul stoni mdzad de/ /kun mkhyen sems nyid don rtogs

ra༅༅/ /pas/ /chos nyid mkha' la dbang bsgrur zhing / /rnam dag byams pa'i gsung gis ni/ /chos nyid stong pa'i sgra sgrog pas/ /nged snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /dad pa'i sa bon gsos btab nas/ /bka' bzhine nyan zhing gus par bgyid/ /ci bsam 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu rin chen rgyal ba'i sras/ /khyod la brten nas mchis gyur pas/ /'jig rten mig sgrur ḍā ki ma/ /bud med gzugs can kho mo cag /sngon chad 'khor ba thog med kyi/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i rang rgyud dang / /srid pa'i nying mtshams sbyor ba la/ /dang po mi skye'i ṣ+pebs kyang med/ /da cung zhig sdod do snyam pa la/ /'chi bdag gzhin rje skad pa de/ /thibs non gyi mun pa gtsug na 'khyil/ /'chor med kyi zhags pa lag na thogs/ /dus nam zhig tshe la rang dbang med/ /'byung bzhi lus kyi mdangs 'phrog cing / /nang sregag gi dbang po 'gag par byed/ /de nas bar

do'i snang ba 'char/ /snang mun 'od kyi lam 'phrang der/ /brtse med gshed po nyi bzhin 'brang / /nyam thag mnar ba'i sdug bsngal myong / /de rjes ming bzhi 'khyams po de/ /las ngan rlung dang bag chags kyis/ /cha med yul du rgyus med khrid/ /rang dbang med par skye gnas tshol/ /gsor ba zo chu'i khyud mo ru/ /skye rga na 'chi srid pa'i mtsho/ /g.yo 'khrug rba rlabs bskyod pa la/ /sngon chad bying ba skyabs med na/ /da res sde dpon khyed kyi mthus/ /byang chub sems kyi gzings bcas nas/ /'jigs shing lta ba'i rlung log dang / /'dod yon g.yo ba srin mo'i gling / /las kyi chu srin 'tshe ba las/ /mi 'jigs bde bas bskyabs nas kyang / /pha mthar son pa nor bu'i gling / /sna tshogs rin chen sa gzhi la / /lam ring dub pa'i tshong pa rnams/ /ngal sos dal bar gnyid log cing / /ci bsam dgos 'dod len par zhu/ /'khor ba'i ri sul nyam nga bar/ /'jigs bcas mi khom

ra༅༅/ /brgyad kyi nags/ /sgrib g.yogs mun pa char gnag cing / /nyon mongs gcan zan ma rungs pa/ /mthong bas 'jigs skrog mche ba bdar/ /skyon gyi zug rngu tsher ma can/ /sdug bsngal brgyad kyi tsher khrod du/ /lam stor smag tu 'thom pa rnams/ /khyed gsung dri ma dang bral ba/ /cha yis yongs rdzogs ston ka yi/ /zla ba ltar dkar sprin med cing / /'od 'phro snang bar gyur pa des/ /ma rig mun nag bsal nas kyang / /rnam dag yangs pa'i lam stod zhu/ /lam 'jigs pa can gyi bar do ru/ /'phrang 'jur med gsum la bskungs bton nas/ /nged sngon chad bdud kyi jag pas khyer/ /las kyi lcags sgrog dam pos bcings/ /thar med khron pa'i dong du bskyar/ /dus da res skyabs gnas bla ma rje/ /rgol ba sus kyang mi spobs pa'i/ /dpung gnyen khyed kyi mthu stobs kyis/ /'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang bsgral ba'i phyir/ /'chi ba〉 de gsal chos kyi

sku/ /chos sku ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag zhu/ /bar do dag pa'i sgru lus la/ /longs sku ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag zhu/ /skye gnas gang skye'i rang dbang yod/ /sprul sku ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag zhu/ /'phrang de gsum bsgral ba'i pha rol na/ /ber chad bdud las grole ba'i sa/ /mi 'jigs snyems dang bral ba'i lam/ /phyir mi 〈snag pa gtan gyi yul/ /dga' bde yangs pa'i zhing khams shig /yod do skad par kho mos thos/ /sngoni chad ma phyin mthong ma myong / /'gro mgoni bla ma thugs rje can/ /skyob pas lam gyi shul mtshon te/ /ma mthong yul de stoni par zhu/ /lar ya nga'i gnas su nyam thag cing / /mgoni med smre sngags 'don pa rnams/ /dus gzhan ma yin 'di nyid la/ /'bras bu sku bzhi mngon gyur zhu/ /zhes gsol ba btab ste dngul dkar gyi me long la gser gyi pad+ma rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra bkod pa zhig maṇ+ḍal du 'bul du byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis gsungs

ra༅༅/ /pa / bzhin bzang ma khyod nga la de tsam du mos gus che zhing chos 'di la nan tan du zhu na/ nga rang gi lugs su byin rlabs byed dgos pas tshogs kyi yo byad shoms shig gsungs pas/ khong cag gis de'i nub mo rang la zas sna drug cu tshogs pa'i yo byad bshams te/ tshom bu'i maṇ+ḍal la brten nas khong cag lnga la rje btsun rnal 'gyor snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i lugasatsasu dbang bskur zhing byin rlabs mdzad de/ de'i dus su bar do gnad kyi 'phrang sgrol ska gsum ngo sprod kyi gdams pas dag pa bde chen gyi zhing du bgrod lugs 'di rnams mgur du bzhengs pa/ 'dzam gling snying po rgya gar yul/ /gtsug lag khang chen bi kra ma/ /rig pa'i 'byung gnas de nyid rdzi /byang sgo bsrung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta / /mi yi seng ge 'gran zla med/ /rgelo ba ngan pa'i klad 'gems phyir/ /gyad stobs po che yi dpa' dang mtshungs/ /bka' rgyud sde bzhi la ma rmongs shing / /mchog thun mong

dngos grub brnyes pa de/ /rje nā ro paṇa chen ma lags sam/ /de nyid sras kyitsho mchog gyur pa/ /pha dka' ba spyad pa'i thugs rus can/ /lho brag mar pa lo ts+tsha zhes/ /mtshan yongs su grags so 'brug sgra ltar/ /rje bka' drin can gyi zhal snga nas/ snguka thub bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ /mi rnams tshe thung longs spyod dbul/ /bdud rigs bar chod mang ba'i phyir/ /dus yun ring sdod pa'i long med cing / khes bya'i mtha' la chod dus med/ /rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya mi 'tshal bas/ /bu sgrub pa snying por longs shig gsung / /mi ngas kyang le lo ma bgyis te/ /rjes gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin rjes su mnyan/ /gnas ri khrod bas mtha' bstegs nas kyang / /lus dka' thub spyad de bsgoms pa las/ snyams cung zad rgyud la skyes pa yodi/ /sems lhan ne gtod cig skal bzang ma/ /spyir 'o skol 'gro drug sems can la/ /gzhi bar do'i chos drug shes kyang 'tshal/ /lam srid pa gsum gyi

ra༅༅/ /'byung 'jug gis/ /gnas khams gsum 'khor bar yang yang 'khyams/ /'phrang 'jur med gsum gyi so mtshams su/ khul ring mgron po mi gsum la/ /mdza' bshes gnyen gyi bya ra bas/ /dga' brod gdong nas bsu ba yode/ /sun ma de dang ma mjal na/ /dgra sdang gshed ma'i phyag brnyan pas/ /bya spyode blta nyul 'ong ste mchi/ /dpung ded dpon gsum dang ma 'grogs na/ /rgyus med 'jigs bcas tshong pa rnams/ /ma mthong 'jigs pa'i skungs sa nas/ /lung ston bdud kyi pho nya gsum/ /thar med jag pa lam na bsgug /'dra min sprul pa'i gzugs 'dzin zhing / /bslu ba'i tshig gis yid bsgrur te/ /lam gole log par khrid nas kyang / /bdun phrag bdun pa yan chad du/ /snang min srid pa'i bar do ru/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal nyams su myong / /de nas las kyi rjes 'branges te/ /slar yang 'khor ba'i btson rar 'jug /da btson

ra de las thar 'dod na/ /da res 'khor 'das bar do ru/ /gnas lugs ngo sprod phyag rgya che/ /gzhi lta ba gtan la 'bebs kyang 'tshal/ /snang ba skye shi'i bar do ru/ /rig pa sems kyi rtsalasbyang phyir/ /lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la 'bad kyang 'tshal/ /rang bzhin lam gyi bar do ru/ /gnyug ma ye shes ngos gzung phyir/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag bsgom yang 'tshal/ /rmi lam gnyid kyi bar do ru/ /bag chags lam du balhar ba'i phyir/ /'od gsal sgru lus sbyang yang 'tshal/ /tha ma srid pa'i bar do ru/ /sku gsum mngoni du gyur nas kyang / /zhing khams gsum du bgrod kyang 'tshal/ /gal te mngon du ma gyur na/ /skye gnas4 brgyud pa'i bar do ru/ /spyod lam dag pa'i mtshams sbyar nas/ /rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i rten 'brel gyis/ /dal 'gror 'dzom pa'i lus thob cing / /snga ma'i las 'phro sad nas kyang / /lam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyung ste/ /ring por mi thogs de nyid

ra༅༅/ /du/ /grol bar 'gyur par the tshom med/ /khyed ya mtshan che ba'i bud med lnga/ /rtse gcig gus pas bka' nyan zhing / /don ched du bskyar te zhu ba la / /mikho bos bar do'i gdams ngag bshad/ /rje lho brag mar pa'i thugs phyung yang / /gnad de las zab pa yod re skan/ /zhes mgur du bzhengs pa las/ yang bzhin bzang ma de dag langs nas phyag dang bskor ba lan bdun bdun byas te/ rin po che'i phra bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rje btsun gyi sku gsung thugs che ba'i yon tan la bstod cing lus sgoms par 'jug pa dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes bde stong gi mchod pa 'bul ba dang / bar do ngo sprod kyi chos de dag tshig zhib rgyas su bsnyad cing / don mdor bsdus pa nyams su blang bde ba zhig gnang 'tshal zhes zhu don glur phul ba 'di rnams yin no/ /rje 'gro ba skyob mdzad bka' drin can/ /lcags la gser 'gyur btab pa bzhin/ /snyan brgyud dag pa'i

bdud rtsi yis/ /sdug bsngal bde bar basmyar mdzad pa'i/ /pha sangs rgyas khyod la phyag 'tshal gyis/ /thugs brtse bas mi 'bral rtag tu skyong / /rgyud sbyangs pa can gyi snang ba la / /zhing yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyingase/ /bde chen spros bral gyi pho brang de/ /rje bla ma'i gdan sa ma lags sam/ /ḍā ki sprin tshogs 'dus pa'i dbus/ /gdan rig stong dbyer med seng ge'i khri/ /srid pa'i skyon spangs pad+ma dang / /sna tshogs rtog pa'i sprin bral ba/ /'od gsal nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la/ /pha bla ma rje btsun bzhugs pa de/ /sku blta bas mi ngoms gzi mdangs can/ /zhal lhang nge lhan ne+e shin tu mdzes/ /yoni tan tshogs kyis rab brgyan cing / /dpe byad mtshan gyis spras pa'i phyir/ /rgyal sras gzheni nu nyid dang mtshungs/ /sku mthong na dga' ba'i rje la bstod/ /gsung sgra dgrangs snyan pa dri za'i glu/ /sgra rang snang stong pa chos kyi sgra/ /bde chen seng ge'i sgra sgrog pas/ /bdud dang mu

ra༅༅/ /stegs skrag mdzad cing / /skal ldan gdung ba sel mdzad pa/ /gsung de la phyogs bcur snyan pas bstod/ /thugs mi phyed snying po rdo rje ltar/ khes bya'i mthar thug kun la mkhas/ /lta ba kun spangs nam mkha' las/ /byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ /gdul bya'i mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /thugs 'gyur ba med pa'i rje la bstod/ /rje sangs rgyas ngo bo sku gsung thugs/ /sna tshogs dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu khyod/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo spyi gtsug gi/ /cod pan gdan la bzhugs nas kyang / /bsam pa dag pas byi dor byas/ /g.yel ba med par nyin mtshan du/ /phyag bya mchod cing gsol btab na/ /ci 'dod re ba skong mdzad cing / /'dod pa'i don rnams sgrub mdzad pa/ /dbang gi rgyal po lta bu yi/ /rje rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i sprin tshogs las/ /byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsi yi/ /'char

'bab 'o ma'i rgyun de la/ /skal ldan 'ga' zhig 'thung byed pa/ /skye gnas 'di nyid kho na la/ /nyone mongs tha ba btul nas kyang / /rtogs pa'i myu gu 'khrungs 'gyur zhing / /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /sku dang ye shes phrin las rdzi /lo 'bras me tog phun sum tshogs/ /'gro kun rab tu tshim byed pa/ /ring por mi thogs bskrun par shog /de ma thob kyi bar du yang / /pho nyas bgrode pa lam gyi rten/ /zag bcas lus kyi bde ba las/ /zag med ting 'dzin cher bskyed nas/ /dga' ba rnam bzhi'i ye shes kyis/ /bde stong ting 'dzin la gnas shing / /dbu ma'i don la 'jug pa'i phyir/ /yongs su sbyangs pa'i shes rab ma/ /kho mos bgyid par 'tshal lags pas/ /dgyes bzhin khyod kyis gnang bar mdzod/ /de rjes slad nas zhu ba'i don/ /chos 'di bar do 'phrang sgrol la/ /phyogs bstan tshig gis brda ma mjal/ /dmar khrid zhib tu bsnyad pa dang / /sku bzhi ngo sprod don gyi

ra༅༅/ /gnad/ /mngon 'gyur dus dang sa mtshams zhi /mdor bsdus 'di las med ces pa/ /zhal khrid nyams len bsdu bar zhu/ /gzhan yang khyod kyi byasargya yis kyang / /chab 'og 'bangs su gyur pa la/ /sna tshogs gdams pa'i bcud bstan pas/ /rgyud dang dbang po tshim gyur nas/ /sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyung ste/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba kho na la/ /rtags dang yon tan sna tshogs pa/ /rje btsun khyed dang mnyam par shog /ces mjug dge ba'i smoni lam dang bcas pa'i glu de rnams rje btsun gyi snyan du phul ba las/ yang rje btsun gyis bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma rnams gzhi gsum du mi khom pa brgyad kyi 'du byed kyis thang chad cing lam srid pa gsum nas yun ring bshad pas/ lus ngal dub tu gyur pa shul rings kyi mgrone po gsum yode de/ gdams ngag kyang yod la nyams su yang blangs pa'i gang zag dang / gdams ngag yode la nyams su ma

blangs pa'i gang zag dang / gdams ngag kyang med la nyams su yang ma blangs pa'i gang zag go/ /snga ma de ni srid pa'i lam dang / 'jigs pa'i 'phrang dang / bdud kyi skungs la sogs pa'i ya nga ba gang yang med de/ bsgoms pa'i gnad kyis grol ba'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma ni skye 'o tha mal pa dang mtshungs te/ ya nga ba dang bcas pa'i 'phrang de rnams su zhugs nas rang bzhin gyi bdud kyis khrid de/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i nas su skye 'chi bar ma chad par zo chu'i khyud mo lta bur longs spyod pa'o/ /bar ma de la sngar bstan pa'i ya nga ba dang / bcas pa'i lam 'phrang gi dogs pa de dag bsal zhing bar chad bdud kyi phyag brnyan rtags pa'i gdams ngag yode de khyodi la mi 'gyur ba'i dad pa dang / zab mo la mos pa'i shes rab dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha yod na khams dang dbang po'i dus tshod dang sbyar la khad kyis bsnyad par bya/ da res sku gsum mngon 'gyur gyi so mtshams

ra༅༅/ /lag len du bstan na lam 'chi ba'i srid pa la 'gyu ba gnad gcod kyi 'phrang phyi nang 'byung ba'i skye mched rim gyis thim pa'i rjes la/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag las rnam par grole ba nam mkha' sprin med pa la nyi zla shar ba lta bu chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs ma bcos pa ji lta ba dus der 'char bas de ka 'chi ba 'od gsalachos kyi sku yin te/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta bla ma dam pas ngo sprad pa'i gnas lugs lta ba'i don go ba dang / mtshon byed lam gyi 'od gsal sbyang 'tshal/ lam srid pa bar ma do la sngone 'byung yid kyi gzugs can las kyi gshed mas 'tshe ba'i 'phrang / snang mun 'ode kyi bar do ru/ dbang po kun tshang thogs pa med cing las kyi rdzu 'phrul 'od dang ldan pa'i lus shig yod pa/ de ka bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ zung 'jug lha'i snang ba

skyam lta bur bzhengs nas bag chags snga ma'i lhag lus skyong ba yin pas de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shelopar byed pa lad lta bskyed pa'i rim pa lha'i sku ladamigs sku gsal ba dang / mtshoni byed lam gyi skya ma rmi lam sbyang 'tshal/ lam srid pa tha ma rig pa las kyi rlung gis rang dbang med par bskyod pa'i 'phrang dri za mngal gyi skye gnas 'tshol ba'i dus der pho mo sbyor ba byed pa la chagame sdang skye bas sngar gyi gdams ngag dran pa'i gnad kyis rang nyid bde stong gi nyams dang mi 'bral bar gnyen po'i rtsal mthar phyin pas las kyi snang ba mi 'char zhing / dus phyin chad bsams nas skye ba len pa de ka skye ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku yin te/ yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta grol lam gtum mo drod kyi ye shes skyes pa dang / chags lam las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gsum pa rdzogs pa'i don nyams su myong bas phrag dog mig ser sbyang

skyam lta bur bzhengs nas bag chags snga ma'i lhag lus skyong ba yin pas de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shelopar byed pa lad lta bskyed pa'i rim pa lha'i sku ladamigs sku gsal ba dang / mtshoni byed lam gyi skya ma rmi lam sbyang 'tshal/ lam srid pa tha ma rig pa las kyi rlung gis rang dbang med par bskyod pa'i 'phrang dri za mngal gyi skye gnas 'tshol ba'i dus der pho mo sbyor ba byed pa la chagame sdang skye bas sngar gyi gdams ngag dran pa'i gnad kyis rang nyid bde stong gi nyams dang mi 'bral bar gnyen po'i rtsal mthar phyin pas las kyi snang ba mi 'char zhing / dus phyin chad bsams nas skye ba len pa de ka skye ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku yin te/ yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta grol lam gtum mo drod kyi ye shes skyes pa dang / chags lam las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gsum pa rdzogs pa'i don nyams su myong bas phrag dog mig ser sbyang

ra༅༅/ /'tshal/ mdor hril gyis dril ba la 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du 'gyur lugs kyi dus dang sa mtshams de ltar shes par bgyid 'tshal/ rje lho brag mar pa'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba snyan brgyud don gyi ngo sprod thabs lam gnad kyi mthar thug kyang de las med do/ /rnal 'gror pa nga'i dgongs pa'i bzhed lugs blo yid ches kyi gdengs 'phral nyams su blang rgyu 'di las med pas/ bzhin bzang ma khyed kyis kyang de ltar shes par gyis la nyams su longs shig gsungs pa las/ mig bsgrur ma de lnga'i nang nas gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma thabs lam zab mo don gyi ngo sprod la shin tu mos shing dad par gyur pa des kyang zhabs spyi bor blangs nas rje btsun lags dus 'edi nas bzung ste skye gnas thams cad kho mo rtsi bzhin du 'brang zhing las kyi phyag rgya bgyid par 'tshal bas/ bar do ngo sprod kyi gnad de rnams kyi nyams dang rtogs pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du thugs la gdags

'tshal zhes zhu ba nan tan du gsol nas/ phyag dang bskor ba lan grangs du mar byas te/ slar khong rang gi gnas su song skad do/ /rje ras pa chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i dpal bzhad pa rdo rje dang / 'jig rten mig bsgrur gyi ḍā ki ma lnga yis 'phrang sgrol gnad kyi bar do la dris pa lan dang bcas pa'i brda don glur blangs pa mgur chu gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sa map+ta// //rje nor bu rirno chen bka' drin can/ /dngos grub brnyes pa'i ras pa dang / /'jig rten mig bsgrur gdol pa mo/ /sme sha las kyi ḍā ki lngas/ /dris pa lan dang bcas pa'i done/ /yid 'phrog snyan ngag glur blangs pa/ /me tog phreng ba brgyus pa'i tshig /thod rgal nyams kyi dgongs done 'di/ /yi ger bkod par mi rigs kyang / /bdag nyid brjed pas 'jigs pa dang / /ma 'ongs gdung brgyud 'dzin pa rnams/ /mos shing spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin yi ger bris/ /lan gsum

sa༅༅/ /bar du zhu phul nas/ /dgyes bzhin gnang ba ma lags pa/ /mkha' 'gro ko long dam pa'i phyir/ /gzu lum ras gcod ngas ma byas/ /slad nas 'byone pa'i sgom chen la/ /dmar khrid nyams tshad ma byas par/ /dpe 'byud yi ge ma bstan gsungs/ /bla ma rje yis bka' rgyas btab/ /gal te bapokha las 'das gyur na/ /ḍā ki'i bka' chad 'byung ba'i phyir/ /ye ger mi spel sba bar zhu/ /thub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus/ /cho 'phrul chung ngu'i mar ngo la/ /spu sdug ri dwags rgyu ba'i tshal/ /'om chung dpal gyi nags 'dabs su/ /dam tshig can gyi rdo rje spun/ /phu bo gcen po'i zhal ngo ru/ /gu ru bo dhi rā dza dang / /bdag ming wo kyi mtha' can gyis/ /gsung gleng dri zhib nan tan gyis/ /dri rmed zhus dag bgyis nas kyang / /chos 'di bar do 'phrang sgrol la/ /mgur chu gser gyi phreng ba zhes/ /r+pā ldan phyir na mtshan du gsol/ /'di bris bsod

nams gang thob pas/ /'gro kun bar dor grol gyur cig /rje mnyam pa med pa'i rnal 'gror pa chen po ras kyi na bza' can dang / mtshan ldan gyi phyag rgya ma bkra shis tshe ring ma spun lnga'i zhus lan du gnang ba/ 'phrang sgrol gnad kyi bar do las slad nas ras pa rnam gnyis kyis bka' bgro bar mdzad de mtshan zhabs tog tu phul ba rdzogs so// lto/ //na mo gu ru/ me mo bya'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nam sred yolab na/ gnas dben pa chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang du 'od chen po zhig lhag gis byung skad/ de nas mi'i sna sgra sha ra ra byung bas su yodi snyam pa la/ dri zhim po sngone chad med pa zhig sna bug tu byung tsa na bkra shis tshe ring ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas/ 'khor gcig gis dri zhim sna tshogs bsregs pa'i spos thogs/ gcig gis bza' btung gya nom pa mang po thogs/ gcig gis sgra'i rigs mang po thogs/ gcig gis na bza' bzang po thogs/ gcig gis me tog sna tshogs

ra༅༅/ /thogs te khong lngas phyag dang bskor ba mang po byas nas 'dod yon sna tshogs pa sprul nas mchod de/ lnga po mgrin gtsig tu bsdebs nas glu 'di skad ces zhus so/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /dal 'gror lus la skal ba can/ /lha dang bla mas mtshan gsol ba/ /bzhad pa rdo rje mi zer ram/ /yab dang yum gyis mtshan gsol pa/ /mi la thos dga' mi zer ram/ /rgyal khams yongs kyi mtshan gsol pa/ /grub thob ras pa mi zer ram/ /mtshan gsum ngo mtshar ldan pa de/ /lha sman rgyal mo'i g.yon 'gram na/ /chu bo lo ta han gyi 'gram zhig na/ /klu yi rgyal po dung sgra yis/ /pho brang 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ya mtshan sman lung chu dbar na/ /sgrab pa snying por lhur len cing / /'jig rten chos brgyad yal bar dor/ /srid pa'i dgon pa'i nang nas phyung / /ngo mtshar che'o rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag cag rnam pa lnga po 'di/ /rdzu 'gyel lus kyis

'dir lhags te/ /snyan pa'i tshig dang 'jam pa'i ngag /ci bder rol ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /pad can dung can ri mo can/ /glang po can dang rnam pa bzhi/ /bdag cag rnams la ldan mi ldan/ /las rgya zhus na bkas gnang ngam/ /dbab dang dkyil dang bzlog pa dang / /'grem pa'i sbyor ba mkhyen lags sam/ /de ltar mkhyen na mgyogs byed mchog /pho nya'i lam pa yin par nges/ /bka' rgyud sde bla na med pa nas/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin gli /bu mo dgag ces gsungs pas na/ /bsnyen bkur rnams kyi nang nas kyang / /phyag rgya ya mtshan che'o gsungs/ /de phyir bdag cag 'dir mchis so/ /da mkhyen par mdzod cig rnal 'gror pa/ /gcer bu'i lus la gzi mdangs can/ /zhes de skad du glus bskul ba dang / rje btsun gyis lan gsungs pa/ do nub nam gyi cha stod la/ /lhang lhang glu yi brda sbyor ba/ /gangs khyung mgo shel gyi zur phud can/ /lho sprin smug po'i bla bre la/ /

ra༅༅/ /rgyu skar mang po'i me tog can/ /sman btsun khyed kyi pho brang yin/ /tshe ring dbang che bskal bar gnas/ /de srog gcod spangs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /longs spyod rnam thos bu dang mnyam/ /de ser sna spangs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /'khor bzang bka' bsgo nyan pa de/ /bzod la nan to bya ba byas/ /de nas dge la spro ba de/ /brtson 'grus le lo med pa yin/ /da lta nga dang phrad pa de/ /smon lam bzang po btab pa yin/ /de yan chad rten 'brel zab mo'i glu/ /da don la sbyar te mchid 'di 'tshal/ /nga nā ro paṇa chen brgyud pa 'di/ /lam rtsa dang rlung la rang dbang thob/ /mchode pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang / /mtshan ldan phyag rgya 'bul ba 'di/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i 'bul ba yin/ /de phyag rgya bzhi la mtshan nyid 'tshal/ /pad can mdangs ldan bde ba rgyas/ /dung can nyams dga' bde ba myur/ /ri mo gting zab zag pa med/ /glang pos dngos po'i gnas lugs

ra༅༅/ /rgyu skar mang po'i me tog can/ /sman btsun khyed kyi pho brang yin/ /tshe ring dbang che bskal bar gnas/ /de srog gcod spangs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /longs spyod rnam thos bu dang mnyam/ /de ser sna spangs pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /'khor bzang bka' bsgo nyan pa de/ /bzod la nan to bya ba byas/ /de nas dge la spro ba de/ /brtson 'grus le lo med pa yin/ /da lta nga dang phrad pa de/ /smon lam bzang po btab pa yin/ /de yan chad rten 'brel zab mo'i glu/ /da don la sbyar te mchid 'di 'tshal/ /nga nā ro paṇa chen brgyud pa 'di/ /lam rtsa dang rlung la rang dbang thob/ /mchode pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang / /mtshan ldan phyag rgya 'bul ba 'di/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i 'bul ba yin/ /de phyag rgya bzhi la mtshan nyid 'tshal/ /pad can mdangs ldan bde ba rgyas/ /dung can nyams dga' bde ba myur/ /ri mo gting zab zag pa med/ /glang pos dngos po'i gnas lugs

rtogs/ /nyes pa'i skyoni dang bral ba de/ /sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma/ khes rab gsang ba'i pad+ma la/ /e dbyibs waṃ gyis mtshan pa yod/ /thabs kyi nor bu hūṃ sngone po/ /phaṭa kyis gnyis ka'i thig le bsdom/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyar bas/ /zung 'jug bde ba'i mchod pa yin/ /dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig bzhi/ /sku bzhi ngo bo nyid kyi ngang / /'bebs pa rus sbal 'grerdzos kyis 'bebs/ /bskyil ba a ba dh+ra tīr bskyil/ /bzlog pa dud 'gro'i 'gyur bzhis bzlog /'grems pa rnam grerdzol phyag rgyas 'grems/ /thig ni mya ngan 'das pa'i lam/ /le ni ro mnyam bde ba yin/ /las ni rnam pa sna tshogs byed/ /kyi ni bde stong mtshams sbyor zhing / /phyag ni de dang de ru mjal/ /rgya ni 'khor 'das gnyis la 'debs/ /las ni gang dang gang la byed/ /de yi phrogs ni kyi yis byed/ /phyag ni bde stong dbyer med las/ /mi 'da'i phyir na rgya yin no/ /snyoms 'jug

ra༅༅/ /mgyogs byed pho nya'i lam/ /zag med bde bas gang ba'i lam/ /gsal stong dngos grub 'byung ba'i lam/ /mi rtog spros bralachos sku'i lam/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku lam/ /gsal stong sna tshogs sprul sku'i lam/ /bde gsal mi rtog zung 'jug lam/ /mgyogs byed pho nya de la bya/ /de phyir chags lam sbyor ba yis/ /khyed kyang nges par thar pa thob/ /nga yang skye med btsan sa zin/ /skal bar ldan no mtshan ldan ma/ /zhes pa'i mgur de skad bzhes nas/ de phyin chad las kyi phyag rgya mdzad/ /bza' btung gya nom pa'i sbyin bdag mo byas/ sgo gsum gyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang zhing mnyes par mdzad do/ /spyir bkra shis tshe ring ma dang / la phyi gangs kyi 'brog sman zul le ma dang / ling pa brag gi sman mo dang / bal po lam pa'i mtsho sman ma dang / yol mo gangs ra'i gzhi bdag mo dang lnga pos rje btsun gyi las kyi phyag rgya las khyad

par du 'phags pa bkra shis tshe ring ma'o/ /mi ma yin bu mo phyag rgyar 'gugs nus pa'i skyes bu nus pa can dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / ljongs kyi bdag mo bkra shis tshe ring ma gnyis kyi zhus lan mgur du bzhes pa bde stosnang ye shes sprin gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ ras pa mched gnyis kyis maṇ+ḍal phul nas zhus pas dgyes bzhin gnang ba sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ tshe ring ma'i chos skor rnams la'ang 'chad pa po dpal bzhad pa rdo rje'i bka'i rgya/ zhu ba po mkha' 'gro mched lnga'i gsang ba'i rgya/ sdud pa po a tsar+ya bo dhi rā dza dang / ras pa zhi ba 'od gastim kyi dam tshig gi rgya ste/ rgya rim pa gsum gyis bto pa'i chos ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rdzogs so// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid brin sding ma'i pha bong reg pa dug can gyi steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bu slobo dang nya ma 'ga' la khrid btab nas sgom du bcug pas/ spyir gyis kun la nyams bzang po skyes/ khyad par rus stag

ra༅༅/ /yin pa'i gawo pa dad gzhi can zhig 'dug pa de la/ rtogs pa ngo 'phrod nas rje btsun la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste/ khrid r+sā pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs gral du kho na re/ rje btsun lags/ bdag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang thar pa'i phan yon la bsams na/ don med sos dal du skad cig kyang sdode pa phangs par gda' bas/ rje btsun gyi phyag phyir 'brangs nas nyin mtshan du g.yel med bsgoms pas khrid par zhu/ bla ma brgyud pa dang rje btsun gyi sku'i yod tan la stos na 'jig rten pa'i dge legs rnams rdzun dang dgos med du gda' bas 'di don gyi chos shig kyang gsung du gsol zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so/ /nga yi brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen yin/ /yang mes tai lo sher bzang yin/ /mes po nā ro paṇa chen yin/ /pha rgan mar pa lo ts+tsha yin/ /nga rang mi la ras pa yin/ /gdams ngag zab mo'i rgyun chags yin/ /de ni yin pa rnam

drug lags/ /da ni mi la'i rdzun drug 'chad/ chu shing 'dzom pa'i dgoni pa na/ /nye gnas zer yang rdzun du gda'/ /za grogs 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung / /gtapa ngan mang po rna ba tsha/ /lus la gtum mo 'bar tsa na/ /snam phrug zer ba rdzun du gda'/ /khres po 'dis kyang dgordzos rgyu chung / 8ga sre'i gnas tshang nga mi 'dod/ /ting 'dzin zas su zos tsa na / kho chang zer ba rdzun du gda'/ /ngan skyags rgyu de dgos pa chung / /g.yos ba〉snal byed snying nga mi 'dod/ /zhen pa nang zha sa log tsa na/ /nor rdzas zer ba rdzun du gda'/ /gsog 'jog 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung / /khe tshong brel bas rna ba sun/ /snying rus sgom sran bskyed tsa na/ /bu slob zer ba rdzun du gda'/ /mjal phrad mang po dgos pa chung / /cis kyang dge sbyor chag pa yin/ /snyan brgyud gdams ngag bsgoms tsa na/ /chos bshad mang po rdzun du gda'/ /slob gnyer 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung / /cis kyang nga rgyal skye ba

ra༅༅/ /yin/ /rdzun drug mnatsangagardo rje'i glu/ khes par gyis la go ba long / /zhes gsungs pas/ yang khos zhus pa/ ngo mtshar che lags/ bdarge sogs ma rig pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du da dung rje btsun rang gi sku che ba'i yoni to rnams drug tshan du bsdebs nas chos gsung du gsol zhes zhus pas/ yang mgur 'di gsungs so/ /mitsang la che ba yodatshom myong / /brgyud pa'i che ba bsgo phyir du/ /da res mi la'i che drug bshad/ /mi la'i che drug bshad tsa na/ /bla ma gakho mchog bka' drin che/ /yi dam lha tshogs byin rlabs che/ /chosatsaskyong srung ma mthu rtsal che/ /snyan brgyud gdams ngag zab khyad che/ /mi la ras pa sgom sran che/ /grwa pa bu slob dad pa che/ /da ni mi la'i bde drug bshad/ /mitshomed lung stong snang ba bde/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag sems la bde/ /sra ba'i 'bol chung 'og na bde/ /brag phug stong pa steng na bde/ /'grangs

stogs snyoms pa'i sgyu lus bde/ /'khrul 'khor lus kyi bca' thabs bde/ /da ni mi la'i 'du drug bshad/ /nyin par mi rnams tshogs su 'du/ /mtshan mo mkha' 'gro tshogs su 'du/ /byang sems 'khor lo'i srog la 'du/ /rang sems gnyis med yul du 'du/ /nang nub zas gos tshogs su 'du/ /da ni mi la'i rdzong drug bshad/ /rag ma byang chub sgrub pa'i rdzong / /brag dmar mchong lung khyung gi rdzong / /brag dmar spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong / /mon yul stag phug seng ge rdzong / /ka t+ya'i shel phug chu shing rdzong / /brag dkar rta so dgra ma rdzong / /da ni mi la'i bzang drug bshad/ /phyag rgya chen po lta ba bzang / /nā ro chos drug bsgom pa bzang / /thabs lam zab mo spyod pa bzang / /sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu bzang / /bka' brgyud bla ma byin rlabs bzang / /mi la ras pa gdams ngag bzang / /khyodi 'dir bzhugs bu slobo yoni bdag rnams/ /phan pa'i chose la byed mkhan med/ /

ra༅༅/ /gnod pa'i sdig la hab sha byed/ /sdug bsngal sdig pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /bde ba dge ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /rang sdug rang gis masgortoms par/ /rang gis rang skyid bsgrub rogs mdzod/ /zhal yang yang mjal ba'i smone lam 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pas/ /nya ma bu slob rnams dga' mgu yi rangs te rang rang gi gnas su song / gawo pa de phyag phyir 'brangs pas nye ba'i sras stag sgom ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug ces bya ba byung ngo / /ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug gi skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje 'thi mi la ras pa de nyid ras chung pa la sogs pa'i bu slob rnams dang bcas te/ gnya' nang krod phug na snying po don gyi chos 'khor bskor zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ la stod na gu ru tshems chen/ ding ri na dam pa sangs rgyas/ bal po na shi la bha ro/ rgya gar na d+nghame bo dhi/ gnya' nang na mi la ras pa ste/ grub thob lnga dus mtshungs pa las/ shi la bha ros/ dharma bo

dhi spyan drangs nas bal po rdzong na chos 'khor bskor zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bal bod kyi mi mang po dhame bo dhi'i zhal lta ru 'gro zhing 'dug pa las/ rje btsun gyis bu slob rnams kyang mjal bar 'dod nas/ ras churngari pas rje btsun la d+ngharma bo dhi dang mjal na legs pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi lan du mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /rje bla ma'i byin rlabs grub thob mang / /ngo mtshar sangs rgyas bstan pa dar/ /bde skyid 'gro ba'i dpal du shar/ /rje grub thob mjal mi mang ba de/ /skal ldan 'ga' re yod pa'i rtags/ /ding ri'i dam pa sangs rgyas dang / /la stosnad gu ru tshems chen dang / /bal po shi la bha ro dang / /rgya gar d+ngharma bo dhi dang / /gung thang mi la ras pa rnams/ /sems rnam rig tsam re kun la yod/ /sgom rang mgo thon pa su la'ang yod/ /sems rang gsal sems ngo sus kyang shes/ /sprul bsgyar rdzu 'phrul kun gyis nus/ /stong nyid snying rje kun gyis

ra༅༅/ /'grongs/ /'phral ngo mtshar ltad mo khong tshos ston/ /nyams byung rgyal 'i la nga rang mkhas/ /snying rus zhen log nga rang che/ /gzhan rnams khyad par ma mchis pas/ /nga ni mjal du mi 'gro bas/ /bu khyed rnams mjal du cis kyang song / /gzhan skyor+sha yod pa ma yin te/ /nga na so rgas pas mi thon 'dug /dpal u rgyan yul du mjal bar smon/ /the tshom ma byed blo gdengs yod/ /ces gsungs pas skyon med na ka mi rnams kyis mi la ras pa chags sdang gis mi 'byon par 'dug zer skur pa zhu bar 'dug pas cis kyang byon pa 'thad lags zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyes ltung dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi kha byur gyi kha lab la/ /the tshom za na rang nyid 'khrul/ /sgom sgrub snying nas byed dus su/ /'gro 'dug mang ba bar chad yin/ /bla ma rje la mjal dus su/ /bcos ma mang na lha

grogs 'khrug /gsang sngags zab mo'i thabs lam la/ /yid gnyis byas na 'grub mi nus/ /grub thob byin rlabs che lags te/ /'khor dpung mang ba tshig pa za/ /bu ras chung grogs mched cis kyang song / /zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ mi mang pos sdig gsog par 'dug pas cis kyang 'byon par zhu/ nged rnams la yang phan par 'dug zhus pas/ 'o na d+nghame bo dhi la phyag lan du 'gro gsungs pas/ ras chung pa sogs grwa pa rnams mgu nas/ rje btsun 'byon na rgya gar ba gser la rtsi ba yin pas gser zhig bsgrubs nas byon pa drag zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprang 'dod pa zad par byin gyis rlobs/ /byas tshad chos su 'gyur bar shog /byas tshad chos su ma gyur na/ /byang sems bsgom pa'i don go chung / /sgom ting 'dzin skyes pa grogs mi 'dod/ /sgom rang grol shar ba grogs 'dod na/ /rgyun du

ra༅༅/ /bsgoms pa don go chung / /mi la ras pa nor mi bsgrab/ /mi la ras pa nor bsgrabs na/ /bya ba btang ba don go chung / /d+ngharma bo dhi gser mi 'dod/ /d+ngharma bo dhi gser 'dod na/ /grub pa thob pa don go chung / /ras chung rdor grags khe mi 'dod/ /rdo rje grags pa khe 'dod na/ /bla ma bsten pa don go chung / /zhes gsungs nas khyed rang rnams sngone la song zhig ngas phyi nas 'ong gis gsung / bu slobe rnams sngon la brdzangs pas rje btsun 'byon nam mi 'byon nam bsams pa'i the tshom log ge ba'i ngang la bal po rdzong du sleb tu cha ba la/ rje btsun gyi sku shel gyi mchod rten du sprul nas/ skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du thogs brdugs med par nam mkha' la byone nas/ bu slob rnams kyi nang du byon pa dharma bo dhis mthong bas ngo mtshar bar gyur cing / bu slob rnams the tshom za ba rje btsun nam mkha' nas byon pas dga' mgu yi rang bar gyur te/ dpon

slob rnams 'grig pa d+ngharma bo dhi'i drung du mi mang dus phebs pa la/ rgya gar gyi d+nghame bo dhi khri las babs te/ bod kyi mi la ras pa la phyag phul bas/ mi kun dharma bo dhi bas kyang mi la ras pa bzang bar yid ches shing / gnyis ka la tshogs pa kun gyis sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang mi 'bral bar gyur to/ /de nas grub thob gnyis khri gcig la bzhugs nas phan tshun mnyes pa'i gsung gleng mdzad pa na/ d+nghame bo dhis rje btsun la khyed gcig pur bzhugs pa rang la thugs dgyes par yode 'dug pa ngo mtshar che gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyis de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma spyal pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' brgyud grub thob rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya gar d+nghame bo dhis gtso mdzad pa'i/ /'dir tshogs skal ldan bal bod khrom pa la/ /bod kyi rnal 'gyor mi la ras pa ngas/ /nyams myong ye shes glu ru len/ /nyams myong glu ru mi len du/ /grub thob sprul sku'i ngo ma chog /

ra༅༅/ /rtsa yon po lnga po rlung gis bsrang / /rlung log pa lnga po mal du bsrang / /khams snyigs ma lnga po me la bsregs/ /sems nyon mongs dug lnga'i sdong po sgyel/ /dgra las rlung rnam rtog dbu mar bsrang / /dgra gnod byed thul ba'i dpa' bo la/ /grogs ngan pa'i 'khri shal bya rgyu med/ /ces gsungs pas d+ngharma bo dhi na re dgra thul lugs legs byung /sne de dang thun pa'i gnyen bzang po ci 'dra yod gsung pa'i lan du yang mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje grub4 thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /grogs nang nas 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa dwangs ma lnga yi a ma de/ /rlung dwangs ma lnga yi pha dang phrad/ /khams dwangs ma lnga yi sras bu 'khrungs/ /sems dwangs ma lnga yi rang zhal mthong / /'di rgyal sa zin pa'i kha bo ste/ /pho brang dbu ma'i gzhal yas khang / /'ja' sa 'khor 'ordzo bzhi la sgrog /sgya 'phrul dra ba'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /ched 'dzin med pa'i

khrims kyis bsdams/ /gang shar rig pa'i rten 'brel las/ /rang zhal ngo 'phrod kyi gnyen dang mjal/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /bdag gi de nyid ma khyab med/ /de rnal 'gyor nga yi nye du yin/ /gnyen bzang byang chub sems nyid la/ /dus nam yang 'du 'bral med pas bde/ /zhes gsungs pas d+ngharma bo dhi mnyes nas/ spyir rnal 'gyor pa'i nyams la bshad kyis mi lang ste/ lta sgom spyod pa'i 'gag cig gsung bar zhu dang zer ba'i lan du rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so/ /yengs med sems la blta nus na/ /kha lta skam po lab don med/ /rang rig nyams dang 'dres pa na/ /blun sgom ro nyal byed don med/ /rten 'brel 'char tshul shes pa na/ /chos brgyad spyod pa rang zhig yin/ /sems la nongs 'khris med pa na/ /tshul 'chos ngo bsrung zog dang bral/ /gsor 'das sku dang ye shes te/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na/ /zhe 'dod rtsol bas

ra༅༅/ /grub pa min/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rnal 'gyor pa'i lta sgom spyod pa ngo mtshar che gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyis d+nghame bo dhi la khyed kyi nyams len gyi gnad zab mo rnams kyang gsung bar zhu gsungs pas/ d+ngharma bo dhis mgur 'di gsungs so/ /nga lta ba bzang po'i sgrab brgyud la/ /'dir tshogs skal ldan gsol ba 'debs/ /las kyis 'brelab bzang po yis/ /myur du mjalobar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam rtog bag chags ma zhig pa'i/ /sems labaltas pas ci la phan/ /bdag 'dzin skyid 'dod ma spangs pa'i/ /yun du bsgoms pas ci la phan/ /'gro ba'i don la mi brtson pa'i/ /nga rgyal spyod pas ci la phan/ /bla ma'i gsung la mi nyan pa'i/ /dga' 'dus gsor gyis ci la phan/ /ngo lkog g.yo smyu khrel gyi gzhi/ /'bras bu gzhan done ma byas na/ /bla med byang chub 'grub mi 'gyur/ /lar yin lugs bshad pas gnong la phog /'khrug pa

byas na phung gzhi che/ /kha rog bsdad pa gdams ngag zab/ /khyed bod kyi rnal 'gror glu dgrangs snyan/ /nga glu dgrangs snyan pa mi 'dug ste/ /spro ba skyes nas blangs pa yin/ /dpal bde ba rgyas pa'i zhing khams su/ /dbyangs len par spro bas myur du mjal/ /zhes gsungs shing gzhan yang mnyes pa'i gsung gleng mang po mdzad de/ rgya gar gyi d+nghame bo dhi phar byon/ bod kyi mi la ras pa dpon slob rnams yar byon pa las/ gnya' nang gi nya ma rnams kyis rje btsun dpon slob la/ byon skyems zhus zhal mjal tshul rnams dris pas de'i lan du rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so/ /dgung nyi zla mjal bas gling bzhi gsal/ /ma bu phrad pas gdung ba zhi/ /drod gsher mjal bas rtsi thog smin/ /grub thob mjal bas rgyal khams bde/ /bal po rdzong gi nags gseb tu/ /d+ngharma bo dhi phyag phebs pas/ /mi la ras pas mjal du phyin/ /khong dharma bo dhi sku bzhengs nas/ /mi la nga la

ras༅// 'i/phyagabyas+t+rapaspra/ /khrom paX mi ṭ+wāṃms the lti zoswā/ /khong sgyu ༷ lus kyi phyapyo rgya shaṃs/ /༷ wīg thal sbyur pus mo baX/sa/bre/bsnya dri rmekyi ྾ kyi dgangs su ༷ga/ /ldun na phyakri rgya ༷sa pa bangh+rub/ /gnyam rid dag sdi' dgan pa ru/ /ḍid gsal brjad mdu gsung phyong byas/ /sman lam bzang pa' 'al pa zhagh+ra /sngan rgyas ba' dus na yad drir ngas/ri/ngad grags ༷༷da mjal phrad lakriX sa da/'i/rgyal khams yangasatram̐ grags pa yan/ /zhug gsungaX ༵sa/nya ma rnamasdu dāgani mgu ya rangs nardzu nga mtshar rdar gyudā cang / rja byādz+nyān swā d+ngharma ba d+nghas phyag byas pa' stabatra/ kyas snyana'i pa dazlo sku5 swād kyang rgyas dror gyus // /d+nghame ba d+ngha dang mjal ba'askarar// //na swā sna ru/ rja btsun ma la ras pa da nyad kyas rang snang dbang du 'dus pas gzhan snang zal gyas nan ta/rgya gar gya d+nghame ba d+nghas phyag phul bas snyan grags rgyas nas/ gnya' nang ga

dge gsoni dge'i 'bul nod kun rje btsun la phul bas/ sku bsod kyang rgyas pa'i ngang la sems can gyi don dang thugs dam 'phel bar gnya' nang dzadi phug na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mtshan nyid kyi gra sa zhig yod pa de'i ston pa rnams rje btsun la phrag dog gi sgo nas mu stegs chos log mkhan yin zer skur zhus drag po byed pa byung ngo / /dus nam zhig gi tshe gnya' nang du mu ge cung zad cig byung ba las/ yul mi rnams kyis ston pa la bun thong byas pas stoni pa rnams na re/ nged rnams kyi chos log mi shes pas shi dge gson dge'i 'bul nod 'ong rgyu ni med/ nged rang rnams kyi nor skal rnams ni khyed tsho la go mi chod pa'i chos rnam dag slob gnyer gyi ༄gas la zad/ khyed rnams labun dgos na khyed rang rnams la yodi dus kyi 'bul sa chos log mkhan de la zhus zer/ bun gtong du ma nyan pas yul mi 'ga' zhig na re/ de phyogs gcig nas bden pa tsam yode/ 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas rje

ra༅༅/ /btsun la zhu mod/ tshe 'dir dgos pa 'dug pas 'bul nod stoni pa rnams la'ang byed zer/ yul dgoni rnams 'cham byas so/ /de'i tshe stod pa rnams kyidrag pa loston dge 'dun 'bum dang / ra ston dar ma blo gros zhes bya ba la sogs te ston pa rnams kyi gros la/ mi la ras pa 'di ma phud na yul 'dir 'o skol gyi bstan pa dang / gang zag la phrin las mi 'ong bar 'dug pas mi la'i chos 'di chos log yin rung min rung phud pa legs par 'dug /de la drag pos phud na rang re rnams ngo tsha zhing yul pa rnams lab tu 'gro bas/ khyed stoni pa sgra tshad lung rigs la mkhas pa gsum skurdzong la/ chos gtam gyis dang / kho la kha nas dbyung rgyu lce las med pas lan mi 'ong gis/ brgya la tshul mthun re tsam byung rung / kha rub dang 'bur 'joms kyis sun dbyung cerdzog cig /sdug thug nas rang phud la 'gro ba yin gyis zer bzhin btang bas stod pa gsum ras chung

ra༅༅/ /btsun la zhu mod/ tshe 'dir dgos pa 'dug pas 'bul nod stoni pa rnams la'ang byed zer/ yul dgoni rnams 'cham byas so/ /de'i tshe stod pa rnams kyidrag pa loston dge 'dun 'bum dang / ra ston dar ma blo gros zhes bya ba la sogs te ston pa rnams kyi gros la/ mi la ras pa 'di ma phud na yul 'dir 'o skol gyi bstan pa dang / gang zag la phrin las mi 'ong bar 'dug pas mi la'i chos 'di chos log yin rung min rung phud pa legs par 'dug /de la drag pos phud na rang re rnams ngo tsha zhing yul pa rnams lab tu 'gro bas/ khyed stoni pa sgra tshad lung rigs la mkhas pa gsum skurdzong la/ chos gtam gyis dang / kho la kha nas dbyung rgyu lce las med pas lan mi 'ong gis/ brgya la tshul mthun re tsam byung rung / kha rub dang 'bur 'joms kyis sun dbyung cerdzog cig /sdug thug nas rang phud la 'gro ba yin gyis zer bzhin btang bas stod pa gsum ras chung

pa brgyud nas/ rje btsun dang mjal ba yin zer byung bas ras chung pa 'thad rgyu med pa tsam zhig la/ rje btsun la stod pa gsum mjal ba yin zer 'dug pas gtong ngam mi gtong zhus pas/ nga la lho brag mar pa'i zhal nas khyodi kyi sems can la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas phan gang thogs gyis/ tha na 'brel gtam dang gleng mo sogs kyis kyang sems can la phan 'dogs gyis gsungs pa yod pas/ nang du thongs shig gsungs pa ltar nang du bos/ tsha ba drangs chab btang ste rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'o dad pa can gyi rdzas 'di sa la phog na sa 'gas/ rdo la phog na rdo 'gas/ chu la phog na chu 'chad bya ba yin pas/ khyed stoni pa rnams kyis kyang mdo bsngo ba re gsung bar zhu gsungs pas/ stod pa gral mgo ma de langs nas se gol gtogs cing / 'o lags so nged ston pa bslab gsum gyi sdom pa dang ldan zhing / chos gos rnam gsum dang ldan pa 'di rnams yoni sbyong ba'i gnas yin
