ra༅༅/ /bar/ /zang zing nor gyi ngor bltas nas/ /chos zhu ru cog gi slob ma la/ /snyan brgyud gdams ngag ma ston ang / /nyams pa'i grib kyis phog nyen —gda'/ /ri khrod dben pa ma lags pa'i/ /mi nag grong gi nye 'khor du/ /dad log snang balhar mi nus pa'i/ /zab mo tshogs kyi gsor lo dang / /brtul zhugs spyod pa ma byed ang / /skye bo'i ya ga phog nyen gda'/ /ang drug nyams len glu chung 'di/ /spyir chos mdzade yongs kyi spyi nor yin/ /sgos bu slob rnams kyi sems la zhog /ces gsungs pas/ thugs sras rnams kyi thugs la 'jags par gyur pa las/ yang ras pa rnams kyi nang nas gzhon pa phyag phyir sngerdzod zer ba rnams kyis da snyigs dus su serdzong gda' bas/ bdag blo dman rnams kyi blo dang 'tshams pa'i zhal gdams shig kyang gnang bar zhu zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /khyed da dung gson dang bu slobo rnams/ /

thub pa'i bstan pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /snying rus rdo la yi ge bris/ /zhi gnas ltengs po'i gnyid byung na/ /sgo gsum rig pa gsos 'debs gyis/ /ye shes me stag chung ring la / /dran pa'i me gserdzos yang yang dzār+sha/ /'khor ba'i btson dong sgrol 'dod na/ /yengs pa med par 'bad la sgoms/ /mya ngan 'das la mngon dga' na/ /'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad thong / /snying nas chos shig byed bsams na/ /nga zer nyon la nga phyir 31ga /sgrab pa mtha' ru 'don 'dod na/ /rgyu 'bras nam 'chi cha med serdzoms/ /sgrub pa yun du byas pa na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas gting nas mnyes/ /chos la ngo stosnag ma byas na/ /drin can bla ma'i bka' drin 'khophor/ /tshig dang done du ma 'dzol na/ /mi nga yang 〈sna ba skye ba'i phyir/ /'di bas phyi ma nges par bde/ /zhes gsungs pas/ kun dga' mgu yi rangs te/ tshe 'di blos btang ba'i nyams len la brtson par gyur to/ /bon po ri'i skor

ra༅༅/ /ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid gnya' nang grod phug na bzhugs dus/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'gror mas masgo sum du zhalabastan te mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag chig brgyud du gnas pa'i bka' rgya bkrol nas snedi ldan 'ga' zung la bstan pas chog pa'i lung bstan byung ste/ ras chung pa dang ngan rdzong stod pa la sogs pa'i thugs dang 'dra ba'i bu slob 'ga' la snyan brgyud kyi dbang gnang ba'i bum dbang bskur dus/ mi rgan rgas 'dug pas bum pa khyod rang song la slobo ma rnams le dbang bskur cig gsungs pas/ bum pa nam mkhar 'phags nas slobo ma rnams la rim par dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' las rol mo'i sgra sna tshogos grags pa dang / sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri bzang 'thul ba dang / lha'i me tog gi char sna tshogs 'bab pa la sogs pa'i ltas bzang so byung zhing / de dus kyi slob ma kun gyis dbang gi ye shes mngon du

byas so/ /de la bu slob rnams kyis ngo mtshar du byas pas/ rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so/ /snyan brgyud dri med dkyil 'khor du/ /zhen pa med pa'i mchod pa bshams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes ngo sprod pa'i/ /rin chen bum chu'i dbang bskur tshe/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi mchod pa dang / /sna tshogs rol mo sgrog bzhin du/ /bum pa rang gis dbang bskur la/ /ye shes ngo mtshar skyes pa bzang / /bka' brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ /zhes gsungs shing de re zhig gsang bar slob ma kun la bka' rgyas btab bo/ /yang ras chung pas rdo rje rnal 'gror ma'i bris sku zhig bzhengs pa la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ mi la rgan pos cho ga rgyas pa mi shes pas dam tshig pa'i lha la ye shes pa rnams brtan par bzhugs la dga' stone du me tog longs shig gsungs nas me tog gtor ba'i tshe/ bris sku g.yo 'gul mang po mdzad pa'i bar la/ nam mkha' nas 'ja' 'od kyi sku gsung thugs

sa༅༅/ /kyi rten mang po thim zhing lha'i me tog bzang po'i char babs pa de/ dbu la thod bzhin du blangs shing sku la khyab snyam du chags pa la kun gyis ya mtshan du byas pas rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so/ /gzugs sku dam tshig sems dpa' la/ /chos sku ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs/ /'od kyi sku gsung thugs byon pas/ /bstims nas ngo sprod rab gnas tshe/ /mi la rgan nas ma longs kyang / /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs skyas/ /rgyal ba chos sku'i zhing khams nas/ /gzugs sku'i me tog spyan drangs te/ /yi dam lha la mngon sum thim/ /rab tu gnas par zhal bzhes phyir/ /ya mtshan me tog blangs pa de/ /dbu dang sku lamadze+es par brgyan/ /slar yang yi dam rang la thim/ /de longo mtshar skyes pa de/ oṃ/kun la skal ba yod pa'i rtags/ /zhes gsungs pas ras chung pa la sogs pa'i bu sleb kun gyis rje btsun dang rdo rje rnal 'gror ma dbyer med du

mthong ba lags so/ /dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid la dang po nas mchog tu dad pa'i yon bdag gshen rdor mo dang legs se zhes bya ba'i bza' mi gnyis yod pa des rtsar mar spyan drangs pas/ rje btsun dang mjal ma thag gshen rdor mos phyag nas 'jus te/ da bdag rgas 'khogs nas 'chi la thug pas 'jigs te/ rje btsun gyi drung du chos byed pa ma byung bas 'gyod zer mang du ngu zhing 'dug pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas yon bdag skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal 'di chos mdzad dam pa rnams ma gtogs sems can kun la 'ong / de la 'jigs na 'chi khar chos byas na 'thad gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /'o sko/la 'gro ba 'jig rten pa/ /skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi/ /gcig tu ma zad kun la yodi/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor yang yang 'khor/ /mi shes sdug bsngal rba la g.yengs/ /bde ba skad cig mi gda' na/ /sdug gis

ra༅༅/ /dogs nas sdug bsngal bsgrub/ /skyid du re zhing sdig pa byed/ /sdug bsngal 'di las thar 'dod na/ /ngan spyod sdig pa spangs na legs/ /'chi khar lha chos byas na 'thad/ /ces gsungs pas kho na re/ bdag skye ba'i dug bsngal mi dran pa gda' bas gsung bar zhu dang zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /'o na yon bdag dad pa can/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsa na/ /kun gzhi bar dor 'khyams po de/ /chags sdang gnyis kyi mngal du zhugs/ /ma yi mngal du zhugs tsa na/ /nya mo dol la 'thums pa 'dra/ /khrag chu ser nang du nyal tsa na/ /mi gtsang ba la sngas gdan byas/ /las ngan dbang gis lus ngan grub/ /gnas ngan nang du sdug bsngal spyod/ /tshe sngone dran yang skad ma thon/ /tsha grang sna tshogs nyams su myong / /zla dgu ngo bcu dgral bar lus/ /ma las skyes pa'i dus su yang / /lus 'jur mig mkhrang las drangs pa 'dra/ /ma yi

mngal sgor go tsa na/ /tsher ma'i dong du bsnar ba 'dra/ /ma yi pang du blangs tsa na/ /bye'u chung khra yi khyer ba 'dra/ /mi gtsang phru ma phyis tsa na/ /gar+sā por lpags pa bzhus pa 'dra/ /lte ba'i thag pa bcad tsa na/ /khong me'i srog rtsa bcad pa 'dra/ /tshang bu mal du bcug tsa na/ /bskyags nas baphro dong bor ba 'dra/ /lar skye med r+pā gcig ma rtogs na / /skyeba'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /'chi kar dgoso pa'i lha chos la/ /phyir bzhol byas pas skalpopa chad/ /'bungs nas lha chos byas pa 'thad/ /ces gsungs pas yang kho na re/ rgas pa'i sdug bsngal zhig kyang gsung bar zhu zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsu ngas so/ /'o na yon bdag gzhug bzang po/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal bshad tsa na / /rang lus wāng bzhi rgud pa yi/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yi re mug /drang por skyes pa'i lus po rgur/ /brtan por bzhag kyang gom pa gzor/ /nag 'i skyes pa'i smra lo

ra༅༅/ /dkar/ /dbang po'i dwangs ma mig kyang 'gribs/ /yan lag gtso bo mgo bo 'khor/ /sgra rnams nyan byed rna ba zhon/ /mkhur tshos khrag gi rgya mtsho skams/ /byad kyi rgyang shing sna yang zhom/ /rus pa'i dwangs ma dung so bud/ /smra ba'i rgyal po lce yang ldib/ ṣeg sre'i bu lon bsad bzhin mang / /zas dang gnyen 'dun bsdas kyang bros/ /sdug bsngal yi chad spangs shing 'khor/ /bden par smras kyang nyan mkhan med/ /gces par gsos pa'i bu tsha sdang / /bsogs tshad byin la drin gzo med/ sh+ka 'phyis zer zhing dmod mo mang / /lar rgas med don zhig ma rtogs na/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /rgas nas lha chos mi dran pa/ /sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin yin/ /da lta kha dbugs yod ring la/ /dam pa'i lha chos byas na legs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ /kho na re de rnams ji bzhin bdag gi thog tu bab gda'/ da na ba'i sdug bsngal

zhig gsung dang zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /'o na yon bdagaskyoshas ga/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsa na/ /lus glo buranyid lar+sā kyilobatab/ /zugagazer yid la med par langs/ /rlung mkhris bad kan bdud— du babs/ khrag dang chu ser khol zhing na/ ji /nad dang gzer gyis dbang po bsdus/ /mal bde mor nyal kyang 'gre ldog mame / /sngon ser sna byas pa'i las dbang gis/ /zas bzapapo byin yang kha nas ldog /gnas bsil bar bsdad kyang me bas tsha/ /gos dro bar g.yogagokyang chu b.lograng / /gnyen bshes rnams kyi mtha' bskor yang / /na ba'i sdug bsngalobago thabs med/ /rtsobon sman pa thabs mkhasda kyung / /sngon las ngan na tsha sel bar dka'/ /lar na med don zhig ma rtogs na/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal bsam lasa'adas/ /na tsha nam phog mi shes pas/ /sdug dogs lha chos byas3 'thad/ zhes gsungs pas/ yang kho na re bdag 'chi

ra༅༅/ /khar lha chos shig e 'ong lta bas 'chi ba'i sdag bsngal zhig gsung bar zhu dang zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /'o na yon bdag nges 'byung can/ /'chi ba'itsasdug bsngal skyi re bun/ /lan gcig 'chi ba byung ba'i tshe/ /gzhin rje'i pho nyas zin pa na/ /phyug po'i nor gyis blu sa med/ /dpa' bos ral kha sprad sa med/ /mdzangs mas bslu brid bya sa med/ /mkhas pas 'ordzo rgyus bkrerdzol sa med/ /phongs pas zhu ba bya sa med/ /ngan pas snres gdol bya sa med/ /sngar mas wa bros bya sa med/ /yan lag rtsa rnams mtha' nas bsdus/ /phan tshun ri bos mnan pa 'dra/ /dbang po'i yul rnams thams cad bsdus/ /phan du re ba'i sman pas bor/ /skyebo tu re ba'i mo bon bros/ /rten sgyab byas pa'i lha srung yar/ /brda dang gtam la lan mi thebs/ /dbugs phyi nang 'gyu ba ma chad na'ang / /lus la shi sha'i dri ma chags/ /drod me stag tsam de mtha' nas

sdusdo/ /la ༷ gza'an+d+ra nga skar ma spu+o/ /la la sdugā bsngal 'o sad 'asdod/tram̐/ la zas dang nor la sgomo/ /rang gisabasoskya pa gaspyan gyi~X spyod/ /sems5 rtse ba mang yang k+ṣiṃg sngir ༵spya/ /༷pyas babe+e ༷ ༷da kyang skyug bra lta/ /༅sa pa' lus pa sum lhagabyasdu/ /phung pargung du bskyur n+d+ras s+t+yasa'i/ /ra bags chur ba༅ dang du bskyur/ /dpa zaṭ+wāṃ kha thagashe sase/ /da bad par 'dugā gaX dasdo pa can/ /spyabugs 'gyu ba chad pa'asangasapard/me/lomaglang nar gyas gang nayadā / /bdagaziphan pam 'a〉ga ༵sa/ /ra sgruphywa snro ca snasan/ /byams pa' gzhugagyaswā mtha' bskar yang / /phan+d+ra pa skad sa/ sgrub sdibayod/'i/thamasdu can+d+ra 'bral dror zithang tsa na/'a/0 sacwa mā dro da ang / /da 'dra' dus gabyung tsa na/ /dalopa' lha chas ma lagasapa/ /gang gas phan pa yad pa man/ /'cha dus ma 'gyad tsam ra dgas/ /'cha khar ma 'tshar tsam ra

ra༅༅/ /mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ gshen rdor mo chos sgor zhugs pa la khrid btab nas bsgoms pas 'chi khar lam sna zin par gyur to/ /de'i tshe legs se 'bum gyis rje btsun yab sras rtag tu mi bzhugs rung / zhag shas cis kyang bzhugs dbesnas zer nan gyis zhu ba phul nas/ zhag bdun bzhugs pa'i bar la gnya' nang na mi mang tshogs tsha tsha 'debs pa zhig yod pa de byung bas/ legs se na re/ rje btsun yab sras kyang ltad mo la 'byon nam zer/ nged mi 'gro gsungs pas/ 'o na de ring dge rtsar gda' bas/ rang re'i mchod khang du mchod pa 'bul ba dang / tsha tsha 'ga' 'debs grogs mdzod/ sems can gyi don lags pas/ bdag gi bu chung dang re'u lug la'ang gzigs grogs mdzod/ khyimadang snod spyad rnams la'ang gad re mdzad grogs mdzod cig zer mo rgyan gos bzang por zhugs nas song / rje btsun yab sras thugs dam la 'byams nas mo'i

ra༅༅/ /mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ gshen rdor mo chos sgor zhugs pa la khrid btab nas bsgoms pas 'chi khar lam sna zin par gyur to/ /de'i tshe legs se 'bum gyis rje btsun yab sras rtag tu mi bzhugs rung / zhag shas cis kyang bzhugs dbesnas zer nan gyis zhu ba phul nas/ zhag bdun bzhugs pa'i bar la gnya' nang na mi mang tshogs tsha tsha 'debs pa zhig yod pa de byung bas/ legs se na re/ rje btsun yab sras kyang ltad mo la 'byon nam zer/ nged mi 'gro gsungs pas/ 'o na de ring dge rtsar gda' bas/ rang re'i mchod khang du mchod pa 'bul ba dang / tsha tsha 'ga' 'debs grogs mdzod/ sems can gyi don lags pas/ bdag gi bu chung dang re'u lug la'ang gzigs grogs mdzod/ khyimadang snod spyad rnams la'ang gad re mdzad grogs mdzod cig zer mo rgyan gos bzang por zhugs nas song / rje btsun yab sras thugs dam la 'byams nas mo'i

las ci yang ma grub par re'u lug gis zhing zos/ bu chung ngu ba'i sgang la mo sleb byung ste/ ci yang ma mdzad par 'dug pas/ mo na re gzhan rnams mi mdzad rung / chos par thugs rje chen yo dgos pas bu dang re'u lug mi sdug tsam dang / dge las rnams mdzad pas skyon dogs med lags zer ba'i lan du rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so//nga gnas bde chen gyi spang kha yangs pa la/ /gzhi 'gyur med kyi re'u lug bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /khrag chags re'u lug khyodang ba'i 'o(nga ma byung / /khrag chags re'u lug legs se 'bum gyis skyongs/ /nga byams dang snying rje'i a ma yis/ /rig pa'i khye'u chung bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /snabs bshal bu tsha skyong ba'i long ma byung / /snabs bshal bu tsha legs se 'bum gyis skyongs/ /nga sgom mi 'gyur gyi ri bo brtan pa la/ /dran pa yengs med kyi tsha tsha btab btab nas/ /'jim pa'i tsha tsha 'debs pa'i long ma byung / /'bi 'bi'i

ra༅༅/ /tsha tsha legs se 'bum gyis mdzod/ /nga byang khog stod kyi mchod khang du/ /sgom 'od gsal gyi mar me 'bul 'bul nas/ /ras dkar sdong dra/ 'dzugs pa'i 'ordzong ma byung / /ras dkar sngerdzong bu legs se 'bum gyis tshugs/ /sgyu ma lus kyi khang hrul la/ /bag chags phyags dar byed byed nas/ /khang pa'i phyags dar ngas ma byung / /khang pa'i phyags dar legs se 'bum gyis mdzod/ /nga sna tshogs srid pa'i yo byad la/ /sgyu ma'i rtsal sbyang byed byed nas/ /phor sder 'khrud pa'i long ma byung / /spyad pa'i bkru bshal legs se 'bum gyis mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ mo na re/ /rje btsun lags nged 'jig rten pa'i dge ba yang khyad du mi gsod par zhu/ bdag gis bla mchod gzhan yang bsten myong zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla mchod snying rje med pa de/ /the'u rang lha ru mchod pa 'dra/ /bdag gzhan gnyis phung ya re cha/ /sems

bskyed med pa'i chos spyod de/ /blun po mgo bskor dra ba 'dra/ /'dod pa 'bar ba ya re cha/ /phyogs res can gyi sbyin pa de/ /kha lan ston mo'i re mos 'dra/ /re zhalang mang ba ya re cha/ /zhing sa med pa'i 'bul ba de/ /khram pas nor bcol gtad pa 'dra/ /'khrul gzhi 'gyur ba ya re cha/ /snying rje med pa'i sgyin gtong de/ /ka ba 'breng bas brabs pa 'dra/ /rang la 'khril ba ya re cha/ /rang rgyud ma thul lta ba de/ /'ud gogo rbad gtam byed pa 'dra/ /rgyu 'bras khyad gsode ya re cha/ /gnad du ma song 〉snam pa de/ /rdzun mas zor khang 'bubs pa 'dra/ /yode lo byed pa ya re cha/ /rten 'brel ma shar spyodi pa de/ /spyod pas tsha chu 'thungs pa 'dra/ /'dod sred 'phel ba ya re cha/ /chos brgyad sgrigs pa'i dam tshig de/ /mi gtsang dar du gtums pa 'dra/ /nang nas rul ba ya re cha/ /rang 'dod ma spangs 'bras ngu de/ /rdzab la mi gzugs bzos pa 'dra/ /rkyen gyis 'jig pa ya re

ra༅༅/ /cha / /zhes gsungs pas/ mo 'grod pa skyes te/ rgyan gyi gseb nas g.yu drag pa zhig phyag rten du phul nas khrid zhur byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis legs se 'bum la rdo rje tshig rkang ma 'di mgur du gsungs so/ /nyon dang phyug mo legs se 'bum/ /rnam rig bkra ba'i rig pa can/ /khyod rang gi lus la tshur stos la/ /skyid 'dod med pa'i sgom zhig gyis/ /rang gi ngag la tshur stos la/ /smra brjod med pa'i sgom zhig gyis/ /rang gi sems la tshur ltos la/ /rnam rtog med pa'i sgom zhig gyis/ /lus ngag yid gsum ma yengs par/ /sgom rgyu med pa'i 〉rdzom zhig gyis/ /zhes gsungs nas/ mos bsgoms pas nyams skyes te bla ma la yan lag bdun pa 'di phul 'ordzo//rje ngo mtshar ras kyi na bza' can/ /gtad pa med pa'i khengs sems can/ /ya nga med pa'i zhe dogs can/ /chags pa med pa'i blo gdengs can/ /brtul zhugs ras pa'i zhabs

la 'dud/ /ras chen khyed la mchod par 'bul/ /brtul zhugs ras la sdig pa bshags/ bla ma khyed la rjes yi rang / /chos k+ṣi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dge ba 'gro kun don du bsngo/ /rang gi lus la tshur bltas nas/ /skyid 'dod med pa'i sgom byas kyang / /da dung skyid 'dod 'ong zhing gda'/ /rang gilo ngag la tshur bltas nas/ /smra 'dodi med pa'i sgom byas kyang / /da dung smra 'dod 'ong zhing gda'/ /rang gis sems la tshur bltas nas/ /rnam rtog med pa'i sgom byas kyang / /da dung rnam rtog 'ong zhing gda'/ /lus ngag yid gsum ma yengs pa'i/ /sgom rgyu med sdi'i sgom byas kyang / /da dung sgom rgyu 'ong zhing gda'/ /gdams ngag gegs sel bogs 'don zhu/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du rje btsun gyis gegs sel bogs 'don gyi rmegu/ra zhadi gsungs so/ /nyon dang gseni dang legs se 'bum/ /khyod lus la skyed 'dod

ra༅༅/ /'dug pa na/ /'dus pa'i gnyen dang gson 'bral gyis/ /bsags pa'i nor rnams sbyin par thong / /chags zhen med pa'i ngang la sdode/ /ngag la smra 'dod 'dug pa na/ /'jig rten chos brgyad rgyab tu por/ /nga rgyal rang mthong rlung la bskur/ /nga rgyal med pa'i ngang la sdod/ /sems la rnam rtog 'dug pa na/ /rang sems dran pa'i lcags kyus zungs/ /'khor 'das gnyis su mi 'dzin par/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang la sdod/ /gang shar rjes med ngang du skyongs/ /da dung sgom rgyu 'dug pa na/ /sems can rnams la snying rje sgoms/ /rang lus thugs rje chen por sgoms/ /spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma sgoms/ /stong pa nyid la sgom yun srings/ /rjes la bsngo ba'i rgya yis thob/ /de go bar gyis la lha chos mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ mos kyang rje btsun gyi bka' bzhin nyams su blangs pas lam sna zin pa'i rnal 'gyor mar gyur to/ /gshen rdor mo dang legs se

'bumagyi skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid gnya' nang grod phug na bzhugs dus/ thugs sras ras chung pa de nyid la 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang ba cung zad 'dug pa la/ 〈snangs gsungs pa'i zhal ta yang yang gnang bas ras chung pa'i thugs la/ ngas pha yul ni spangs chos brgyad kyi skyod gyis ma bordzos las che snyam rje btsun la pha yul spangs pas chos phyed 'grub zer ba de bden lags sam zhus pas rje btsun gyi zhal nas chos spyi skad la de skad zer te/ des cung mi phan gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so//rigs kyi bdag po'i ngo bo ni/ /spyi gtsug bde chen pho brang na/ /skyon gyis ma gos bla ma de/ /yon tan tshogs kyis rab brgyan te/ /blta bas mi ngoms rje la bstod/ /pha yul spangs pa'i mi yul kyang / /de srung lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos/ /grags dang snyan pa che na dga'/ /bar der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb/ /zas bkur sti spangs pa'i kham

ra༅༅/ /zan kyang / /che la gsog lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos/ /de yang zhim la 'grangs na dga'/ /bar der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb/ /gos re'u phrug spangs pa'i lcam ber kyang / /tshem drub lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos/ /de yang gro 'jam yang na dga'/ /bar der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb/ /mkhar khyim spangs pa'i sa phug kyang / /thigs tshags lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos/ /de yang btsan la rub na dga'/ /bar der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb/ /zhing chen spangs pa'i zhing chung yang / /so nam lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos/ /'o/ nyung bzang la mang na dga'/ /bar der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb/ /'khor ba'i chos nyid gzhi bral te/ /brtags na ngos bzung med pa la/ /rtogs na mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /thams cad stong pa'i chos nyid la/ /rnal 'gyor rtag par ma 'dzin cig /ces gsungs pas/ /gsang sngags thabs kyi

lam la bsten pa lags pas/ 'dod skurdzon bag tsam re bsten pas khyab lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas 'dod yerdzon sgrub pa'i grerdzogs su 'gro na bsten pas rung ste/ sgrub pa 'dod yon gyi grogs su 'gyur na mi rung / ngas lho brag mar pa'i drung nas 'ong dus chos brgyad spongs/ 'dod yon ngan ngon tsam la brten nas sgrub pa gyis shig gsung ba ltar bsgrubs pas yod tan cung zad rgyud la skyes pa yin/ khyod kyang chos brgyad spongs la sgrab pa long yod du ma bzhag par sgrubs shig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje bla ma'i rnam thar sems la gcags/ /gsung zhal ta bdud rtsi brjed dus med/ /chormi long yod la bzhag na skal ba chad/ /chos rang rgyud la bsre na 'bungs la sgoms/ /tshe 'di la chags na phyi ma sdug /'phral skyid la dga' na bar chod che/ /chos long yode la bzhag na glen pa yin/ /rang 'chi bas 'jigs na 'bungs la sgoms/ /las

ra༅༅/ /sdig pa spyad na ngan 'gror ltung / /sems g.yo zog 'dug na rang nyid brlag /rang bsam ngan skye na bsod nams 'dzad/ /las rnam smin sbyong na 'bungs la sgoms/ /gos bzang po rgyan 'dod snang ba 'khrul/ /zas zhim po za 'dod sdig spyod rem/ /gtam snyan po 'dod na lha khang brdugs/ /blo chos brgyad spongs la 'bungs la sgoms/ /phyug po 'ong 'dod dgra dang phrad/ /'khor mang pos bskor 'dod blo 'grod che/ /tshogs dngos po gsog 'dod log lta mang / /blo chos dang bstun nas 'bungs la sgoms/ /sgom nus na sems la rtogs pa 'char/ /ma nus kha bshad khram pa'i gshags/ /yun ring po sgom 'ordzong ma mchis pas/ /yengs med 〉snam la brtseni par gyis/ /blo chos dang 'dre na gar yang bde/ /rang gcig pur bsdad pa cis kyang drag /sgom gsal stong gi bsam gtan rin po che/ /bu ras chung gi sems la gnas par shog /

ces gsungs pas chos brgyad kha bri ba tsam ma gtogs mtshang thoni pa ma byung bas 'di la nges 'byung gi bskul 'debs shig dbostas par 'dug datrerengs pa las/ gnya' nang tshong 'dus su dmar khye ba'i tshong pa mang du byung ba'i tshe/ ras chung pa dang dpon slob gnyis pos bsod snyoms la byon pas/ sha'i rtsig pa brtsigs/ mgo'i phung po spungs/ pags pa gcal du bkram/ khrag gi mtsho bskyil te/ sems can gsede rgyu mang po bstar la brgyus pa'i dbus na moni pa rgan po lag pa zha ba zhig gis kyang lug nag po chen po zhig la khong lag btang bas rma bzos tsam la rgyu ma nar ra ra lug cerdzor te/ 'jigs nas skad chen po 'don zhing 'dar khril li ba'i ngang la rje btsun yab sras la skyabs tshol du byung nas lug tshe'i dus byed pa'i bar la/ rje btsun gyis spyan chab mang po bsil zhing lug la 'pho ba mdzad nas rnam shes byang chub lam la bkod de snying rje chen sto mi bzod pa'i ngang nas mgur 'di

ra༅༅/ /gsungs so/ /e ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la yar ltos dang / /a tsa ma sdig can snying re rje/ /las re rmongs mi lus kyi yong ba la/ /zhe re phangs sems can gyi gsod lugs la/ /gyod re che rang mgo'i skor lugs la/ /cug re drag pha ma'i 'chi lugs la/ /ji ltar byed sdig sha'i brtsigs lugs la/ /ci re byed khrag gis mang lugs la/ /ji tsam stosnags sha yi za lugs la/ /gang nas bsams snang ba'i 'khrul lugs la/ /sdig re che snying rje med lugs la/ /ji tsam sgribs rmongs pa'i gti mug la/ /ci re byed sdig pa'i so nam la/ /su yis spyod 'dod pas gdung lugs la/ /gang gis byas yul lugs kyi ngan pa la/ /cug re drag skyo ba'i skye lugs la/ /ci rang byed sdig can gyi brel lugs la/ /phyi ma skad cig mi dran pa'i/ /mi 'di 'dra mthong na nga re 'jigs/ /sdig spyodi rnams dran zhing snang ba 'khrugs/ /

ras chung pa lha chos shig e dran ang / /dran na skyo shas kyi snying rlung ldang / /sgom na ri khrod kyi gnas su gshegs/ /bsam na bla ma'i bka' drin soms/ /'bros na sdig spyod rtsa nas bros/ /gtong na 'jig rten gyi bya ba thongs/ /'dzin na sgrub pa'i dam bca' zungs/ khes na mi tshe chos la skyol/ /zhes gsungs pas ras chung pa yang skyo shas dang nges 'byung drag po gting nas skyes te spyan chab mang po bsil zhing / bla ma lags da bdag kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin chos brgyad sdig zas kyi 'asbo ba spangs nas sgom pa lags pas 'o skol dpon slob dben pa'i ri gang 'dra zhig la sgom du 'byon zhus pa'i lan du rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so/ /e ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /las ngan gyis bsgribs pas mun pa nag /rnam rtog gi rkun ma mang la 〈snad/ /bsam gtan gyi nor bu 'chol las che/ /yengs med kyi mel tshe byed re ran/ /mi sdig can la 'chi ba 'ong snyam

ra༅༅/ /med/ /nged rang ras chung gnyis la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /'khor ba'i rgyun ni lam 'phrang ring / /dug lnga'i jag pa 'tshub la rgod/ /bu rig pa'i khye'u chung 'dzin las che/ /ye shes kyi skyel ma tshol re ran/ /mi sdig can la 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/ /rang re ras chung gnyis la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /skyon gyi ri so dpang re mtho/ /nyon mongs kyi rngen pa khyi re tsha/ /ting 'dzin gyi ri dwags gsod las che/ /yang dag gi mtha' la 'bros re ran/ /mi sdig can la 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/ /rang re ras chung gnyis la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /sgya ma lus kyi khang hrul la/ /zhag dang za ma'i char pa babs/ /'o( dang zla ba'i thigs pas brdungs/ /sgya ma'i khang hrul 'jig las che/ /'chi brod kyi thigs chogs byed re ran/ /mai sdig can la 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/ /rang re ras chung gnyis la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /'khor ba'i rgye mtsho gting re zab/ /rig pa'i khye'u

chung rkyal re ran/ /'grul pa'i rba la g.yengs las che/ /gnyis med kyi gling du 'bros re ran/ /mi sdig can la 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/ /rang re ras chung gnyis la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /'khrig chags kyi ne'u thang yangs la che/ /khyim thab kyi 'dam rdzab gting re zab/ /nges 'byung gi glang po nying las che/ /thar pa'i skam sa snyeg re ran/ /mi sdig can la 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/ /rang re ras chung gnyis la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /theg dman gyi lta sgom g.yang sa che/ /blo dman gyi byis pa bya byed mang / /rigs drug gi g.yang la lhang las che/ /mi sdig can la 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/ /rang re ras chung gnyis la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /zhes gsungs nas dpon slob gnyis byon pas tshong 'dus kyi gzhi byes kyi mi phal cher rang dbang med par dad pa skyes nas/ rje btsun yab sras la bsnyen bkur dang 'asbo ba'i yo byad mang po phul rung sdig zas dang 'jig rten chos brgyad du 'dug

ra༅༅/ /gsungs nas ma bzhes par la phyi gangs la byon no/ /'chi brod thigs tshags ma'i skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la yab sras gnyis la phyi'i bdud 'dul phug mo che na bzhugs dus mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul drag po byung bas/ ras chung pa sku rgyab kyi brag phug gcig tu ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs pas/ lha 'dre rnams kyis rje btsun la 'jigs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs ston cing mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa dang / khyod kyi sha khrag de nged rnams kyis sus thob la khyer ro zer mi snyan pa sna tshogs brjod du byung ba'i tshe mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyon mongs gdug rtsub zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'o na yi dwags snying re rje/ /'dre mo'i dmag tshogs las re rmongs/ /khyed bsam ngan gdug sems goms pas na/ /sems can yongs la 'tshe bar 'dod/ kho dang khrag la za 'dod pas/ /

gsode gcod dbugs len shin tu khrod/ /lus ngan yi dwags nang du skyes/ /las ngan spyad cing dpyal bar skye/ /thar pa'i sa bon mi dran pas/ /thar thabs med pas snying re rje/ /nga stong nyid rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rdzu 'phrul lus kyi bkod pa la/ /khyed khyer rgyu rnyed na dga' ba yin/ /byang chub sems kyi snying rje la/ /'dre mang po tshogs na de bas dga'/ /zhes gsungs nas/ rje btsun gyis zad par chu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ dar cig nas lha 'dre'i dmag sngar bas kyang mang ba chas byung ste/ de rnams kyi nang nas bud med 'jigs su rung ba zhig na re/ kho ga re zer bas/ gcig gis snga sor chu 'di'i thad na 'dug zer rde'u zhig bskyar song bas/ rje btsun gyis nga 'di na yod ces sku dngos bstan pas kun 'jigs nas bros serdzong / yang slar 'ordzog nas cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan kyang glags ma rnyed pa dang / lha ba'adre rnams na re da rang re rnams 'dums gyis zer

༄ngaX/ 'a/bas/ rjezlo tsun gyis thudzo kau na i nganganas mgur sdosngi gsungs so/ /sdod lega~X par wo daze sngi ma yin/ri/khyed las phu 'asnga dasbyag dpungad/ /lasazlonasdag pa rang lasdago/ngasna~Xsradu sa skyur shar ba la/ /'drasdudamag dpudu rgan ducha/tho/da sasapar kau caga~X 'dra rnams/ /khyad dkan mchag gsum ṅgi skyaba~X sna rnyi/ /gan+d+ras bzang pa 'chug da rnyad payan/ khokhrarnyizasasu mari za na/tram̐/tha ras thar pa ba pa sdun/ /'gra la sbya byā spangs pya na/ /byang chub swām sna myur du 'an/'a/ da ༵ pa spa~X nus na/ /sangs rjos ba~Xn la zhugs ni ༄/ /dag ba bcu pa lhas nus no/ /bla ma' shā/mas ngag ga ba yan/ /sgad gsum rnyisdig sdi zha nus na / /rag 'dzan gras la da pa na/ /dam bca' sdam pa na nus na/ /'a skal 'dun ma 'cham pa yan/ /sdam pa dam srung nus na/ /ngas kyang rjas su 'an pa yan/ /

zhes gsungs pas lha 'dre rnams dad nas sngar tho 'tshams pa mthola'ordzo bshags serdzo/ /da bka'i 'bangs bgyid pas chos gnang bar zhu zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis kyang khong rnams la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi lung dang las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad pas kun gyis srog snying dang dam bca' re phul nas song ngo / /de nas rje btsun gyis ras chung pa la mdang khyod la ji lta bu zhig byung gsungs pas/ bdag la 'od gsal gyi ngang nas ltad mo chen po rang byung / mdang rje btsun gyi gzim mal du gcig gis rde'u zhig bskyur song ba sku la ma phog lags sam zhus pas/ mdang nga nyams dga' la lus chur bsgyar ba yin te/ rde'u phog pa yin nam rnyesnad 'di na mi bde ba'i nyams shig 'dug ltos dang gsung / yang rje btsun sku lus chur basmyur bas ras chung pas rde'u gsal bas rje btsun sku khems bde bar gyur to/ /de nas bu slob gzhan yang mang po phebs byung ba dang / rje btsun la phyi'i mdun gyi ri mthon

ra༅༅/ /po zhig yod pa der skyo sangs la 'gro gsungs pas/ 'khor rnams kyis da sku na bgres pas mi thar bas mi phebs par zhu zhus pas/ las sla 'di ltar byas pas chog gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nga mi la ri rtser 'gro 'dod pas/ /mi la ras pa rgas pa dang / /'byung bzhi rgud nas 'gro ma nus/ /bem po'i ri khyod ljar gyis nyol/ /zhes gsungs ma thag ri mgo gug byung ba'i rtser rje btsun gyis zhabs bzhag pa dang yang gyen du langs song / der ri rtse na 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i dbus su re zhig bzhugs nas/ slar yang 'phur nas phebs te nga la ri rtser chang 'dren mkhan yang byung gsungs pas/ bdag cag rnams kyang der sleb pa'i thabs zhu/ chang ji ltar byung zhus pas/ ri rtser 'gro na gdams ngag 'di ltar sgom dgos zhes mgur 'di gsungs so/ /ri las lta 'dod bu slob rnams/ /'dzin na rang

sems 'od gsal zungs/ /gcun na re mig ltar gyis chun/ /'ching na rgya mdud ltar gyis chings/ /'dzin na lcags kyu ltar gyis zungs/ /de ltar bsgoms na thar pa ye ri rtser bslebs nas ltad mo lta/ /nyams myong chang la 'thung ba yin/ /skal ldan pho mo nang du shog /ltas dang ston mos tshim par byed/ /skalamed rnams ni phyir la khyed/ /chang rang 'thung dag mi nus te/ /sings po 'thung yang mi nus sam/ /byang chub sgrab dag mi nus te/ /mtho ris sgrab kyang mi nus sam/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa na re byang chub kyang sgrub nus lags/ chang yang 'thung bas gnang bar zhu zer ba'i lan dre/ 'o na drin mchog mar pa'i rlugs kyis chang 'di ltar 'thungs zhes mgur 'di gsungs so/ /snying po'i don la mnga' brnyes shing / /gnyug ma'i don la rgyun chad med/ /sgra sgyar mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /pha khong gi mtshan nyid 'di 'dra ste/ /nam mkha' bzhin du gsal la

ra༅༅/ /dag /nyi zla bzhin du kun la khyab/ /'dam bu'i tshal bzhin mtho dman med/ /sangs rgyas rgyal po ldo brag pa/ /'bral med gtsug gi rgyan pye bzhugs/ /rigs drug gtso bo mi rnams kyang / /dbyed dang ston gyi dus rtag tu/ /snying po med pa'i so nam la/ /ser mo chang gi yo lang byed/ /'o skol chang zhig btsos nas 'thung / /chang gi 'tshod lugs bshad tsa na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgyed bu btsugs/ /stong pa nyid kyi zangs nang du/ /dkar mo dad pa'i nas shig blugs/ /dran pa snying rje'i chu zhig blugs/ /ye shes chen po'i me zhig sbar/ /mtha' dbus med par chan du btsos/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi thang dkyil du/ /bde ba chen po'i phyar bar bdal/ /gdams ngag dam pa'i phabs shig btab/ /tshad med bzhi yi mal du nyal/ /du ma ro gzhag glum du langs/ /'du byed rdza ma'i nang du blugs/ /thabs shes gnyis su med par bamings/ /ye shes

lnga yi chang du ngar/ /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i them khung nas/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i chang btsags pas/ /rgyu la rnam dag he ru ka /rkyen la chos dbyings he ru ka /mdog la pad+ma he ru ka /ro la rdo rje he ru ka /dri la sna tshogs he ru ka /reg la sgeg pa'i he ru ka /da ni rnal 'gror chang 'thung ste/ /dang po chos skur gsal la dag /gnyis pa longs skur rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gsum pa sprul skur cir ya/nga snang / /rgyun chad med pa'i sings po la/ /skal ldan bdud rtsir 'thung ste mchi/ /skal med 'thung mkhan byung dogs med/ /yang cig 'thung ba'i dpe bshad na/ /myoji 'dzin dag pa'i chang phud de/ /chos nyid ngang du bsings nas ni/ /sum ldan bla ma sangs rgyas mchod/ /thabs shes ldan pa'i 'bring po de/ /dam tshig ngang du bkug bkug nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes par byas/ /mchog thun mong gnyis kyi sings po de/ /nyams myong ngang du bskyangs nas kyang / /rang

ra༅༅/ /gzhan kun gyi 'dod pa sgrub/ /da mdzes pa drug gi chang skyogs su/ /snyan brgyud dag pa'i chang yod de/ /chang de 'thungs na bde ba 'bar/ /ro de myang —na mya ngan 'da'/ /de rnal 'gyor chang gi 'thung lugs yin/ /kun la med pa'i khyad chos yin/ /de ngo mtshar spyod pa med du byung / /e ma ya mtshan mi che'am/ /zhes gsungs pas bu slob kun nges shes skyes par gyur to/ /bdud 'dul phug mo che der skyo sangs la byon pa chang glu'i skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid ras chung pa dang 'bri sgom ras pa la sogs te bu slob 'ga' dang bcas ram sdings gnam phug na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ras chung pa dang 'bri sgom ras pa gnyis nā ro mai tri'i lta sgom las 'phros pa'i bgro gleng mang du mdzad pa las/ rje btsun gyis khyed gnyis nga'i glu 'di nyon la de nas gleng mo gyis shig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /nyams dga' 'o tha snyad bral bas

skyid/ /rje drin can gyi bla ma gtsug na bzhugs/ /'bral med kyi rtogs pa rgyud la shar/ /khyod spyod khams can gyi ston sgom gnyis/ /nyer len nang nas ma 'phrod na/ /ku co byed pa nga rgyal yin/ /lar sgro 'ardogs nang nas chod pa la/ /mtha' bral gyi lta ba mi zer ram/ /lung rigs dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du che/ /rnam rtog chos skur thim pa la/ /rang byung gi sgom pa mi zer ram/ /nyams 〈snang dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du che/ /tshogs drug rang sar dag pa la/ /ro snyoms kyi spyod pa mi zer ram/ /dus tshod dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du che/ /bde stong gi nyams myong skyes pa la/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag mi zer ram/ /dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du che/ /stong nyid kyi gsal snang byed pa la/ /sa lam gyi rim pa mi zer ram/ /lam rtags dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du che/ /rang sems zad sar skyol ba la/ /tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas mi zer ram/ /sku bzhi dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du

ra༅༅/ /che/ /lung rigs dang man ngag ldan pa la/ /brgyud ldan gyi bla ma mi zer ram/ /thugs rje dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du che/ /dad ldan snying rje che ba la/ /snod ldan gyi slob ma mi zer ram/ /mos gus dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du che/ /lar sems thag lta bas gcod pa yin/ /nyams su bsgoms pas len pa yin/ /spyod pas mtha' ru 'don pa yin/ /mngon du sku bzhi byed pa yin/ /'bras bu sems su 'dod pa yin/ /thams cad gcig tu rtogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas kun gyis sgro 'dogs chod par gyur to/ /yang rje btsun gyis ras chung pa la chos snying nas byed na 'di dag dgos gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rig 'dzin bu slob tshur nyon dang / /chos nyams su len na 'di dag dgos/ /yon to thams cad bskyed pa yi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma de/ /chos sku rang du yid ches dgos/ /blo la nges shes tshud dam ras chung pa/ /zhal nas

gsungs pa'i gdams ngag de/ /dug lnga 'joms pa'i sman mchog yin/ /bdud rtsi rang du yid ches dgos/ /blo la nges shes tshud dam ras chung pa/ /bla ma'i mdzad spyod rnam thar rdzi /mngon spyod phrin las sgrub pa de/ /sprul sku rang du yid ches dgos/ /blo la nges shes tshud dam ras chung pa/ /sems mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu'i dran rtog 'di/ /skyes kyang skye med gzhi rtsa bral/ /dran pa yengs med yid ches dbordzos/ /blo la nges shes tshud dam ras chung pa/ /nyon mongs dug mtsho'i rba rlabs 'di/ ṣeng thag me yis tshig pa bzhin/ /'ching ba med par yid ches dgos/ /blo la nges shes tshud dam ras chung pa/ /'dod khams lha yi bde ba yang / /nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog bzhin// /'khor ba bde med du yid ches dgos/ /blo la nges shes tshud dam ras chung pa/ /lar 'dus byas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /mi rtag nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /'bab chu dang ni spos rgya bzhin/ /tshe 'di long

ra༅༅/ /med du yid ches dgos/ /blo la nges shes tshud dam ras chung pa/ /nges par rang gzhan thams cad 'chi/ /gcig kyang mi sdod 'chi bas na/ /'chi med sgrub la yid ches dgos/ /blo la nges shes tshud dam ras chung pa/ /zhes gsungs pas bu slob kun la nges shes lhag par skyes so/ /de nas gnya' nang gi nya ma rnams kyis ras chung pa mchodi gnas la spyan 'dren du byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis kyang zla ba phyed kyi bar bka' gnang nas song zhing ras pa gzhan rnams kyang ldom bu la song ba'i bar la mdzes se dang khu byug la sku(gas te brin pa'i yoni bdag dang nya ma 'gas mjal du 'ongs pa las/ rje btsun cha lugs lhug par bzhugs 'dug pas/ nya ma rnams kyis drung du 'grerdzo ma phode pa las mdzes ses phyin nas sku la na bza' phul nas kun drung du 'dzom pa dang / nya ma rnams kyis rje btsun lags cha lugs lhug par stoni pa 'di la/ nged 'jig rten pa rnams ngo

tshar byed pa lags pas/ sba gsang dum re mdzad na thugs rje che bar gda' zhus pas/ rje btsun gcer bur rkerkeg bzhengs te mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /nga rtag tu mo yul 'grims 'grims nas/ /rang yul ngang gis brjed de thal/ /dam pa'i rje dang 'grogs 'grogs nas/ /nye 'brel ngang gis brjed de thal/ /lha chos don du gnyer gnyer nas/ /mi chos ngang gis brjed de thal/ /gcig pur ri khrod 'grim 'grims nas/ /g.yeng ba ngang gis brjed de thal/ /spra spre'u'i yang rtsal bltas bltas nas/ /be'u lug ngang gis brjed de thal/ /me lcags snan po bcangs bcangs nas/ /khyim mtshes ngang gis brjed de thal/ /dpon med g.yog med bsdad bsdad nas/ /zhe sa ngang gis brjed de thal/ /gcig pur bag yangs byed byed nas/ /ngo tsha ngang gis brjed de thal/ /sems la gang byung byed byed nas/ /sba gsang ngang gis brjed de thal/ /lus la gtum mo sbar sbar

shel/ /skya/ /goswātshongaṭ+wāṃ ṭaṃsnatha ༵da de /ṅgig/bzlo/ rdokāsbya kli bsngimadī ༵sngudro /༵/chos/༵dze+e zlorno yi/dhi ༵snrospya tha~Xng/dezlo/ k+ṣiṃlazung wīg baṭ+wāṃms bsgatinas/ /spraswāpa n+d+rang k+ṣiṃ ༵sro la kam/rem/dzod lar ba cosamasnyag/la/byangachubare mikhye dakhyolha chos/dka/'a moragada' nga warmi pye/ /nga gzung 'anamaduḍi pa grakyi dī la/ོ/khyadayanamabye ngas ba i ma'ispyo/dpa/byed mishe sa zhes ga sungasapa 'i/mtha/ranyamarnamasakyisabastenabañcāphun/sum/ rdzo bgayadzo gāsdad sdi yan/ /nganazagadang khram sna'i byem/du/zhag relas ma bsdad rung yu naring/'go/ran sarjebatsu nagyi drung du 'o ngasapa sa gnam sgom nan 'dug sa pa byas nalosdung sprang / /shāsne 'u/zlas/ zengalhas/ re/stesprang spro/lhas/ dzo//sprang ༷ni capa/ zengakhur / spro/ tshonasprepa / sprang ///rtu/ zengasprepa

'atre(ra ba la thugs ma mnyes pa yin bsams nas zhu dbyangs 'di phul 'o(/ /dam chos gnyug ma'i ngang la gza' gtad med/ /gza' gtad byung na gnyug ma min/ /rdzogs pa chen po la phyogs ris med/ /phyogs ris byung na rdzogs chen min/ /phyag rgya chen po la dgag sgrub med/ /dgag sgrab byung na phyag chen min/ /nyams bde ba chen po la gsal 'grib med/ /gsal 'grib byung na bde chen min/ /dbu ma chen po la ngos bzung med/ /ngos bzung byung na dbu ma min/ /bdag ras chung rgyal khams bskor du 'gro/ /pha rje btsun sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /zhes zhus pas rje btsun gyis gnam sgo'i steng nas mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /sems las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas med/ /lam rtsa dang rlung las myur ba med/ /skyabs dkone mchog gsum las gnyan pa med/ /nyams bde stong gnyis las bzang ba med/ /drin dam pa rje las che ba med/ /de 'gro ba yongs kyi spyi bor

ra༅༅/ /khur/ /ma nor gdams pa nyams sulongs/ /nges shes rgyud la skyes pa yin/ /rtogs tshad rang las rnyed tsa na/ /brgyud pa'i gdamagangag thebasapa yin/ /rang gisasems ponachod tsa na/ /yid ches drod rtags 'phral la 'byung / /byams pa rgyud la skyes tsa na/ /sems can snying rjes zin pa yin/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sumathong tsa na/ khyin rlabs ngang gis 'jug pa yin/ /zung sdebs kyi tshig rkang 'ga' zung po/ /don go bas bsams na chos su yod/ /ma go 'gyur 'gugs dgrangs su gda'/ /bu ras chung sku khams bde lags sam/ /pha rgan nga bde mo'i ngang na gda'/ /zhes gsungs nas gnam sgo phye ste nang du sleb gdang / da res dag ngas ku re byas pa yin te/ lar rang da dung khyod la chos brgyad kyi snang ba chen po 'dug pas de spangs nas ri la sgom nus dgos gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje bla ma'i byin rlabs ri la zhugs/ /

gnas ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyod skal ba can gyi ras chung pa/ /sems dbang po sgrims la glu la nyon/ /dben gnas ri khrod 'dzin dus su/ /nye ba'i kha tshis ma dran cig /dran na dgra sdang gsene langs byed/ /bla ma'i drung du sgom dus su/ /tshogs gsog gi kha lan ma dran cig /dran na spyod ngan dmag dpung 'khrug /'byung po la gtor ma gtong dus su/ /gtor ril gyi gsog 'jog ma dran cig /dran na rang nyid 'byung por 'gro/ /yengs med kyi bsam gto sgom dus su/ /grogs po la mjal phrad ma byed cig /byas na mched grogs kyi dge sbyor spur/ /dka' thub kyi snying rus byed dus su/ kho chang gi zhim lto ma dran cig /dran na yi dwags kyi gnas su skye/ /snyan brgyud kyi thabs lam sgom dus su/ yes 'dod kyi slob gnyer ma dran cig /dran na log pa'i lam du 'jug /dben pa'i ri la sdod dus su/ /'gro 'dod bya ra ma dran cig /dran na yid ngan 'phral la

ra༅༅/ /ldang / /bu snying rus kyi lha chos mgo bo sto/ /sdug sgur gyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spongs/ /smon lam gyi 'brel pa'i bu slob la/ /pha yis rtogs pa skye bar shog /snang srid chos sku'i rtogs pa 'di/ /bu yi nyams la rdzogs par shog /ces gsungs pas ras chung pa'i mtshang la phog nas phyag 'tshal zhing zhu dbyangs 'di phul lo/ /pha bla ma'i bka' drin lha chos byed/ /sems 'phreng ba'i drin can pha ma bskyar/ /spong dka' ba'i pha yul rgyab tu spangs/ /grogs nye ba'i gdung sems shig da dung 'dug /'phral zas nor gos gsum gsog 'jog bzhol/ /ser sna dang sdig gsaug gi mthun rkyen med/ /dka' thub dang bcud len gyi brag la bsgoms/ /sems gsog 'jog gi snang ba zhig da dung 'dug /mjal ni grub thob dngos dang mjal/ /thob ni snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thob/ /sgom ni yengs med du gang 'grus byed/ /mjal 'dod

dang zhu 'dod cig da dung 'dug /byed ni pha yi zhabs tog byed/ /sgrub ni tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas sgrub/ /bzhugs ni ri khrod kyi gnas su bzhugs/ /bya blo dang byed blo zhig da dung 'dug /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo ngo rdo rje 'chang / /bu'i snang ba 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes zhus pas rje btsun gyis ras chung pa la zhal ta mang po gnang bas thugs skyed shin tu che bar byung ba yin no/ /de nas rje btsun yab sras gnya' nang pa rnams kyis grod phug tu spyan drangs so/ /ram sdings gnam phug ma'i skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid la gnya' nang pa'i yone bdag rnams kyis zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa bgyid cing / rje btsun grod phug na bzhugs/ ras chung pa phug pa gong ma na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'ahreto rnams kyis ras chung pa'i thugs rgyud mnal lam gyi brdas bskul te/ rje btsun la gasku1la ba btab pa'i ngor rje btsun rang gi rnam par thar pa gsungs

ra༅༅/ /so/ /de nas ras chung pa dbus su 'byon pa'i thugs 'dun drag po rang yod pa las/ nya ma 'ga' zhig yab pas kyang sras rgya gar 'khor ba khyad par du 'phags zer nya ma gzhon pa rnams ras chung pa'i drung du 'phro/ rgan pa rnams rje btsun gyi drung du 'gro ba las/ dus nam zhig gi tshe rje btsun yab sras kyi drung du nya ma rnams bsnyen bkur 'bul du byung ba las/ ras chung pa la bsnyen bkur bzang po byas/ rje btsun la bsnyen bkur cung zad las ma byung ba'i tshe/ ras chung pa'i thugs dgongs la/ nga la 'di tsam yong lugs kyis/ rje btsun la 'di bas kyang bzang ba byung yod bsams/ rje btsun gyi drung du phyin te rje btsun lags de ring bsnyen bkur bzang po byung lags sam/ 'o skol dpon slob kyi bsnyen bkur gyi thog nas ras pa rnams la'ang tshogs 'bor zhig gnang ba drag lags sam zhus pas/ de byed nga'i skal ba g.yam pa'i 'og na yod pas longs shog

gsungs blangs pas/ sha rid gzug gcig chang skyar ku ba gang / rtsam pa thun tsam rnams 'dug pas/ ras chung pa rang gi gzim phug tu byone te thugs bsams la/ nya ma 'di rnams kyis byed lugs sam/ bla ma sangs rgyarme lta bu 'di'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig kyang ngas mi do rung bsnyen bkur log par byas 'ong gi 'dug sngar yin na bla ma'i drung du bsdad/ gdams ngag kun rdzogs pa dang zhabs tog snying tshim pa zhig byed bsam pa yin te/ da bsdad yun ring natshubla ma'i zhabs tog tu mi 'gro zhabs 'dren du 'gro ba 'dug pas/ zhu ba 'bul du 'grerdzo snyam snga mosnar bzhengs nas byone pas/ rje btsun dbu phur nas gzims 'dug /mes 〉rdzom ras pa yang mal na 'dug pa las/ ras chung pa'i thugs dgongs la/ nga'i bla ma 'di rang don du chos sku mngon du gyur kyang / gzhan ngor bya cha chos spyod 'dra yang mdzad na bsam pa/ rje btsun gyis mkhyen te spyod lam rnam bzhi'i mgur

ra༅༅/ /'di gsungs so/ /bu nyon dang gson dang ras chung pa/ /pha rgan mi la ras pa ngas/ /res 'ga' nyal zhing nyal zhing sgom/ /nyal zhing nyal zhime sgom tsa na/ /gti mug 'od gsal du 'char ba'i gdams pa yodi/ /mi nga la yod de gzhan la med/ /kun kyang 'di ltar yod na dga' ba la/ /pha rgan mi la ras pa ngas res 'ga' za zhing za zhing sgom/ /za zhing za zhing sgom tsa na/ /bza' btung tshogs 'khor du shes pa'i gdams ngag yod/ /mi nga la yod de kun la med/ /kun kyang 'di ltar yod na dga' ba la/ /pha rgan mi la ras pa ngas/ /res 'ga' 'gro zhing 'gro zhing sgom/ /'gro zhing 'gro zhing sgom tsa na/ /'gro 'dug bskor bar shes pa'i gdams ngag yod/ /mi nga la yod de gzhan la med/ /kun kyang 'di ltar yod na dga' ba la/ /pha rgan mi la ras pa ngas/ /res 'ga' spyod cing spyod cing sgom/ /spyod cing spyod cing sgom tsa na/ /spyod lam

chos nyid du grol ba'i gdams ngag yod/ /mi nga la yod de kun la med/ /kun kyang 'di ltar yod na dga' ba la/ /bu ras chung yang de ltar nyams su longs/ /mes sgom yang 'ordzongs la skyo tsha bskol/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas dbus phyogs la 'gro ba'i zhu ba rgyu mtshan dang bcas mang du phul ba'i mthar yang mgur 'di phul lo/ /bdag rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim pa dang / /chos 'khor lha sa bsterdzor ba dang / /jo shwaka zhal gnyis mjal ba dang / /dpal gyi bsam yas blta ba dang / /gaskurdzo ru khra 'grug bskerdzor ba dang / /mar rngog gdan sa mjal ba dang / /gnyal dang lo ro lta ba dang / /ro snyoms ldom bu byed pa la/ /cis kyang dbus su 'gro bar zhu/ /zhus pas rje btsun gyi zhal nas bu khyod kyi gdul bya dbus na yod kyang 'gro ba'i dus la ma bab pas bla ma'i bka' ma bcag par nga'i glu 'di nyon cig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /thabs mchog gsang

ra༅༅/ /sngags rigs las 'khrungs/ /dga' bzhi rnam dag sku bzhi'i rje/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /skyes mchog mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dgung de ring bkra shis yar gyi ngo / /dus khyad par can gyi tshes brgyad la/ /nga rnal 'gror gyi shes pa bde bde po/ /me shel gyi nyi ma 'od zer tsha/ /dmag brgya yi nang nas dar mdung can/ /bu ras chung zer ba'i bzhin legs po/ /tshig de skad gong du mi smra bar/ /khyod da lta dran nam snga nas bsams/ /da ma yengs rna ba'i dbang po dang / /thugasakyime long g.ya' phyis la/ /mi gon glu 'di lhan ne gsoni/ /dben gnas ri khrod 'grim dus su/ /rgyal khams 'grims pas ci la phan/ /bla ma sangasargyas sgom dus su/ /lha sa bskor bas ci la phan/ /ltad mo sems la blta dus su/ /bsam yas ltad mos ci la phan/ /sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod dus su/ /mar rngog gdan sas ci la

phan/ /snyan brgyud gdams ngag 〉snam dus su/ /gnyal dang 'o( ros ci la phan/ /rang sems gtan la 'bebs dus su/ /khra 'drug bskor bas ci la phan/ /zhes gsungs pas yang ras chung pas zhu ba nan gyis phul bas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /gangs stod kyi seng ge dkar mo khyod/ /rong du ma 'bab gangs stod zungs/ /brgya la rong du babs pa na / /g.yu ral nyams kyis ma dogs sam/ /g.yu ral ngom zhing gangs stod zungs/ /da res bla ma'i bka' la nyon/ /brag stod kyi bya rgyal rgod po khyod/ sa(da du ma 'bab brag stod zungs/ /brgya la shod du babs pa na/ /gzhog sgro nyams kyis ma dogs sam/ /gzhog sgro ngom zhing brag stod zungs/ /da res bla ma'i bka' la nyon/ /nags stod kyi stag gu ri bkra khyod/ /sa mthar ma 'bab nags stod zungs/ /brgya la sa mthar babs pa na/ /gra 'dzum nyams kyis ma dogs sam/ /gra 'dzum ngom zhing nags stod zungs/ /da

༄༅/ 'i ོ /resablamaldi bkā' la sto'i/ /sbya dz+nyād kyi nya mo gser sdig khyod/'i/mtsho maskya ma bskor mtsho sa〉 zungakyi/ /brgya dzo tsho mtha' bskor ba na/'a/doX sbya wīms kyas ma dgas sam/ /gasdur mag ngam zhang ma ༷༅pa zuṭīs/'i/da rasan+d+ra ma' bka' la nyan/ོ/gung zi gā rasdu chuzo ra gragaswā khyad/sdu/sa khamaX sa 'graswā ra khrad zungs/ /brgya la rgyal khams 'gāms pa na/ /nyamaswā rtags 'gragus kyasdu ma ༄gas sazi/ /nyaXg rtags skyang zhang ra la sdud/n+d+ra/ ras bla ma' bka' la2na/ /snas gsungs ṭīs/sna chung pas nga sdi ma~X drung du bsngi yun rang na zhabs /gā / sna sna zhabaX ༷dran du 'gra ba kyidaX gas/snramakyi rtags ngam du rgya~X khamakyi la 'gra b.rā zhu sa dbyangs 'ad phul la/ /pha bla ma rja ban snyan gsan dang / /gangs stad kya nga dkar ma nga / /gangs stad yangs la ma 'phya ru/ /g.yu ral gas pa rgyas dus da/ /

ras chung mi sdod dbus la 'gro/ /da res blama'i bka' gnang zhu/ khragastodirdzokyi bya rgyal rgod pong / / /nam wo nga mthoni pomigacod du/ /gsho ga drugalegs po rgyas duyomed/ /ras chung mi sdod dbus la 'gro/ /da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu/ /nags gsegakyi stag gu ri bkra nga / tags khrod’yongs la mi 'phyo ru/ /gratsa'adzum legs po rgyas dus med/ /ras chung mi sdod dbus su 'gro/ /da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu/ /mtsho dkyisagyi nya mo gsere mig nga / /mtsho mtha' yongs la mi rgyu ru/ /gser mig legs po rgyas dus med/ /ras chung mi sdod dbus su 'gro/ /da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu/ /gung thang ras chung rdor grags nga / /rgyal khams yongs la mi 'gro ru/ /khos rtogs bzang po rgyas dus med/ /ras chung mi sdod dbus su 'gro/ /da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu/ /zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis ras chung pa nyams dang rtogs pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bla

ras chung mi sdod dbus la 'gro/ /da res blama'i bka' gnang zhu/ khragastodirdzokyi bya rgyal rgod pong / / /nam wo nga mthoni pomigacod du/ /gsho ga drugalegs po rgyas duyomed/ /ras chung mi sdod dbus la 'gro/ /da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu/ /nags gsegakyi stag gu ri bkra nga / tags khrod’yongs la mi 'phyo ru/ /gratsa'adzum legs po rgyas dus med/ /ras chung mi sdod dbus su 'gro/ /da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu/ /mtsho dkyisagyi nya mo gsere mig nga / /mtsho mtha' yongs la mi rgyu ru/ /gser mig legs po rgyas dus med/ /ras chung mi sdod dbus su 'gro/ /da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu/ /gung thang ras chung rdor grags nga / /rgyal khams yongs la mi 'gro ru/ /khos rtogs bzang po rgyas dus med/ /ras chung mi sdod dbus su 'gro/ /da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu/ /zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis ras chung pa nyams dang rtogs pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bla

ra༅༅/ /ma'i drung nas ma 'phags shig ces mgur 'di gsungs so/ /chos thos bsam rgyud la sbyangs pa yi/ /ras chung rdo rje grags pa khyod/ /mi kho bo'i tshig 'di go bar gyis/ /khyod chos 'dod kyi dad pa ma skyes par/ /za 'dod kyi ldom bu ma byed cig /gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i/ /lta ba'i kha khyer ma mtho zhig /nang rig pa'i rtsal sbyong ma byas par/ /gti mug gi blun sgom ma byed cig /gdams ngag gi 'tsho skyong mi shes par/ /yig nag gi phag chod ma byed cig /chos zab mo'i ston lugs mi shes par/ /thos chung gi mgo bo ma bskor rtseg /bsod nams kyi spel lugs mi shes par/ /mi nor la hab sha ma byed cig /zhen pa nang nas ma log par/ /dad rdzas la yog zas ma byed cig /bag chags kyi snapargya ma dag par/ /'ol tshod kyi mngon shes ma 'chad cig /bla med mngon du ma gyur par/ /yon bdag gi mchod gnas ma byed

jug /dge sbyor gyi tshi ga rgya mi thub par/ ci/blama'i drung nalom 'phagasashig r+sha /bu ras chung mi 'gro da res sdod/ /ces gsungs kyang / zhu ba nan gyis phul bas/ khyo da de tsam du nga la mi nyan par cis kyang 'gro na/ ngas yon bdag rnams lā khyod dbus su: gtong ba'imona' skyel yod de/ mna' kurna rmi lagasgra ma yin palobaka' gnang bas chog da 'gro grabs gyis shig gsungs pas/ ras chung pa dga' che la‘ ngu bro ba zhig byung ste zhag 'ga' dbu sngas sprad nas snyan brgyud kyi gdamasarjag rnams zhus/ dpe cha la yang bris nas 'byon pa'i tshe chas gzhan ni byed rgyu med/ na bza' ras rkyang de gsol/ gra ba zur gsum dang ba men gyi a ru de rgyab tu bshal/ ༄ snyan brgyud kyi be'u bum mchan khung du bcangs nas rje btsun gyi drung du byin rlabs zhur phyin pas/ rje btsun gyi thugs la ras chung pa 'didang yun ring du 'grogs pa yin cing / da e phrad rkyong mi shes bsam skyel thung la byon nas la

ra༅༅/ /khar phebs pa dang / rje btsun gyi zhal nas da khyod 'gro lugs ji ltar 'gro gsungs pas/ 'gro lugs 'di dgrangs su phul lo/ /nga dam chos lta —ba dper bzhag nas/ /snang stong zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro/ /rtag chad chams la 'bebs shing 'gro/ /'gyur med lam du slong zhing 'gro/ /lta ba zhan yang nga mi 'gyod/ /dam chos sgom pastodaper bzhag nas/ /bde gsal zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro/ /bying rgod chams la 'bebs shing 'gro/ /'od gsal lam du slong zhing 'gyo/ /sgom pa zhan yang nga mi 'grod/ /dam chos spyod pa dper bzhag nas/ /brtul zhugs zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro/ /tho cho chams la 'bebs shing 'gro/ /zhen med lam du slong zhing 'gro/ /spyod pa zhan yang nga mi 'grod/ /dam chos dam tshig dper bzhag nas/ /rnam dag zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro/ /g.yo sgyu chams la 'bebs shing 'gro/ /zol med lam du slong zhing 'gro/ /dam tshig

zhan yang nga mi 'gyod/ /dam chos 'bras bu dper bzhag nas/ /lhun grub zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro/ /re dogs chams la 'bebs shi nga 'gro/ /skuwāzhi lam du slong zhing 'gro/ /'bras bu zhan yang nga mi 'grod/ /rje btsun mar pa dper bzhag nas/ /snyan brgyud zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro/ /tha snyad chams la 'bebs shing 'gro/ /gdams ngag lam du slong zhing 'gro/ /chos lam khyer zhan yang nga mi 'gyod/ /bla ma mi la dper bzhag nas/ ci /snying rus zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro/ /le lo chams la 'bebs shing 'gro/ /brtson 'grus lam du slong zhing 'gro/ /brtson 'grus zhan yang nga mi 'grod/ /nga rang ras chung dper bzhag nas/ ri/skalpoldan zur kha 'a grim zhing 'gro/ /log rtog chams la 'bebs shing 'gro/ /mos gus lam du slong zhing 'gro/ /gsol 'debs zha na yang nga mi 'grod/ ṣes zhus pas/ 'gro lugs legs byung / lar rang bu ma'i rtsar bsdad na skyid che/ sgo nga

ra༅༅/ /ma'i drod la btsos na rdol sla/ sgom chen bla ma'i drung na gol sa med pa yin te/ mi nyan par 'gro bar 'dug pas ngas khyod brtse bas mi 'dor/ khyod rang yang gsol ba rgyun du thob cig gsungs pas/ ras chung pas spyan chab bamil zhing bdag rje btsun la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes rgyun chad med pa yodi cing / sngar yang re sa rje btsun las med/ da dung sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du re sa rje btsun las med pas/ 'di phyi bar do kun gyi skyabs dang skyel ma zhu zhes zhu don 'di dgrangs su phul lo//bla ma sangs rgyas kyi datre ngas pa thugs rje che/ /bdag ras chung pa la skyel ma mdzod/ /nga lta ba'i la la 'grerdzo bsam pas/ /rtag chad skungs sa mang ba dang / /phyogs ris jag pa rgod pa dang / /gzung 'dzin la stongs che ba yis/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i la la ma phyin bar/ /bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che/ /'jigs sa sgrol cig sprul pa'i sku/ /sgom

pa'i la la 'gro bsam pas/ /bying sgode skung sa mang ba dang / /dmigs gtad sa 'phrang dam pa dang / /rnam rtog mgo lo rgod pa yis/ /skye med spros bral thang la ma phyin bar/ /bu la skyelam mdzod cig rin po che/ /'a jigs losgrol cig sprul pa'i sku/ /spyod pa'i 'phrang la 'gro bsam pas/ /zhen pa 'grogs yun ring pa dang / /tshul 'a chos sa 'phrang dog pa dang / /tho co'i jag pa rgod pa yis/ khugs 'byung zhen med 'phrang wom phyin bar/ /bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che/ /'jigs pa sgrol cig sprul pa'i sku/ /dam tshig sa mkhar brtsigs bsam pas/ /thos pa'i go rgya chung ba dang / /gnyen po'i zhol khyim dma' ba dang / /ngo lkog bri sgrogs che ba yis/ /skye med dag pa'i 'obs kyis ma 'khor bar/ /bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che/ /'jigs pa sgrol cig sprul pa'i sku/ /'bras bu'i tshod cig len bsam pas/ /'khor 'das bzhul thag ring ba dang / /myang 'das

ra༅༅/ /sa 'phrang dam pa dang / /re dogs jag pa thod pa ste/ /sku bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi khyim du ma phyin bar/ /bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che/ /'jigs —pa sgrol cig sprul pa'i sku/ /ras chung rgyal khams 'grim bsam pas/ /lha lus skyid 'dod che ba dang / /bod du dad gzhi chung ba dang / /khram pa'i jag pa rbede pa yis/ /bu pha yi drung du ma phyin par/ /bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin ngo che/ /'jigs pa sgrol cig sprul pa'i sku/ /zhes zhus pas rje btsun gyis khyod 'gro ba la skyel ma bkra shis gsol ba yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /nga yi brgyud pa gang yin zer tsa na/ /brgyud pa mi ngan brgyud pa bzang / /brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen yin/ /brgyud pa bzang po de yi bkra shis 3(ga /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis 3(ga /bla ma gang yin zer tsa na/ /bla ma mi ngan bla ma bzang / /bla ma mar rngog rnam gnyis yin/ /bla ma bzang po de yi bkra shis 31ga /

bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /dam chos gang yin zer tsa na/ /dam chos: ngan dam chos bzang / /dam chos phyag rgya chen po yin/ /dam chos bzang po de yi bkrashi sa shog / bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /yi dam gang yin zer tsa na/ /yi dam mi ngan yi da ma bzang / /yi dam rdo rje phag mo yin/ /yi dam bzang po de yi bkra shis sho ga /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /choloskyong gang yin zer tsa na/ /chos skyong mi ngan chos skyong bzang / /chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral yin/ /chos skyong bzang po de yitsabakra shis shog /bu ras chung pal bkra shis 3(ga /lta ga〉(ma pa spyod pa gsum/ /bu ras chung pa labakrashis 〈 snag /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum/ /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis 3(ga /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum/ /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis cerdzog /bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum/ /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis cesag /sangs rgyas bden la chos kyang

ra༅༅/ /bden/ /de bzhin dge 'dun bden pa yis/ /bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog /nga rang gang yin zer tsa na/ /nga rang mi la ras pa yin—/——da/mi la'i bkra shis bu la 31ga /bu pha bas lhag pa'i bkra shis sgo(ga /ces gsungs shing gzhan yang zhal gdams la/ khyod la dbus su khyi mo shig gis rkang pa nas 'ju ba 'dug pas/ de dus bla ma dang nyams len ma brjed par gyis gsung / /rje btsun der bzhugs pa la/ ras chung pas phyag dang bskor ba byas song bas/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la kho nga la phyi mig cig bltar 'ong de bar ma bsdad na kho mi dga' bsam/ dar cig la thog der bzhugs pas ras chung pas phyi mig mi blta bar song ba dang / rje btsun gyi thugs la kho rtsi mig gcig kyang mi blta bar 'gro lugs kyis bla ma dang mched grogs la log lta skyes pa yin nam/ chos dang brgyud pa rnams gsang zhing 'gro ba'i rigs yin dgongs nas/ rlung

thun cig bzung sngone la byon te/ brage senge ge'agying ba 'dra ba zhig gi mdun du ras pa bdun du sprul te/ ras chung pa'i nyams sad phyir mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /khyod lam byon ras pa tshur nyon dang / /khyod rang su yin blamo gang / /mes po su yin yang mes gang / /brgyud pa su yin gdams ngag gang / /sgom r+pāgang yin dgon pagang / /ri'adi ji skad brag 'di gang / /'gro ba gang gi phyogs su 'gro/ /songs shig su yi zhal nas gsungs/ /gar 'gro su yin zer zhing 'gro/ /khyod 'gro ba'i 'gro lugs ji ltar 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa'i thugs dgongs la/ gzhan nga'i sngon du de skad zer ba'i ras pa mi 'ong / rje btsun gyi sprul par 'dug snyam ste/ phyag phul nas 'gro lugs mgur du phulab/ pha rje btsun chen po snyan gson dang / /mi khyod rang su yin zer tsa na/ /nga rang gung thang ras chung yin/ /bla ma mi la ras pa

ra༅༅/ /yin/ /mes po mar rngog rnam gnyis yin/ /yang mes tai lo nā ro yin/ /gdams ngag mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud yin/ /brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang narme —yin/ /sgom pa la phyi gangs rwa yin/ /ri 'di pi ling zur kha yin/ /brag 'di seng chen 'gyings pa yin/ /'gro ba dbus kyi phyogs su 'gro/ /songs shig bla ma rje btsun gsung / /bdag de ltar 'gro bas 'gro chos zhu/ /zhes zhus pas sprul pa rnams sku dngos la 'dus te/ ngas khyod phyi mig gcig kyang mi blta bar serdzong bas nyams sad du 'ongs pa yin te/ dam tshig la skyoni mi 'dug da nga dang khyod dam tshig gtsang bas 'du 'bral med pas dbus su songs shig gsungs pa la ras chung pa spro bzhin rje btsun gyi zhabs spyi bor blangs nas snroni lam mang du btab nas dbus phyogs la byoni no/ /de nas rje btsun gyis grerdzod phug tu phebs pas nya ma rnams sngar ltar bsten bkur khur nas byung ba la/ ras chung pa

med par shes nas ras chung pa la 'bul rgyu rnams brag phug 'ur ding du sbas te/ rje btsun gyi drung du phyin pas rje btsun bla ye na bzhugs 'dug pa la/ nya ma rnams kyis rje btsun lags sngar snga bar mi bzhengs pa la/ da lan snga bar bzhengs pa ci lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas nga ras chung pa dbus su 'grerdzo ba la skyel thung la phyin pa yin te/ yar bslebs pas shes pa skyo ba snyam byung 'dir bsdad pa yin gsungs pas/ khong rnams na re/ ras chung pa dbus su 'byone pa la/ rje btsun gyis bshol ma btab pa lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis ngas dag kho la bzhol 'di ltar btab ces mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bu gces pa'i ras chung dbus su thal/ /kho rang gi ched la ma bab na/ /gzhan gyi kha la kho mi nyan/ /kho mar rngog gdan sa lta'o skad/ /gnyal dang lo ro lta'o zer/ /darnga/la gyi bsam yas lta'o zer/ /chos 'khor lha sa lta'o skad/ /ngas dag kho la 'di skad

ra༅༅/ /byas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bsten dus su/ /jo bo shākyas ci la phan/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grims dus su/ /mar rngog gdan sas ci la phan/ /snyan brgyud gdams ngag nyan dus su/ /gnyal dang lo ros ci la phan/ /ltad mo sems la lta dus su/ /bsam yas ltad mos ci la phan/ /sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod dus su/ /rlos 'khor lha sas ci laphan/ /ngas dag kho la de skad byas/ /lar gces par bskyangs pa'i ras chung khong / /nyi ma dbus kyi phyogs su thal/ /khyed nya ma sbo yong na 'byil tsam du gda' ste/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khong rnams na re/ bla ma sku na bgres dus 'dir nye gnas gal che ba yin pa la/ bshol de tsam btab kyang mi nyan par 'gro ba khong khrel re chung zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi gsungs nas ras chung pa la khrel ngo tsha dam tshig mi 'dug gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /pha mas gserdzos pa'i brtes phrug bu tshas kyang / /pha

ma ses khar phan pa brgya la 'ga'/ /dam tshig med pa'i slobe mas kyang / /slobe dponi gog khar phan pa brgya la 'ga'/ /pha khyi rgan dang 'dra ba shul du bor/ /bu dar seng dkar mo dang 'dra ba dbus su thal/ /pha rgan wa skya dang 'dra ba shul du bor/ /bu stag chung ri bkra dang 'dra ba dbus su thal/ /pha khyim bya de pho dang 'dra ba shul du bor/ /bu bya rgyal rgod po dang 'dra ba dbus su thal/ /pha cong rong bong bu dang 'dra ba shul du bor/ /bu 'do chen rta pho dang 'dra ba dbus su thal/ /pha glang rgan bre bo dang 'dra ba shul du bor/ /bu 'brong chung rwa sngon dang 'dra ba dbus su thal/ /sku gzugs lha sku bas legs pa de dbus su thal/ /ngag rgya dar bas 'jam pa de dbus su thal/ /gsung dril bu bas snyan pa de dbus su thal/ /thugs dgongs za 'og bas bkra ba de dbus su thal/ /dri tsan+dan bas zhim pa de dbus su thal/ /zhes gsungs pas khong rnams na re/ de tsam du thugs brtse ba la grogs

༄4nyi/dad ོ /rngotram̐ng ba ji ltaX ༷da/thaX nga du 'gro ba la 'o mi badzo skya ṣ+kags lags dzo zer ba la/spyo tsun gyis rdzong ba 'aṭ+wāṃ ltar byas tsonga~X /sa zigur 'aX sazhas sa/ /kha gragasardzu zaḍi pa zhag dang 'gragaswā nas thalashe/sa/gzhaspya gya grags la 'du 'braswā yad/ /ras chung sdigs la 'du 'bral da/ /rang byungame sa tsosna mkho ḍing /ོ/bu ras chung pa kha 'gazi nas thal/ /rdzuskyaX /galazhayisathal/ /gzhan gya ṣ+ṭṛ ldu gam stiskyatsho nga / /rasachuspralagamaswāgs da/ /༷rāsarludā ga rta lhas/ri/bu ras chung pa kha nywa nakyi thal//kha gas dran pa gatshu nga gan nas byāl/ /gzhan gya gaX la grang dra ༵da/ /rasbya chung gas la grang dra da/'i/ga.a ma 'bar gya ras sa da/ /bu ras chung pa yas rgyun nas thal/ /zas bzang pa zhag kyang za zhang thal/ /gzhan ma' zas la zham mngar yad/ /ras chung zas la zham mngar

med/ /ting 'dzin ro mchog bzang po de/ /bu ras chung pa khong za zhing thal/ /nor bzang po zhig kyang khyer nas thal/ /gzhan gyi nor la dgra rkun yod/ /ras chung nor la dgra rkun med/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu dang / /bu ras chung 'aX(gas nas dbus su thal/ /zhes gsungs te/ cung zad thugs skyorto ba'i rnam pa ltar mdzad nas bzhugs pas/ nya ma rnams khong rang la sems las med pa ltar byas nas/ rje btsun la thugs las mi mdzad 'tshal/ da dung ras pa zhi ba 'od dang se ban ras pa serdzogs grod phug na phyag phyi ba mang po rang skusnad pa lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas ras pa mang ste ras chung pa 'dra ba nyung / nya ma mang ste dad pa can nyung gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes serdzo/ /gung thang gi gto chung ras pa dang / /gcen lung gi ngan rdzong bde ba skyong / /mdo bkra'i se ban bkra shis 'bar/ /stag mo'i 'bri sgom gling kha ba/ /khong snying dang 'dra ba'i bu bzhi yin/ /

ra༅༅/ /lar chung 'grogs sems kyi tsher ma yin/ /ras chung song bas dran pa 'phyo/ /tshig tha snyad kyis brtags pa'i lta ba de/ /ming lta ba byas kyang kha lta yin/ /gzung 'dzin g.yeng ba spong ba 'am/ /sems rtse gcig tu rtogs pa'i mi re nyung / /blo layar skyed med pa'i sgom pa de/ /ming sgom pa byas kyang zhi gnas yin/ /zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba 'am/ /sems gnad du bsnun pa'i mi re nyung / /khyo nyin srib byed pa'i spyod pa de/ /ming spyod pa byas kyang 'brel ba yin/ /chos brgyad zil gyis non pa'am/ /chos mtha' ru thon pa'i mi re nyung / /ngo lkog dang bcos ma'i dam tshig de/ /ming dam tshig byas kyang zog po yin/ /khas blangs dam bca' ma nyams pa'am/ /rang sems dpang por 'jog pa'i mi re nyung / /'dod pas gdungs pa'i 'bras bu de/ /ming 'bras bu byas kyang mgo skor yin/ /chos nyid rdo rus thug pa 'am/ /lam sna zin pa'i mi re nyung / /

shog logs gdams ngag zab mo de/ /zab zab 'dra yang zin bris yin/ /gang zag snying rus chung pa 'am/ /chos brgyud par ldan pa'i mi re nyung / /tshe 'dis bcings pa'i slob dpon de/ /ming slob dpon byas kyang brel snen yin/ /gang zag tsho mos gus chung ba'am/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten ṣ+pe'i mi re nyung / /mig zim byed pa'i mos gus de/ /ming mos gus zer yang dar cig yin/ /las ngan ltag tshan ches pa'am/ /stos med gsum ldan gyi mi re nyung / /grong ltag gi dgoni chung khra mo de/ /ming dgon pa byas kyang grong yul yin/ /gang zag tsho g.yeng ba ches pa'am/ /gnas ri khrod 'grims pa'i mi re nyung / /bka' gdam gyi btsun chung srang rdo mabordzo/ /ming btsun chung byas kyang lus bsgrur yin/ /gang zag tsho snying rus chung ba 'am/ /'dul khrims sna re srung ba'i mi re nyung / /gnya' nang gi nya ma mchor mgo ma/ /ming yon bdag byas kyang 'dod bslu yin/ /budo med tsho snying

ra༅༅/ /rtsal chung ba'am/ /bsnyen bkur sbyin gtong byed pa'i mi re nyung / /spyir mgo nag gi dad pa kha la yod/ /khyed nya ma tsho'i dad pa 'doms na yod/ /nga rnal 'gror gyi dad pa snying la yod/ /pha bong gros pa dreg pa chags/ /gtsang chab rgas pa gnyer ma mang / /ljon shing rgas pa skra lo zags/ /ri khrod rgas pa chu shing zad/ /rnal 'gror rgas pa nyams rtogs 'gribs/ /nya ma rgas pa dad pa yal/ /nya ma me bya dang 'dra ba mdongs zol skyong / /nya ma ne tso dang 'dra ba long gtam spel/ /nya ma ba rgan dang 'dra ba be'u lug skyong / /khyed nya ma tsho 'gro na 'gro re ran/ /ngan pas mi tshad 'phyes 'phyes tsam/ /ma gi brag phug 'ur ding na/ /phye rkyal tsho byi bas 'brad cing 'dug /mar gong tsho rbab tu 'gril nas thal/ /chang ku tsho wa mos sgyel zhing 'dug kho khog tsho bya rog gi 'thog cing 'dug /'gro na mgyogs par phyin pa drag /khyed nya ma tsho skyid do bde bar song / /zhal

myur du mjal ba'i spyod lam 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pas nya ma rnam/sa phan tshun mig 'gros shig shig gru mo sug sug kha skyengs pa'i tshul dang bcas serdzong bas/ rje btsun gyis gsungs pa ltar 'dug pas/ kherdzong rnams dad pa dang 'dresad pa drag po skyes nas/ lhag ma rnams rje btsun la phul te/ bdag cag rnams la mirtag pa rgyud la skyeba'i mgur ma zhig zhu zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyis bsnyen bkur ma bzhes par mgur 'di gsungs so/ /nyon dang gsod dang nya ma ser sna can/ /gtam snyan grags 'dod pa'i tshogs gsog dang / /tshe 'di'i 'jigs skyebo kyi skyabs gnas dang / /lan la re ba 'dod pa'i sbyin pa dang / /ngas byas rang 'dod kyi 'bul ba bzhi / /de la nam phugs yod pa min/ /kha za 'dod tshogs 'khor shoms khyer dang / /chos mkhas 'dod rang babyo'i pho rgod dang / /sems g.yeng 'dod glu dgrangs tho cho dang / /rang che 'dod dbang bskur ngo srung bzhi/ /'di

myur du mjal ba'i spyod lam 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pas nya ma rnam/sa phan tshun mig 'gros shig shig gru mo sug sug kha skyengs pa'i tshul dang bcas serdzong bas/ rje btsun gyis gsungs pa ltar 'dug pas/ kherdzong rnams dad pa dang 'dresad pa drag po skyes nas/ lhag ma rnams rje btsun la phul te/ bdag cag rnams la mirtag pa rgyud la skyeba'i mgur ma zhig zhu zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyis bsnyen bkur ma bzhes par mgur 'di gsungs so/ /nyon dang gsod dang nya ma ser sna can/ /gtam snyan grags 'dod pa'i tshogs gsog dang / /tshe 'di'i 'jigs skyebo kyi skyabs gnas dang / /lan la re ba 'dod pa'i sbyin pa dang / /ngas byas rang 'dod kyi 'bul ba bzhi / /de la nam phugs yod pa min/ /kha za 'dod tshogs 'khor shoms khyer dang / /chos mkhas 'dod rang babyo'i pho rgod dang / /sems g.yeng 'dod glu dgrangs tho cho dang / /rang che 'dod dbang bskur ngo srung bzhi/ /'di

ra༅༅/ /bzhi yis byin rlabs 'jug pa min/ /chos bshad 'dod yi ge lung med sgrub/ /nga rgyal 'dod phyag dang zhe sa la dga'/ /snod mi rtag blun po'i mgo bo skor/ /nor tshol ba'i zong chos la byed pa bzhi/ /'di bzhi yis 'gro don 'grub pa min/ /gcig pur mi zug yengs la dga'/ /sdug sgur mi nus skyid la mnyes/ /sgom du bcug na bshad pa 'dod/ /che thabs 'jig rten las dang bzhi/ /'di bzhis thar pa thob pa min/ /bzhi bzhi bzhi ru bsdebs pa'i dgrangs/ /nya ma'i thugs dam de la mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas 'bri sgom ras pas zhu ngo byas bsnyen bkur bzhes pa'i tshe/ da dung chos re gsung bar zhu zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so/ /ya gi tshe ring drang srong de/ /gang shar gyi ngo bo mi shes pa/ /thol skyes rig pa dgra bor 'dzin/ /snyoms 'jug dran med sgom du 'dod/ /ma gi yi dwags bse ru ba/ /rang sems bse bar mi

shekho pas/ /gzhan la phrag dog ser sna byed/ /las ngan dbang gis bkres skom spyod/ /bar 'dzam gling mi dbul sdug 'khun can/ /sa 'og gi gser sbram mi shes par/ /yul mi grogs la rkun rdzun byed/ /rdzun zol zog mang zhing je sdag 'gro/ /gnya' nang nya ma spral sprul can/ /rje btsun la tshogs gsog mi 'dod pas/ /tshogs gsog mchor po'i ras pa la byed/ /ras pa la phul zhing skyengs su song / /da 'dre mo'i spral sprul ma mang bar/ /lha mo'i tshogs gsog lha la phul/ /zhes gsungs pas kun dad pa skyes nas phyag mang du 'tshal zhing mchi ma phyung ste/ da gnas 'dir rje btsun rtag tu bzhugs par zhu/ chos dang mthun pa'i bsnyen bkur zhabs tog 'bul zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga 'dir yun ring mi sdod par 'gro/ khyed nya ma rnams tshe srog la bar chad med par byas/ bkra shis chos mthun du mjal ba'i smone lam 'debs so gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes

ra༅༅/ /so/ /mtho la yangs pa'i dgung sngon dang gcig /de la 'khor ba'i nyi zla zung gcig dang gnyis/ /dus tshod gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yad yud du gda'/ /dgung sngon khyed sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /nyi zla nged gling bzhi bskor du 'gro/ kho| mas kyang ku re zhus pa lags/ /dgung sngon khyod sprin gyis ma bsgribs pa byos/ /nyi zla nged gza' yis ma gzung ba bgyis te/ /zhal yang yang du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /bkra shis chos mthun du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /mtho la yangs pa'i brag stod dang gcig /de la 'khor ba'i bya rgyal rgod po dang gnyis/ /dus tshod gnas skabs kyi 'brel pa yad yud du gda'/ /brag stod khyed sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /bya rgyal nged nam 'phang gcod du 'gro/ sa mas kyang ku re zhus pa lags/ /brag stod khyed thog gis ma bzhig pa byos/ /bya rgyal nged thag rnyis ma bzung ba byas nas/ /zhal yang

yang du mjal ba'i smone lam 'debs/ /bkra shis chos mthun du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /ma gi gtsang chab gzhung ring dang gcig /de la 'khor ba'i nya mo gser mig dang gnyis/ /dus sbod gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yad yud du gda'/ /gtsang chab khyed sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /nya mo nged gaṅgā'i chab la 'gro/ skyo mas kyang ku re zhus pa lags/ /gtsang chab khyed yul du ma drangs pa byos/ /nya mosna nged dol la ma 'thums pa byas nas/ /zhal yang yang du mjal ba'i smine lam 'debs/ /bkra shis chos mthun du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /ldum ra nang gi me tog ha lo de dang gcig /de la 'khor ba'i bung ba stag sa/zig dang gnyis/ /dus tshod gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yad yud du gda'/ /me tog khyed sku khams ci bder bzhus/sa/ /bung ba nged gaṅgā'i me tog bskor/ ༷rdo mas kyang kure zhus pa lags/ /me tog khyed sad kyis ma khyer ba byos/ /bung ba nged

ra༅༅/ /rdzi yis ma bskyod pa byas nas/ /zhal yang yang du mjal ba'i smoni lam 'debs/ /bkra shis chos mthun du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /yul gnya' nang gi nya ma dad 'dus dang gcig /de la 'khor ba'i rnal 'gror mi la dang gnyis/ /dus tshod gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yad yud du gda'/ /nya ma khyed sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /rnal 'gror nga gnyan sa'i ri la 'gro/ ba/ rte mas kyang ku re zhus pa lags/ /khyed nya ma tsho 'das grongs med pa phyos/ /rnal 'gyor nga nyams rtogs 'phel bar byas te/ /zhal yang yang du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /bkra shis chos mthun du mjal ba'i spyod lam 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas nya ma rnams kyi nang nas rje btsun gyi phyi bzhin 'brang ba yang 'ag/'a byung zhing gzhan rnams kyang dad pa dpag tu med pa skyes nas song ngo / /de nas ras chung pas dbus su phebs/ bya yul bka' gdams kyi grwa sar byon nas

mkhan po smin grol la bkod pa dang / lha lcam dang mjal ba rje btsun gyi thugs rjes khrel te/ slar yang bla ma'i drung du phebs pa'i bar gyi lo rgyus rnams ras chung pa rang gi rnam thar na gsal lo/ /ras chung dbus bzhud kyi snyor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid gnya' nang grod phug na bzhugs dus/ nam zhig tho rangs kyi tshe/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can de mngon sum du byon nas mi la ras pa thong la la rgya gar gyi dam pa sangs rgyas 'thi zhing 'dug ste khyod mjal du mi 'gro'am zer byung ba la/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la ma bde ba'i sgro 'dogs gcod dgos mi 'dug ste/ khong grub thob yin pas mjal ba la skyon med snyam rlung thun gcig bzung ste gnya' nang thong la la byon pas/ la'i nang nas mar ཿdzang pa 'ga' dang phrad pas/ rgya gar gyi dam pa sangs rgyas 'byon zhing 'dug gam gsungs pas/ dam pa sangs rgyas ni ngo mi shes/ a tsa ra rgan po

mkhan po smin grol la bkod pa dang / lha lcam dang mjal ba rje btsun gyi thugs rjes khrel te/ slar yang bla ma'i drung du phebs pa'i bar gyi lo rgyus rnams ras chung pa rang gi rnam thar na gsal lo/ /ras chung dbus bzhud kyi snyor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid gnya' nang grod phug na bzhugs dus/ nam zhig tho rangs kyi tshe/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can de mngon sum du byon nas mi la ras pa thong la la rgya gar gyi dam pa sangs rgyas 'thi zhing 'dug ste khyod mjal du mi 'gro'am zer byung ba la/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la ma bde ba'i sgro 'dogs gcod dgos mi 'dug ste/ khong grub thob yin pas mjal ba la skyon med snyam rlung thun gcig bzung ste gnya' nang thong la la byon pas/ la'i nang nas mar ཿdzang pa 'ga' dang phrad pas/ rgya gar gyi dam pa sangs rgyas 'byon zhing 'dug gam gsungs pas/ dam pa sangs rgyas ni ngo mi shes/ a tsa ra rgan po

ra༅༅/ /gcig sngo khyog ge mdang mgron khang na nyal 'dug zer/ 'di rnams kyis ngo ma shes par 'dug dgongs la khar phebs nas gzigs pas/ dam pa yame mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyis rje btsun dang mjal bar bskul te/ snying rje'i mgron khang du gzims nas 'byon zhing 'dug pa gzigs te/ 'di la zag med kyi mngon shes yod zer brtag dgos snyam sku lus me tog gi phung por sprul nas bzhugs pas/ dam pas spyan mi gzigs par thal le gshegs song bas mngon shes thogs med yode pa mi bden pa 'dra dgongs pa'i tshe/ dam pa zhal khor log ste me tog gi phung po la zhabs tho brgyab ste/ kho re mi la ras pa lus me tog tu sprul nas bsdad pas mi chog par 'dug yar longs dang / khyod kyi mkha' 'gro'i srog snying rnams glu ru blangs/ dgrangs su gyer ba'i chad pa la sha za'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis khyod kyi bla dbus/sa dang don snying dmar tsa re ba khyer byung ba

dang nga phrad pas/ mdang nged rnams kyis tshogs 'khor byas zos tshar bas/ da khyod la do nub kyi tshe las med do/ /'chi brod kyi gdengs ci yod dam gsungs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun gyis har bzhengs te/ 'chi brod gdengs tshad drug gi mgur 'di gsungs skurdzo/ /mtha' bral chen po'i seng ge de/ /nyam nga med pa'i mche ba gtsigs/ /zhum khengs med pa'i gangs la nyal/ /de rnal 'gror pa nga yi lta ba'i gdengs/ /lta ba mkhan nga 'chi na brod/ 8 nas thar pa'i lam la 'grerdzo/ /g.yo 'gul med pa'i shwa ba la/ /ro gcig du ma'i ra bcu rgyas/ /bde gsal chen po'i spang la nyal/ /de rnal 'gyor pa nga yi sgom pa'i gdengs/ /sgom pa mkhan nga 'chi na brod/ 8 nas thar pa'i lam la 'gro/ /sdig bcu 'brel med kyi nya mo la/ /dge bcu 'bral med kyi gser mig 'khyil/ nyams rgyun chad med chu bo'i gzhung la 'gyo/ /de rnal 'gyor pa nga yi spyod pa'i gdengs/ /spyod pa mkhan nga 'chi na

ra༅༅/ /brod/ 8 nas thar pa'i lam la 'gro/ /rang sems dpang btsugs kyi stag mo la/ /gzhan don lhun grub kyi ri mo bkra/ /yangs dog med pa'i nags la 'gyo/ /de rnal 'gror pa nga yi dam tshig gdengs/ /dam tshig mkhan nga 'chi na brod/ 8 nas thar pa'i lam la 'gro/ /snang ba dkar dmar gyi shog bu la/ /rig pa sems kyis yi ge bris/ /gnyis su med par lta rtog byed/ /de rnal 'gyor pa nga yi dam chos gdengs/ /dam chos mkhan nga 'chi na brod/ 8 nas thar pa'i lam la 'gro/ /'gyu ba dwangs sangs kyi khyung chen la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi gshog sgro rgyas/ /'dus ma byas kyi mkha' la 'phur/ /de rnal 'gror pa nga yi 'bras bu'i gdengs/ /'bras bu mkhan nga 'chi na brod/ 8 nas thar pa'i lam la 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pas dam pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi de 'dra la rgyu mtshan ci yang mi 'dug /phyi'i dngos po dper bkod pas mi 'ong / khyod

rnal 'gror pa gzha' ma zhig yin na da lta'i rig pa 'di la thag chod cig dgos pa yin gsungs pa la/ rje btsun gyis blo bde thag chod drug gi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /mkha' 'gro shugs kyis 'du ba'i dben gnas su/ /gang bde gcig pur chos la bsam mno btang / /dpa' bo bdag rtsad chod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems skye med kyi ngang la 'chi med 'gro/ /skye 'chi'i mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /lta ba'i thag chod blo re bde/ /bde bde 'dra na dam pa rang yang mdzod/ /sgom sgom med kyi ngang nas yengs med 'gro/ /mnyam rjes kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /sgom pa'i thag chod blo re bde/ /bde bde 'dra na dam pa rang yang mdzod/ /spyod pa shugs 'byung gi ngang nas 'gag med 'gyo/ /tshul 'chos kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /spyod pa'i thag chod blo re bde/ /bde bde 'dra na dam pa rang yang mdzod/ /dbang bskur med kyi ngang nas thob med 'phyo/ /lha sku'i mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /

sna ma/ rang sar grol/ /k+ṣiṃ/ rjo lhidī dz+nyo k+ṣiṃ zlo tā rdo sdo/ bde/ba/de /༵sdo ༵bye rno sdo~X bye trī rngo ༵dro sna ma/dzokā//bras/da py-i zlo ༵da sdu ḍi~X chi ༵ ṅgi k+ṣiṃ / me/tā dz+nyo/sa /༷ rto sar grol/ /'bras bu'i thag chod blo re bde/ /bde bde 'dra na dam pa rang yang mdzod/ /ces gsangs pas dam pa'i zhal nas ngas de rnams mngon du byas tshar/bod kyi chos pa la bcos mi dgos pa khyod byung // rgya gar na yang khyod 'dra ba re re tsam las med/ da nga la yang byed mi dgos khyod la yang nga mi dgos par 'dug gsung mnyes nas log 'byon grabs mdzad cing 'dug pa la/rje btsun gyis dam pa'i na bza' nas 'jus te/ dam pa khyod la dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed ces bya ba kha nang du log nas bsgoms pas/sangs

rgyas kyi dgongs pa cig car du rtogs pa yerdzod zer ba de mgur du gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas sngar nga glu len pa nam thos/ da dung yang mi thos nga thong gsung ba la / rje btsun gyis nan gyis zhus pas/ dam pas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di/ /gdon gnod sbyin pho mo 'dul tsa na/ /brtul zhugs 'khrul 'khor 'cha' ba yin/ /lus la na tsha byung tsa na/ /dbyengs rig gcig tu bsre ba yin/ /rnam rtog phra mo skyes tsa na/ /nyon mongs la 'bur 'joms btang ba yin/ /gcig pur lkog tu nyal tsa na/ /rig pa rjen par 'jog g.yin/ /mang po'i gseb tu sdod tsa na/ /gang shar ngo la lta ba yin/ /bying na phaṭa kyi gseng ba yin/ /'phro na rtsa ba gcod pa yin/ /rbode na dbyengs su 'jog pa yin/ khes pa yul phyir 'brang tsa na/ /de nyid don la lta ba yin/ /dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di/ /ltas ngan byung na g.yang du blan/ /rnam rtog ji

ra༅༅/ /ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /na tsha byung na bogs su 'don/ /'byung ba ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /'chi ba byung na lam du slong / /'chi bdag ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa lags/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gsang tshig yin/ /mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i srog snying yin/ /rgyud sde bzhi'i gdams ngag yin/ /snyan brgyud gnad kyi man ngag yin/ /man ngag thabs kyi lde mig yin/ /dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed lags/ /zhes gsungs pas rje btsun mnyes shing cha lugs lhug par bzhugs pa la/ dam pa'i zhal nas lus la sba rgyu zhig 'dug pa mi sbed par rjes pa'i spyode pa 'dra ba de ma byed gsungs pa la/ rje btsun gyis spyo lugs 'di mgur du gsungs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ /mthun pa'i lam sna chos la

drongs/ /rnal 'gror mi la ras pa la/ /gzhan yang smyo'am smyo'am zer/ /rang yang smyo'am snyam pa byung / /spyo ba'i spyo lugs bshad tsa na/ /pha smyo bu smyo brgyud pa smyo/ /brgyudh+ra pa rdo rje 'chang chen spyo/ /yang mes tai lo sher bzang smyo/ /mes po nā ro paṇa chen smyo/ /pha rgan mar pa lo ts+tsha spyo/ /nga rang mi la ras pa smyo/ /brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen de/ /sku bzhe lhun grub gdon gyis spyo/ /yang mes tai lo sher bzang de/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gdon gyis smyo/ /mes po nā ro paṇa chen de/ /rig pa brtul zhugs gdon gyis smyo/ /pha rgan mar pa lo ts+tsha de/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi gdon gyis smyo/ /nga rang mi la ras pa 'di/ /rlung sems gnyis kyi gdon gyis spyo/ /phyogs ris med pa'i lta ba spyo/ /dmigs med rang gsal sgom pa spyo/ /'dzin med rang grol spyad pa smyo/ /re dogs med pa'i 'bras bu spyo/ /zol zog med pa'i dam tshig smyo/ /spyo bas mi tshad 'dre yang gnod/ /pho gdon du bla ma'i gdams rngathun
