drongs/ /rnal 'gror mi la ras pa la/ /gzhan yang smyo'am smyo'am zer/ /rang yang smyo'am snyam pa byung / /spyo ba'i spyo lugs bshad tsa na/ /pha smyo bu smyo brgyud pa smyo/ /brgyudh+ra pa rdo rje 'chang chen spyo/ /yang mes tai lo sher bzang smyo/ /mes po nā ro paṇa chen smyo/ /pha rgan mar pa lo ts+tsha spyo/ /nga rang mi la ras pa smyo/ /brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen de/ /sku bzhe lhun grub gdon gyis spyo/ /yang mes tai lo sher bzang de/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gdon gyis smyo/ /mes po nā ro paṇa chen de/ /rig pa brtul zhugs gdon gyis smyo/ /pha rgan mar pa lo ts+tsha de/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi gdon gyis smyo/ /nga rang mi la ras pa 'di/ /rlung sems gnyis kyi gdon gyis spyo/ /phyogs ris med pa'i lta ba spyo/ /dmigs med rang gsal sgom pa spyo/ /'dzin med rang grol spyad pa smyo/ /re dogs med pa'i 'bras bu spyo/ /zol zog med pa'i dam tshig smyo/ /spyo bas mi tshad 'dre yang gnod/ /pho gdon du bla ma'i gdams rngathun

gengaX/ /gnod/ri/pyo gaphro du mkha' shuskru kyi rlabs gnokyi/ /blo bde ba'i 'gong po phuspyo su zhugs/'a/rtogardzu rtsaldu sngi 'dre mos spyun du~X sna/ne/'dre gawo kyasdu ma tshadu sa yaṭā na/'a/phyag rgya chanapas rgyab nasasagur/'itsha/rdzagasapachan pas mdun nas gar/ /rlung bum pa ༷༷ gās gcadā gas zan/ོ/stang na sa kya tshadā pas gasdur/ /dīg na tang 'atram̐spya gya graḍi ba na/'i/baṭī na baX stang gā ོ grang skyagu/ /ṭā nas kyidamasdu dug khra~X ltar snroga'i/chas nyad kya baḍi ༷sa byadu rdzug brgyazlos//na ṭās zi r+sā swācha sngung 'an+t+ra/ /lta ba' klang du phyags rardzu 'anā/ /sgam paspya klar+sha du snrong rgad 'cha/ri/spyad pa' klang du la 'as 'aṭ+wāṃ/ /ṭībras bu' klaze sa ze dgasanyu cha/ /daswā tshog kyāng du zal zag 'cha/ /sku gsum ngang du rnal 'byar 'cha/ /rnal 'byar ba' nangs par da//snam bu byang rkyang ma lags pa'/ /phya snang ba khra ma' ra dum mthang / /rtswa gras ma' thag

pa ma lags pa'i/ /a wa dh+ra tī'i thag pas sgrog /snabs bshal bu tsha ma lags pa'i/ /bu rig pa'i khye'u chung yar bzhengs la/ /rnal 'gror shi ba'i ro 'di khur/ /sa lam skya mo lolags pa'i/ /byang chub lhun po'i lam la khur/ /sa mkhan mkha' 'gro sde bzhis gyis/ /ro lam bka' brgyud bla mas drongs/ /g.ya' ri spang ri ma lags pa'i/ /dpal kun tu bzang po'i ri la skyol/ /dur khrod wa spyang ma lags pa'i/ /thabs shes rab gnyis kyi wa spyang rol/ /rdo rje 'chang gi dur du sbos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dam pa shin tu mnyes nas rnal 'gror pa khyod kyis smyolugs de legs byung gsungs pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas 'o skol rnal 'gror pa tshogs pa la tshogs kyi 'khor lo shig bshams pa drag gam gsungs pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas 'o na khyod bod gzhis par 'dug pas nga rgya gar ba la tshogs 'khor shoms shig gsung ba la/ rje btsun gyi dbu thod klad pa dang bcas pa ling phog ste pus

ra༅༅/ —— /mo gnyis dang mjing pa'i sgyed bu'i khar bkal ba la/ lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar bas klad pa 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan du bskol bas/ dam pas 'jag ma bdun gyis steng du ska bdun bsgrigs byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis kyang bde mchog gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad gsol gyi bya ba la sprul te bkod nas 'jag ma bdun gyi steng du sku bdun bkod nas tshogs kyi rlakhor lo 3ma pa drug ldan du mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje btsun gyi 'jag ma rnams cung zad mgo gug 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyis dam pa la 'o cag gnyis rlung bum pa can la ni khyad med bdag gi 'jag ma mgo gug pa ci lags gsungs pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas 'o cag gi spangs rtogs kyi yon to la khyad mi 'dug ste/ khyod bod du skyes pa'i khyad du 'dug /'o skol gnyis lta spyod gcig par 'dug pas ma 'ongs pa'i slob brgyud rnams kyang lta spyod gcig par 'ong bar 'dug gsung ngo / /de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis rang

rad ga gnas su gzhags so/ /thong la'e skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi lporas pa de nyid gnya' nang grad phug na bzhugs dus/ la zhing zhes bya ba na ban pa'i sde chen sdi zhag yod pa de'i nang nas ban po phyug po chos la dad pa zhig yad pa des ban po gzhan gyis ma tshor ba rje btsun la bsnyen bkur byas dbang dang gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms pa zhig yed pa de/ 'chi nad kyis thebs pa'i tshe/ kho rang gi nye 'brel kun bsags nas kha chem la nga'i nor skal gang yod rje btsun dpon gasku ga la phul la gnas 'dren zhus/ khyed rad rnams kyang tshe 'di'i bon po bas phyi ma phan pa'i chos gyis shig zer ba la/ khong rnams nyan rigs su mi 'dag pa dang / rje btsun yab sras zin ma drangs kyi dogs nas/ bu mo gcig yod pa de la nga la gri zhig thongs dang byas pas ci byed pa zer/ ngas labs pa'i kha la mi nyan sting nga lcerbos nas 'chi ba yin/ khyed rnamabla la'ang gtam ngan zhig 'ong las che

ra༅༅/ /byas pas/ khong rnams na re/ 'o na khyod rang zer ba bzhin bya'o zer bas/ 'o na 'o cag bon po rnams la phyi ma'i gnas 'dren gyi tha snyad kyis ma goso 'dug pas/ rje btsun gdan drongs shig zer shi bar gyur to/ /de nas bon po'i kha chem bzhin rje btsun dpon slob 'ga' spyan drangs te steng khang zhig tu bzhugs/ bon po rnams kyis 'og tu cho ga byas pas dkyil 'khor gyi rtsa ba na sngar shi ba'i bon po de sngo thul zhol le chang 'thung zhing 'dug pa be tas mthong ba dang / be ta la bon po rnams na re/ mi la ras pa dag nged tsho la 'thab ste/ nged kyi chos gshin po mngon sum du khugs pa 'di 'dra kho la med zer mtshar mtshar du byed cing 'dug pa pe tas rje btsun la zhus pas/ de gshin po min te/ gzhan rnams yid ches pa'i khyad yod pas zhi ba 'od song la kho'i srin lag nas zungs la/ khyod la rje btsun mi las gnya' nang grod phug tu dbang bskur dus kyi gsang mtshan de

ci yin gyis shog cig gsung ba ltar/ zhi ba 'od kyis phyin pas/ khos rje btsun gyi thugs rje'i zil ma bzod par zhi ba 'od chas pa tsam la nga 'gro nga bon po'i bla khyer mkhan snang yul gyi bdud nga ra mi zan bya ba yin bon po'i chos la gtad so mi 'dug pas rngan chan byas 'ongs pa yin zer/ srang bar na mar sngo thul zhol le song ba ded pas ri logs la spyang kir byas song skad/ de gshin po min par kun gyis yid ches pa dang / rje btsun gyis bon po rnams la khyed tshos gshed ma la lam ston par 'dug ste/ nga gzhin po la lam ston pa yin gsungs pas bon po'i nye ba rnams na re/ rje btsun gyi gshin po gzigs lags sam/ ma gzigs na lam ji ltar ston zhus pas/ ngas mthong kho sngon gyi las dbang cung zad cig gis dge rtsa 'di ma grub par lung pa'i phu ya gi na lci ba ser skam ma zhig gi 'og na 'bu phra la ring ba zhig tu skyes 'dug ste/ ngas da lta rang thar pa'i gnas su skyel ba yin gsungs

ra༅༅/ /pas/ 'o na bdag cag rnams la yid ches pa'i slad du 'bu de thar par skye lugs ston par zhu dang zhu ba la/ rje btsun gyis 'o na 'dong zhin gsung / der 'dus pa'i mi rnams dang bcas lci ba ser skam pa'i 'gram du byon nas dang po'i gsang mtshan nas 'os te/ nga khyod rang gi bla ma mi la ras pa yin pas 'dir shog cig gsungs pa dang / lci ba'i 'og nas 'bu de byung nas rje btsun gyi sku 'phang du chil nyal song ba la/ chos bshad 'pho ba dang gnas spor mdzad pas 'bu de shi ba'i 'u sa las 'od phra la 'tsher ba zhig rje btsun gyi thugs kar thim song bas/ rje btsun re zhig dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i mthar gzhin po'i rnam shes a dkar po 'idi 'tsher ba zhig rje btsun gyi thugs ka nas rgyangs thon nas nam mkha' la je mtho je mthor 'gro zhing / rje btsun rin po che bdag thar pa'i bde ba la bkod pa bka' drin che zhes brjod cing song ba kun gyis mthong bas yid

ṭ+wāṃdroṭ+wāṃ'i/zhardogā tram̐dzi shi ṭ+wāṃbye che/༷/kā snaX sdi/rgi t+t+waṃ d+meṭ+wāṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ sh+lau da sngi/bye sdu/dwo sngi byetweṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ/ sna de//shi/ /hūm̐ da ram̐ ne+ehūṃ ñcha/rnyi/ṭaṃ/ /mtsha//ṭaṃ hūm̐bye ༵kā sna/ bshā// thab/ snar+sha /sa r+sha/ dri ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ṭ+wāṃdṛ ༵ de/sa rjo/ma/tshazlo/ ༵nga sa kyi che sho sa yi na/ //stse/ga par sdug sran bskyed pa de/ /ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin/ /chos brgyad 'dun pa med pa de/ /ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin/ /bla mo mnyes pa 'grub pa de/ /ngo mtshar sdusangs kyi che shos yin/ /bon pa'i kha chems 'jog lugs de/ /ngo mtshar da wa

ra༅༅/ /yongs kyi che shos yin/ /nye ba kha la nyan pa de/ /ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin/ /gshin po thar par song ba de/ /ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin/ /'dir tshogs dad pa skyes pa de/ /ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin/ /zhes gsungs pas bon po'i nye ba rnams na re/ kho rang gis dad sa ma nor 'dug /'chi kar sangs rgyas thob pa de ka dgos pa yin zer/ ras pa zhi ba 'od na re/ de ring gi lam sna 'dren mkhan 'di 'dra kun la dgos pa yin te/ 'ong ba dang mos pa dka' bar 'dug zer bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyed bu slobe rnams gzhan gyi lam sna byed pa la 'di tsho dgos pa yin gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes so/ /rje bka' brgyud kyi byin rlabs rgyab dpung bzang / /rigs brgyud mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub thob/ /chos brgyud ma nor bu slob rnams/ /las ngan rnam smin sbyang ba la/ /rang rgyud la sdom pa yodi pa dgos/ /yon bdag gi

bla mchod byed pa la/ /snying rje byang sems skyes pa dgos/ /mang po'i tshogs dpon byed pa la/ /yon tan rtogs pa ldan pa dgos/ /grub thob kyi bla ma mnyes pa la/ /dag snang dang snying rus che ba dgos/ /gshin po'i za ma za ba la/ /mthong lam gyi yon tan skyes pa dgos/ /tshe 'das kyi rnam shes 'dren pa la/ /mngon shes dang grub rtags thon pa dgos/ /dad log snang ba bsgrur ba la/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi sprul pa nus pa dgos/ /de ring bdun tshigs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /mngon sum lam sna zin pa dgos/ /bon po'i bu slob yon bdag rnams/ /sems lothe tshom ma byed cig /ces gsungs pas/ lcam mo pe ta na re/ a jos mi gzhan la 'di 'dra'i bdun tshigs mdzad cing 'dug ste/ rang re'i pha ma gnyis la 'di 'dra ma mdzad zer ngus pas/ rje btsun gyis lcam mo'i phyag nas bzung ste/ pe ta de tsam ngu mi dgos/ ngas pha ma gnyis la'ang drin lan bsab phyir 'di bzhin byas

ra༅༅/ /gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes so/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ge'adebs/ /pha ma'i drin lan gsor bar thugagorjes zungs/ /ngas a ma lus /spre sgrom bu dang / /pha mes drin gyi rgyal po yis/ /skya ma'i lus po dor dus su/ /rnam shes rang gi sems la bsres/ /sems nyid rgyal ba'i thugs la bstims/ /thugs rjes 'ja' 'od zhing khams shar/ /lus snang stong lha yi sku la bsnyims/ /lha rang byung du grub pa ngo mtshar che/ /ngag grag stong brjod med sngags su 'dres/ /sngags dang rang sgra 'grig pa ngo mtshar che/ /sems bar dor 'khyams pa ting 'dzin gyis bkug /gsa'akharngong rig pa rang ngo sprad/ /sems rang sa zin pas zhabrulapa med/ /'pho 'gyur med pa ngo mtshar che/ /mi bdag gis sgrub pa byed pa'i ring / /byams dang snying rje'i drag sngags des/ /i med mawo med sgrib pa sbyangs/ /rigs drug gsor ba'i skye sgo bcad/ /bde

zhing dag pa'i tshogs la sgrigs/ /dga' zhing mnyes pa'i longs spyod 'phel/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /khyod the tshom mi dgos pe ta lcam/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'o na ngo mtshar che/ cho ga ji ltar mdzad zhu ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /pha ma'i drin lan 'khor bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ngas bde chen gnyis med dkyil 'khor du/ /rang rig gsal ba'i lha tshogs bkod/ /rgyud lung dang man ngag gi bum pa ru/ /phar phyin drug gi khrus chab blugs/ /ser sna dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ /bka' brgyud bla ma'i bdud rtsi yis/ /lus ngag sems la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pa sa lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /dbyer med bde ba chen por bstan/ /sku gsum dbyer med kyi tsha tsha btab/ /zag pa med pa'i bdun tshigs byas/ /rjes shes zab mo'i dus mchod la/ /gnyen po bzang po'i mchod pa

rnodro//—/bla ma'i bka' dri/ji ṭ+wāṃṅgi/dran /ṭ+wāṃpy-i/ rgya kau/ ༵ ༵༵ kākho/ra /bye ༵ ṭ+wāṃzhi/na /dze+e~X snas sdi smi ༵ma/ bapaṃ~X she/sa/ ṭ+wāṃr+shaspyu bye ༵ t+t+waṃr+sha ༵dī dz+nyo ñcha nya~X/༵ ༵ sna ༵ ༵r+sha ༷ ༵ ༵ 'di gsangs so/ /rje lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gar+sā la gdung sems zhi byer byin gyis rlobs/ /chos dang sems rgyud 'dres par thugs rjes zungs/ /gsen dang sring mo snru ta lcam/ /chos gzhon nas snying rus ma byas pa'i/ /rgas nas byed bsam ci la phan/ /bla ma rje btsun ma bsten pa'i/ /grogs bzang bla mas ci la phan/ /gdams ngag snyan brgyud ma thob pa'i/ /kha bshad skam pos ci la phan/ /rang sems rang ngo ma shes na/ /mang po bslabs pas ci la phan/ /skye med rang sa ma zin pas/ /kha lta skam pos sdig rī

pa gserdzog /nyams rgyudang nang nas ma shar ba'i/ /tshul 'chos mkhan zhig 'done pa mang / /rten 'brel ltad mo ma mthong ba'i/ /the tshom mkhan zhig rang rtsis che/ /byang sems snying rje ma skyes pa'i/ /ngo 'ordzog mkhan zhig gtsang sbra mang / /sangs rgyas e thob mi bsam pa'i/ /chos pa zer yang nor la gnag /sems can yongs la mi phan pa'i/ /pha ma byams kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /chos dang mthun par mi sgrub na/ /nye ba yin kyang sdang ba'i dgra/ /grogs la gnod pa byed pa'i mi/ /mdzes mdzes 'dra yang bdud kyi rigs/ /snying nas snyugs su mi sgom na/ /'phral sgom chen zer yang sgom sdug yin/ /ci phan ci bzod mi sgrab pa'i/ /grogs bzang po byas kyang zhe rdowonyad mang / /ma phyir sdug bsngal yi mug des/ /khyod sring mo'i sdig sgrib dag dag 'dra/ /zhes gsungs nas sgom du bcug pas nyarmes rtogs khyad par can skyes pa la rje btsun mnyes nas/ lcam mo la brod pa bskyed pa'i

ra༅༅/ /mgur 'di gsungs so/ /khyod da dung nyon dang pe ta lcam/ /chos las snang ba ma log na/ /sdug la zad rgyu yod pa yin/ /mi la ngan pa ma brjod na / /rang la lha bzhin mthong ba yin/ /gzhan la bsam pa mi ngan na/ /rang gi bsod nams 'phel ba yin/ /tshe 'di la zhen pa mi che na/ /phyi ma bde zhing skyid pa yin/ /rang mthong nga rgyal ma skyed dang / /gzugs bzang yid 'ong thob pa yin/ /sems nyid rang gshis skyong nus na/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob pa yin/ /mtshams dang smra bcad dam pa na / /mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs 'jug pa yin/ /sems la skyid 'dod med pa na/ /rnam smin sgrib pa byang ba yin/ /sgom yun shi dang snyoms nus na/ /yang rgyal dgung dang mnyam pa yin/ /sems la nog 'khris mi gda' na/ /dpa' bo dpa' mos bsu ba yin/ /byed spyod chos dang bstun shes na/ /chos skyong dpa' bos bsrung ba yin/ /bla ma rje la gsol

btab na/ /byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung ba yin/ /khyod shes par gyis la nyams su longs/ /dus kun tu bde skyid dpalal spyod/ khes gsungs pas pe rtas kyang ri khrod la zug cing sgom nus par gyur pas nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes nas sras rnams kyi sring bzhi'i ya bar gyur pa yin zhing / de dus kyi bon po rnams kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par gyur to/ /gshin don thugs rje'i lcags kyu dang sring mo pe ta byang chub la bkod pa'i skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid gnya' nang rtsar ma'i phu na bzhugs dus/ bag ma gsar pa zhig gi rin la yon bdag rnams 'thabs pa rje btsun la 'dum zhur byung bas 'thab mi kun la cesag gsungs te byung ba dang / kun la zhal ta'i chos mang du gnang zhing mgur 'di gsungs so/ /khyed mgo la rdo khur gyi rang rtsis can/ /rang la rtsod med kyi phung rdo ma/ /mi la mi shor rang gis lan/ /lus la dmar smug gi nang rul

ra༅༅/ /ma / /yid la khyo 'dod kyi gzhung ngan ma/ /lar phung gi rtsa ba bud med yin/ /yul gyi nad yams mi ngan yin/ /yul ngan dus ngan gyi mna' ma 'di/ /long la rin thang che bar 'dug /btsog la rtsod mi mang bar 'dug /de 'jig rten bsam brlag gi spyod pa yin/ /gzhon nu 'khrug pa ma byed rang tshod zungs/ /rgan pa tsho g.yo sgya ma byed rang la sdig /khrom 'dir tshogs kyi kha lo chos la bsgyur/ /zhes gsungs pas 'thab rtsod zhi bar gyur to/ /de nas yon bdag mo lcam me zhes bya ba'i dad pa can zhig yod pa des bsnyen bkur rgya chen phul ba'i tshogs gral du lcam mos zhus pa/ rje btsun rin po che 'gro don ji ltar grub/ bu slob mang nyung ji tsam gda'/ de rnams kyi nang nas grub thob du tsam mchis zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod kyi sems la de 'dri ba 'char ba de ngo mtshar che/ nga la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan 'di bzhin yode cing 'grerdzo don 'di 'dra

grub pa yin zhes mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro 33 lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlebes/ /mkha' 'gros lung bstan sprul pa'i sku/ /dwags po nyi ma 'gro la 'char/ /ras chung zla ba sprul pa'i sku/ /sgom stag jo dar zhi ba 'od/ /'bri sgom la sogs nyi shu lnga/ /mgo byas de rnams mkha' 'gros gsungs/ /grub thob nyer lnga rtogs ldan brgya/ /rang byung nyams shar brgya rtsa brgyad/ /chos mthun slob ma stong rtsa yod/ /chos 'brel thob pa khri 'bum ste/ /lag len skyong ba re rer 'dug /khyod dri rtog byed pa bag chags bzang / /zhes gsungs pas/ der tshogs pa'i bu slob rnams na re/ grub thob rang yang mang po 'ong bar 'dug zer/ kun dga' mgu yi rangs te snang ba bde cham song ngo / /de nas bsngo ba zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas da lan mchod gnas dang yoni bdag dge rtsa'i bsam sbyor rnams rnam par dag 'dug

ra༅༅/ /pas bsngo ba rang bzhin gyis grub 'dug na'ang / bsngo ba byed pa yin/ ngas kyang sangs rgyas kyi lad mo byed/ khyed rnams kyang nga'i lad mo gyis shig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ /bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur mdzad du gsol/ /tshogs rnams ma lus thams cad pa/ /sangs rgyas 'grub par byed pa'i thabs/ /nga la yod pas lad mo mdzod/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dge 'dun bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis/ /thog med 'khor ba chen po nas/ /sbyin dang tshulakhrims bsgoms pa yi/ /dge ba bgyis tshad rjes yi rang / /da ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba yis/ /sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi ni/ /rgyan dang yo byad rnal 'gror sgi /tshogs su gyur te pha ma dang / /mkhan po slob dpon la sogs kyi/ /ched du sangs rgyas thob par shog /ma thob bar du bdag dge

'dis/ /theg chen bla ma bsten nas ni/ /sdom gsum gnas pa'i lus bzung ste/ /yid la 'dod pa kun grub cing / /phan tshun sdig gsog mi byed shog /'dir yang dge byung bsod nams kyis/ /tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dang / /gabor dang dge sbyong la sogs pa'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod pa yi/ /bar du gcod pa zhi gyur cig /ces gsungs pas/ nam mkha' nas mthun 'gyur byung ngo / /de nas gnya' nang gi nya ma rnams kyis rje btsun ri khrod gzhan du 'byon pa thos nas/ bsnyen bkur bzang po phul te bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa las/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas nga sngar yul phyogs 'dir yun ring serdzong bas/ yon bdag rnams kyang sun 'ong las che da 'chi ba dgug tu gzhan du 'gro/ ma shi na phrad/ de bar la 'di bzhin gyis gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nor rdzas rtswa kha'i

༄༷/ ོ /bril pya 'dra/ོ/lngos ༷skya med par sbyiskya snrong / /dal ldor sding po len ༷ tsha/ /sdig gi'abras bzhin sdol ldidzo s+thādzo/ /nganari soX ba zhe sdaX gan/ /sras la bab kyang bzad pa sgams/'i/ldu las rang gzhan saX ma 'as+thāb/tsha/dwag baX las la brtsan5 ra ṭ+wāṃd/ /'khrul pas thag n+t+ran dan matre gas/zlo/ gcig sdon la gams par gyas/ /gzhan+d+ranaswā sa~Xs snrosamarnyad pas/ོ/rang ga samasasna kyin nyadardzu sa/ /dad pa staX kaX na bun 'dra/'i/yal ba' dusasusnyadurusa'a'il/ /snas gsudris zlosanyamasbyamasasdor/rja banaca gsungarung yul phyagaswā r+shazhanā du ma gtang bsna cas kyāng bzhugs dgakyi zar sna ba nan gyas 'bul du byung ṭās rja btsunatram̐ sa nga ma ri na slar khyad 'a sar ba pa byad/brgya la ma phrad na skabs skabs su 'ad rnams ma brjad par gyas la nyams su langs ga gsungs nas mgur 'ad gsungs sa/ /a ma

'gro ba 'jig rten pa/ /lus g.yu ljang bzhin du bskyangs bskyangs kyang / /rkyen sdong rgan bzhin du 'gyel zhing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /nor sbrang rtsi bzhin du bsogs bsogs kyang / /rkyen ba mo bzhin du 'ong zhing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /mchor dar khres bzhin du phur phur kyang / /rkyen 'ja' tshon bzhin du yal zhing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /gnyen ri dwags bzhin du 'grogs 'grogs kyang / /rkyen rngen pa bzhin du sleb cing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /bu sgo nga bzhin du gsos gsos kyang / /rkyen lam rdo bzhin du phrad cing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod/ /byad me tog bzhin du legs legs kyang / /rkyen ser ba bzhin du 'grim zhing 'dug /skabs skabs su mi rtag skyo shas re bskyed/ /'grogs ma bu bzhin du bzang bzang yang / /

ra༅༅/ /rkyen dgra gnyen bzhin du 'thab cing 'dug /skabs skabs su sems can la snying rje re bskyed/ /skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'des 'des kyang / /sdug rlung dmar bzhin du 'tshub cing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma nus pa la sbyin pa re thong / /lar 'dir tshogs kyi yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /dam pa'i lha chos shig ma nus na/ /tshe ring po bsdad pa ngan ring yin/ /las mang po 'bad pa sdug las yin/ /zhes gsungs pas khong rnams na re/ de bzhin bgyid lags/ rje btsun sa phyogs gzhan du blos gtong mi phod par 'dug ces zhur byung bas/ re zhig grerdzod phug tu bzhugs pa ltar mdzad pa'i mthar/ phug pa'i mdo na pha bong zhig yode pa de la zhabs rjes bzhag nas 'di la gnya' nang pa rnams kyi mos gus kyi rten gyis gsung / nya ma rnams kyis ma tshor bar byon no/ /gnya' nang pa'i nya ma rnams la mjug gi zhal gdams gsungs pa'i skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje

btsun mi laras pa de nyid dpon slob lngas thong la la byon pa'i tshe/ jag pa mi lnga byung bas dngos po dra ba zur gsum de'i nang na thod phor min pa ci yang mi 'dug pas/ khyed rnams rje btsun mi la ras pa zer ba de yin nam zer ba la/ yin gsungs pas kun phyag 'tshal zhing 'o na bdag cag rnams skal ba che bar gda'/ chos re gnang bar zhu zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyis kyang las rgyu 'bras kyi chos mtho ris kyi yon tan/ ngan song gsum gyi nyes dmigs gsungs nas de dge sdig gnyis kyi 'bras bu yin/ blang dor byed mi byed khyed rang shes zhes mgur 'di gsungs sku(/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ya gi dga' ldan lha yul na/ /'bras da lta btab pa da lta smin/ /9rdzong serdzo nam mkhas pa ma lags ste/ /tshe sngoni bserdzod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /sbyin pa thong zhig skal ldan kun/ /ma gi dmyal khams bco brgyad na/ /mtshon da lta brgyab pa da lta sos/ /kho rma las

ra༅༅/ /bzang ba ma lags te/ /tshe sngon srog gcod byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /srog gcod spongs dang skal ldan kun/ /pha gi yi dwags kyi yul shed na/ /sto da lta zos kyang da lta stogs/ /khong grod pa che ba ma lags te/ /tshe sngon ser sna byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /ser sna spongs shig skal ldan kun/ /khrus kyi rdzing bu'i rtsa shed na/ /de na 'dod 'khro'i ba mo yod/ /ba 'jo 'am mi 'jo khyod rang shes/ /sdong po kun 'dus kyi rtsa ba na/ /nad dug lnga sel ba'i sman mchog yod/ /sman brko'am mi brko khyod rang shes/ /bla ma slob dpon gyi spyan snga na/ /man ngag gnad kyi lde mig yod/ /sgo gnyis 'byed dam mi 'byed khyod rang shes/ /zhes gsungs pas jag pa rnams mchog tu dad par gyur te/ bzhis 'phrog 'joms dang gsod gcod mi byed pa'i dam bca' phul/ gcig phyag phyi la 'brangs pas rtogs ldan bzang po zhig byung ba yin no/ /de nas rje btsun dpon slob

rnams ding ri sna dmar na mar phebs te/ lug rdzi zhig la yul pha gi na yod bdag drag pa ji skad bya ba yode gsungs pas/ lha rje g.yang nge zhes bya ba phyug la dad pa che ba zhig yod zer/ der byon pas mi mang po zhig gi dbus na lha rje 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyis yon bdag khyod phyug po zhig yin zer bas/ nged rnams la da nang gi tsha ba slong gsungs pas/ kho na re/ la 'di'i phar rgyab na mi la ras pa/ tshur rgyab na dam pa sangs rgyas bzhugs pas rnal 'gyor pa'i 'grul la zad pa mi 'dug /thams cad la stosna ster na ster gyis mi lang 'dug mi la ras pa dang mjal na zhabs tog 'bul ba yin te/ nged rang rnams dang mjal ba'i skal ba mi 'dug zer bas/ rje btsun gyis mi la nga rang yin du'ang rung bas tsha ba drongs shig gsung ba la kho na re/ 'o na rje btsun mi la ras pa de snang ba thams cad dper drangs nas chos gsung ba zhig yod par 'dug pas/ nged rnams kyi mdun gyi yur

ra༅༅/ /chu'i lbu ba 'di la dpe byas pa'i chos shig gsungs dang zer byung ba'i lan du rje btsun gyis mi rtag chu lbur ma'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la 'dud/ /khrom 'dir tshogs kyi snang ba chos la bsgrur/ /tshe mi rtag chu yi lbu ba 'dra/ /yid brtan med par bla ma bzhed/ /le lo can khang stong rkun ma 'dra/ /stong 'ordzog byed pa ma shes sam/ /gzhon pa serdzos ka'i me tog 'dra/ /yel nas 'gro ba cha med dam/ /rgas pa spang la me 3(ra 'dra/ /rting la thug pa ma shes sam/ /skye 'chi nyi ma'i 'char nub 'dra/ /yang yang 'ong bar thub pas gsungs/ /na ba bye'u chung rdo phog 'dra/ /stobs nus zad pa ma shes sam/ /'chi ba snam zad mar me 'dra/ /rtag par mi sdod nges pa yin/ /las ngan gcong rong 'bab chu 'dra/ /gyen la ldog pa ngas ma mthong / /sdig pa can dug gi sdong po 'dra/ /gang bsten bsten pa rnams brlag pa yin/ /

dam nyams sran ma sad khyer 'dra/ /dam nyams nyams pa tsho phung nas gda'/ /chos spyod zhing pa'i sku( nam 'dra/ /gang rem rem pa rnams rgyal nas gda'/ /bla ma sman dang bdud rtsi 'dra/ /gang bsten bsten pa rnams rgyal nas gda'/ /dam tshig so pa'i mkhar dang 'dra/ /gang bsrungs bsrungs pa rnams rgyal nas gda'/ /las dge sdig srid pa'i 'khor lo'adra/ /sdom 'chol mkhan rnams pham nas gda'/ /'dur ba dug gi tsher ma 'dra/ /gang spel spel ba rnams sbyong zhing gda'/ /'chi bdag nyi ma'i grib so 'dra/ /bkag pas khegs pa ngas ma mthong / /de 'dra'i dus shig byung tsa na/ /dam pa'i chos shig ma lags pa/ /mgoni skyabs byed mkhan logs na med/ /sus thob rgyal ba dam pa'i chos/ /dam pa'i chos la 'dod mkhan med/ /'khor ba'i khyim thab sdug las skyes/ /sdug las skyes la hab thob byed/ /chos kha la lab dus skyid skyid po/ /don la thug dus tug tug

ra༅༅/ /brdugs/ /yon bdag kha sbyang ma che lha chos mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ kho na re de sems la shin tu phan pa zhig byung / da dung skye rga na 'chi las rgyu 'bras kyi chos nges shes skye ba zhig gsung bar zhu dang zer ba'i lan du yang mgur 'di gsungs so/ /don skye med chen po'i ngang shed na/ /chos tshad med bzhi ldan bdud rtsi'i mer/ /'gro rnams bde chen lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rje yid bzhin nor bu khyed la bstod/ /don de la bla ma'i bstod pa mdzod/ /tshig 'di la 'dir bzhugs gsan par zhu/ /khyed gzhon pa dbang po dar tsa na/ /rgas pa 'ong snyam mi gda' ste/ /rgas pa 'og 'bru'i tshul du 'ong zhing gda'/ /rim gyi rim gyis 'ong zhing gda'/ /'byung ba lnga po dar tsa na/ /na ba 'ong snyam mi gda' ste/ /na ba blo rdeg tshul du 'ong zhing gda'/ /btsan thabs btsan thabs su 'ong zhing gda'/ /tshe 'di la snang ba 'thas tsa na/ /'chi ba 'ong snyam mi gda'

ste/ /'chi ba thog babs kyi tshul du 'ong zhing gda'/ /glo bur glo bur du 'ong zhing gda'/ /rgas dang na dang 'chi ba gsum/ /kha dang lag pa bzhin du thug nas gda'/ /bar chod glo rdeg mda' bas tsha/ /'chi bdag la khali so bzhin sgug /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ /bya long bzhin du gral la bsgrigs/ /lar 'bral med kyi mgron gsum de na gda'/ /khyed sdig pa'i las la mi 'jigs sam/ /dmal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum/ /dpag chen gyi mda' bzhin 'phrang la sgug /lar 'gyur med 'phrang gsum de na gda'/ /khyed sngar gyi sdug bsngal mi dred dam/ /da lta'i sdag bsngal la mi 'tsher ram/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra/ /snga ma ma sangs phyi ma 'byung / /'di la sangs dus mi gda' na/ /skyid sdug lam kha'i mgrod po 'dra/ /da lta med kyang da lta 'byung / /'di la 'chad dus mi gda' na/ /dal skyid nyi ma 'de ba 'dra/ /mi rtag kha char bu yug 'dra/ /

ra༅༅/ /'phral du 'ong ba mi shes sam/ /de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ zhes gsungs pas kun dad nas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas/ dus rtag tu mchod gnas su bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas ma gnang ste/ zhag gcig bzhugs pa'i ring la lha rje g.yang nge la gdams ngag gnang nas 'byon par chas pa dang / yul mi kun tshogs nas rje btsun zhag 'ga' yang mi bzhugs na/ nged rnams la nyams len gyi chos shig gnang bar zhu zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /khrom kor re tshogs pa dkyil le nyon/ /khyed nges par lha chos mdzad mi mdzad/ /nges par lha chos mdzad dgongs na/ /rang gi mal du nyal tsa na/ /gnyid gti mug gi dbang du ma btang bar/ /nam srod la yi dam lha bsten mdzod/ /nam stod rje la gsol ba thob/ /nam gung la rnam par mi rtog sgoms/ /tho rangs srog rtsol rlung la 'bad/ /nam langs dug lnga'i bzhags pa

gyis/ /nyi shar snang ba rgya yis thob/ /gtso bo rang gi sems la stos/ /gdams ngag bla ma rje la zhus/ /gsol ba yi dmalha la thob/ /dam tshig rdo rje spun la srungs/ /mchod pa dkon mchog gsum la phul/ /spyi bor thugs rje chen po sgoms/ /snying po ma ṇi pad+me bgrongs/ /sbyin pa dbul phongs kun la thong / /snying rje ma nus pa la gyis/ /zhabs tog mkhas btsun rnams la gyis/ /bkur sti pha dang ma la gyis/ /lar mkhas btsun bla ma brgya tshogs kyang / /don 'di las nyams su blang rgyu med/ /dus gnas skabs kun tu bkra shis shing / /tshe ring nad med smon lam 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pas kun mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob cing lha rje g.yang nges 'chi khar lam sna zin par gyur to/ /rje btsun dpon slob chu dbar du byon no/ /lha rje g.yang nge'i snyor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid kyi thugs sras ras chung pa de nyid la/ lha lcam ldem bu'i bar chad cung zad cig

ra༅༅/ /byung 'dug pa bsal ba'i phyir/ rje btsun gyis sprul pa mdzad nas ras chung pa la sbyin pa bslangs pas/ rong g.yag sder byung ba'i g.yu chen po zhig yod pa de zan gyis gtums nas byin byung bas/ nga'i bu la dngos po'i 'dzin chags mi 'dug cing snying rje chen po 'dug dgongs pa byung ste/ g.yu sbyin par btang ba'i rkyen gyis lha lcam ldem bu la skyo bas bor nas rje btsun gyi drung du mjal du 'ongs pas/ lam bar du khams pa phyug po zhig gis bu mo 'chi ba la slong pas sha skam po khog pa gnyis phul ba zhib mor byas te/ rje btsun la 'bul phyir bsnams byon pas/ rje btsun chu dbar na bu slob rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs dus rje btsun gyi zhal nas ras chung pas khong la 'bul ba lung par mi shong ba khyer 'ong zhing 'dug gsung / de nas myur du phebs byung ste/ sha skam rkyal pa gang gis phyag rten byas/ rje btsun la mjal nas snyun dris pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so//

rje gangs dkar 'grim pa'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /khams bde ba rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /dug lngas dregs pa'i nad sangs pa/ /ma bde ma mchis bde mor byung / /'du 'dzi zhen pa'i g.yeng ba spangs/ /gcig pur rang dbang thob pas bde/ /sna tshogs brel ba'i las spangs nas/ /mi med lung pa dben par bde/ /'jig rten sdug gi khyim thab spangs/ /'phral du gserdzog 'jogamed pas bde/ /mkhas 'dodi dpe cha ma bsgrubs pas/ /sems khral med pa'i sems nyid bde/ /smra 'dodi nga rgyal mi che bas/ /kha mchu kha smras med pas bde/ /g.yo sgru zol zog mi shes pas/ /de byung 'di byed med pas bde/ /grags 'dod dregs 'dod med pa yis/ /gtam ngan mi kha zad pas bde/ /gnas gang byung chog pas gar yang bde/4/gos gang gyon chog pas ci byas bde/ /zas gang zos chog pas gang byung bde/ /mi nga ni dus rnams rtag tu bde/ /bu ras chung bde bar 'dir sleb bam/ /zhes

ra༅༅/ /gsungs nas sha skam de latshod ma byas grwa pa kun la yog drangs byas pas/ ras pa gtsig na re/ rje btsun la thugs sraloras chung pas 'bul ba lung par mi cerdzong ba khyer 'ong zhing 'dug gsungs pa de gang lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas gsus pa'i lung par sha tshod kyi 'bul ba mi sesgong ba byung 'dug pa gsungs pas kun bzhad gad du gyur to/ /de nas rje btsun gyis bu slobo rnams la dbang gnang ba yin pas 'bul ba'i rten 'brel mtshon pa re khyer shog ras chung pa khyod la med kyang rung gsung / ras chung pa thugs mi bde zhing byon pas maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su sngar gyi g.yu de ye re 'dug pas ras chung pa lus sbrid chil ba byung ba dang / sprang po rje btsun gyi sprul par shes pas lha lcam dang bral ba yang rje btsun gyi thugs rjer yid ches pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas ras chung pa nga min na khyod g.yu 'di'i rin la phung la sbyor bar 'dug ste/ nga la yang mos gus rgyun ma

chad pa dang / sems can la snying rje ma bor bar 'dug pas 'tshengs pa yin no gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes so/ /pha bla ma'i byin rlabs nus pa che/ /mi la'i rdzu 'phrul gnad 'gag che/ /ras chung snying rje gtong phod che/ /g.yu sprang po la byin pa kho bos lene/ /do nub bde mchog gi dbang yon mdzod/ /snying rje ma nus pa la byas pa de/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas mchodi dang 'dra/ /nga snying rjes sprang la byin pa na/ /mi la ras pa mchodi pa yin/ /'gro kun pha dang ma yin pas/ /de la sel 'byed byed pa rnams/ /mi shes btsan dug za ba 'dra/ /mkhas btsun thams cad thugs mthun pas/ /〈sna rus chags sdang byed pa rnams/ /bslabs tshad chu la pho ba yin/ /chos la dkar nag med pa la/ /grub mtha' kha 'dzin chos la rnyed/ /thar pa'i 'ju thag chad pa yin/ /rang bde thams cad gzhan las byung / /gzhan phan thams cad rang bde'i rgyu/ /gnod pa thams cad rang la sdig /de

lge/ ngapa~X/sdo~Xṭ+wāṃ~Xṭ+wāṃshāṭ+wāṃsduñcha~X/ched/trīdīdīṭ+wāṃdīrnyi~Xṣ+ṭṛṭ+wāṃs+hor+sha/sapa/tīṭ+wāṃ ༵ k+ṣiṃbye ṭ+wāṃ shā~X cad k+ṣiṃkyi/skyi/dzi dazibacaṭīdrag r+yā / / gsungaswā ༷sa rardzu shā pa sa ga yosgyu ngan so ngagil sa bsag sapa phabla ma 'isku la mtholalo spyog sa ngagagisto/da'/r+pākhra ma pa'i ḍā g.yang ba'alha sa/ri/snang ba khraḍi mkhas shā snroḍi ༵ngapoyi dwag/sa/gnas khre la medabarjo dpamidra ngab/ phablama'igasangal mtho lalogho/ga/sa skyida' dodab sam panganapa'i/rgyu/zhal lcar ༷ ñjul baḍi k+ṣi/ 'i zhe'ado da sdigapa 'ilas/bas/gas pa phabla ma 'ithugs/lam/tho la lospyor+shas yul nga nagrongadu/'khya/mas payis k+ṣ-i la' khor stse/ /gh+ras 'daspya spyad pa ma nga ba'/ / / / // // pa' sgrab mchad lngo/

'dre brdung mang po'i phrin las kyis/ /zab mo sngags kyi nus pa shor/ /bya ba mang po'i bsam bzhag gis/ /ting 'dzin bzang po'i sgom 'phro chad/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mthol lo bshags/ /gnas mal mang po'i 'dug sa des/ /bdag dang gzhan la khyad par phye/ /rang pham khur du ma nus pas/ /mched dzasnags spun la mthol 'o( bshags/ /zhes zhus te rje btsun gyis ras pa rnams la dbang dang ngo sprod rgyas par gnang ste/ dbang spolaba'i tshogs gral du ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis rje btsun la/ ras chung pa rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i skyes bu gsang yum bzhes pa la/— rje btsun gyis kyang thugs rjes gzigs datre sa shing / ras chung pa yang bshags pa 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ dus tshod gnang bshag shes dgos pa yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bka' drin can mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rang rgyud lam du phebs par byin gyis rlobs/ /slob ma'i

ra༅༅/ /rgyud tshod shes par thugs rjes zungs/ /chos la dus tshod med na rnal 'gror 'chal ba yin/ /gtam la zlo dus med na mi rgan 'chal ba yin/ /zas la ster tshod med na mo btsun 'chal ba yin/ /las la byed dus med na 'khor g.yog 'chal ba yin/ /dgra dang 'phrad dus med na dpa' bo 'chal ba yin/ /rkyen dang phrad dus med na btsun po 'chal ba yin/ /sdug bsngal byung dus med na phan 'dogs 'chal ba yin/ /sgom la snying rus med na ri phug 'chal ba yin/ /gcig phan gcig la med na grogs mched 'chal ba yin/ /ci gsung tshad mar mi 'dzin dpon slob 'chal ba yin/ /lar 'chal tshul bshad na bsam mi khyab/ /ci gsung nyams su longs shig bu slob rnams/ /zhes gsungs pas kun nges shes skyes so/ /de nas ras chung pas bla ma'i bka' gang gnang ba sgrub par dam bcas nas zhabs tog la brtson par yodi pa'i mnal lam du/ khyi gcig la

bal gyi khal bkal nas yi ge 'dri/ 'o dod 'bod cing phyin pas la kha gcig la mi brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kyis phar bskyal/ brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kyis tshur bsu ba zhig rmis nas ci yin zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /khyi ni grogs dang ldan pa ste/ /rgyud ni bal las 'jam pa yin/ /yi ge tha snyad don la mkhas/ /nyams myong 'o dod glu ru len/ /skyel bsu brgyad cu brgyad nas 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang nub gcig gi rmi lam du gos phud nas chus bkrus/ bya zhig tu gyur nas 'phur te shing khar babs nas me long la lta ba rnams rmis zhus pas/ chos brgyad tshe 'di'i gos bzhus nas/ /gdams pa dri med chu yis 'khrud/ /byams dang snying rje'i bya lus la/ /tshogs gnyis ldan pa'i gshog btags 'phur/ /babs pa byang chub shing rtser babs/ /me long mkha' 'gro'i brda ston 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /yang nub gcig gi rmi lam du bong bu zhig la kha phyin ci log tu zhon

ra༅༅wa/ /nas re ba'i gos gyen pa rmis pa rje ba.oṃ la zhus pas/ theg chen bong bu'i rta wo pa/ /'khor ba dag la rgyab phyogs te/ /myang 'das mdun du bsu bar byed/ /re ba kun gyi re gnas pa/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang nub gcig gi rmi lam du nor bu mgo thog tu bzhag /ras dri ma med pa lus la gyoni/ me long g.ya' dag pa zhig la blta/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa zas kyis bkang ba bsnams/ pad+ma'i gdan la skyil krung bcas/ rgyab tu 'od 'khyil/ lus la me dpung 'bar/ mdun du chu mig brdol/ snying la nyi zla shar/ g.yon phyogs na skyes pa dang bud med mang po gzhibs 'dug /g.yas phyogs na lu gu gcig dang re'u tshan zhig skyong zhing 'dug pas/ lu gu gcig po de mang du 'phel ba rmis te rje btsun la zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas 'di ltar yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /nor bu bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /bka' brgyud

ras dkar dri med la/ /snyan brgyud ngo sprod me long blta/ /phyag g.yas rdo rjes rnam rtog 'droms/ /g.yon pa bde stong nyams myong skyong / /pad gdan nyes pa'i skyon ma gos/ /skyil krung rtse gcig ting 'dzin gnas/ /rtogs pa rgyab tu 'od gsal 'khyil/ /drod rtags nyams myong chu mig brdol/ /lus la gtum mo me ltar 'bar/ /nyi zla 'od gsal ngang du gnas/ /g.yone du skyes pa bud med gral/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i gdan 'dren 'byung / /g.yas phyogs re'u lug rang 'khor skyong / /lu gu 'phel bas snyan brgyud dar/ /de ltar 'ong ba yin pas da khyed nga'i sar sdod mi dgos par 'dug pas songs shig /gdul bya dus la bab pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub bo gsungs nas zhal gdams mgur du gsungs pa/ bu gcig gsod dang ras chung pa/ /khyod 'khor 'das rkyen la rag las pas/ /bla ma dam pa bsten nus na/ /'bad med gdams pa shugs las

ra༅༅/ /'byung / /bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa/ /khyod yul la chags sems spangs nas ni/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'dzin nus na/ /rtsol med dngos grub shugs las 'byung / /las ngan 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba can/ /nor la chags sems spangs nas kyang / /chags med zhen med byed nus na/ /bde chen lam sna shugs las 'byung / /bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa/ /'khor bar skye ba'i rtsa ba can/ /bu tsha'i 'khri ba bcad nas ni/ /rang nyid gcig pur sdod zugan/ /zhing khams rnam dag shugs las 'byung / /bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa/ /da lta dam chos dar lags kyang / /chos 'dra min mang pos bsre bslad byas/ /bla ma slob dpon byed mi mang / /kha bzang 'dod gtam chags par smra/ /brgyud pa bzang rgyu 'doms shig pha yi bu/ /bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa/ /snying nas dam chos mdzad dgongs na/ /chos nyon mongs gnyen por 'gro dgos

pas/ /kha bshad kyi ngo lkog ma che bar/ /zhe phugs kyi skyid 'dod 'bral ba gces/ /bu gcig gsen dang ras chung pa/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid ma bsam par/ /rang sems rtsa ba ma shor bar/ /sgom pa rgyud la brten cig ang / /zhes gsungs nas ras chung pa khyod dang por sdod byas kyang 'gro zhing 'dug /'gro na da song la gnas sham po'i gangs byar po'i nags lo ro'i rdo bod kyi metshams su sems can gyi don gyis shig ces mgur 'di gsungs so/ /pha nga yi bu chen ras chung pa/ /dbu ru bod kyi yul du songs/ /bu bzhi'i nang na r+pā po khyod/ /bla ma spyi bor sgom zhing songs/ /brgyud pa rnams kyi sras bu khyod/ /dam tshig yengs med bsrung zhing songs/ /snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i sgroni me khyodi/ /ma rig mun pa sel zhing songs/ /skal ldan rnams la spel zhing songs/ /skal med rnams la gsang zhing songs/ /bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzugs shing

pas/ /kha bshad kyi ngo lkog ma che bar/ /zhe phugs kyi skyid 'dod 'bral ba gces/ /bu gcig gsen dang ras chung pa/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid ma bsam par/ /rang sems rtsa ba ma shor bar/ /sgom pa rgyud la brten cig ang / /zhes gsungs nas ras chung pa khyod dang por sdod byas kyang 'gro zhing 'dug /'gro na da song la gnas sham po'i gangs byar po'i nags lo ro'i rdo bod kyi metshams su sems can gyi don gyis shig ces mgur 'di gsungs so/ /pha nga yi bu chen ras chung pa/ /dbu ru bod kyi yul du songs/ /bu bzhi'i nang na r+pā po khyod/ /bla ma spyi bor sgom zhing songs/ /brgyud pa rnams kyi sras bu khyod/ /dam tshig yengs med bsrung zhing songs/ /snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i sgroni me khyodi/ /ma rig mun pa sel zhing songs/ /skal ldan rnams la spel zhing songs/ /skal med rnams la gsang zhing songs/ /bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzugs shing

ra༅༅/ /songs/ /skal ldan thugs rjes 'dzin zhing songs/ /lho phyogs zur kha 'grims shing songs/ kham po'i gangs la sgom du songs/ /rdo bod mtshams su dgon pa thob/ /ces gsungs pas ras chung pa 'byon pa'i chas mdzad nas/ rje btsun la phyag phul te zhu don 'di dbyangs su phul 'o// /pha yi bu chen ras chung pa/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin dbus su 'gro/ /ras chung dbus su 'gro ba la/ /rdo rje'i sku yis byin gyis rlobs/ /tshangs pa'i gsung gis bar chad sol/ /rtogs med thugs kyis lam sna drongs/ /pha rje btsun sku khams bde bar mdzod/ /bu ras chung dbus su 'gro ba la/ /bka' drin gyi skyel ma da dung mdzod/ /nga song dus su rin po che/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /'gro ba'i mgon po bde bar bzhugs/ /mngon shes rig pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /chos kyi spyan can bde bar bzhugs/ /sku drin 'khor med rin po che/ /ma rig mun

sel bde bar bzhugs/ /mjal ba done ldan mthu stobs can/ /byang chub lam mkhan bde bar bzhugs/ /zhes zhus pas rje btsun gyis ras chung pa'i rdzongs su lta sgom spyode pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bu lta ba phyogs ris ma byed ang / /sgom pa ri khrod zungs shig ang / /spyod pa grogs ngan spongs shig ang / /dam tshig snang ba stun cig ang / /'bras bu 'chi ba soms shig ang / /yang bu khyod kyi shing mo yos kyi lo rta'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi tshun la 'dir sleb par gyis shig /dgos pa chen po yod do gsung /gser dum zhig dang snying la 'phrod pa'i zhal ta mang du gnang bas/ ras chung pa bla ma dang 'bral ma phod rung / bla ma'i bka' byung bas dbus phyogs su 'gro dgos par kho thag chod nas/ spyan chab bsil zhing smone lam zhal mjal 'di dgrangs su phul lo/ /rgya gar gyi chu dang bal po'i chu/ /lung pa'i dbang gis so so yang / /chu bo'i ngang du ro gcig

༄༄/ོri'i /rdzus/'i/rgya malhu klong du ṭājaldu te zlochi/ khor nasna 'aṣ+ṭa ba'i khri gadh+rags dang / /n+d+rab naswā rdos pa'i zla ba spus/ /sding tsolti dbang gidī so so rdzung 'i/ /'ad sh+yar snro ngang du ra ga༄ga sdig/ /dgung spran zid rngi ngang du zijadī tasducha/ /rgyal ba' thugs dang 'gra drug ga sams/ /ma n+d+rag dbazlo gas sa sa yang / /'imazi kyi kya ngang du n+d+ra gcag pas/ོ/chazlo dgrangs ngaze du ṭājal ta mcha/ /pha n+d+ra ba'in ra laḍizhuṭ+wāṃs pa dang /nga/bdug ras chung rgyal khams bskar ba gnyam/snyu/ lus dbadā gas sa sayarda/tsu/nāsasku'aṭīX sa ra gcag pa/tshe/ /'ag maX gnas sngi mjal ta mcha/ri/pha rja ban skyu khams sdu bdār bzhugs/ /bdag ras chung dbus su 'gra bar zhu/ /zhas spyas nas rja ban gya zhabs spya bar blangs nas sman lam mang pa btab sta/dbus la phabs nas byar pa nags kya dgan par bzhugs dus lha lcam bzhags pa 'bul du byung bas/thag

mar mjal kha mi gnang ba ltar mdzad kyang rjes su thugs rje che ba dang / rin chen grags zhu nan che bas mjal kha gnang ste/ dbul zhing phongs pas 〉sna gsum sdag bsngal ba'i rnam par 'dug pa la tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khrungs te spyan chab gaskurdzo bas gser gyi gnang sbyin dang bcas te mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /skyes mchog mi la'i zhabs la gserdzol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin yang yang dran no thugs rjes zungs/ /khyod sngar dang mi 'dra gleng mo bzhun/ /nga bla ma'i drung du mjal ba'i tshe/ /'o skol 'thab gzhi'i g.yu mo che/ /maṇ+ḍal steng na bzhag nas gda'/ /de mthong bas kho bo ba spu g.yos/ /sngar dbus la ma 'gro ma 'gro gsung / /da dbus la songs shig songs shig gsung / /de dran zhing kho bo ngo mtshar skyes/ /pha rje btsun de yi rnam thar la/ /gser dang sa rdo khyad par med/ /gser 'di khyer cig khyer cig gsung / /de dran cing kho bo yi rangs skyes/ /pha yis gnang ba'i

ra༅༄)/— / gser 'di la/ /sangs rgyas sku 'dra mang du bzhengs/ /de lus kyi sgrib pa 'dag pa yin/ /gzungs sngags cho ga mang du thon/ /des ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong ba yin/ /mchod rten tsha tsha mang du thob/ /des yid kyi sgrib pa 'dag pa yin/ /nang du rang sems dpang por zhog /don du snyan brgyud gdams ngag sgoms/ /yang yang rje la gsol ba thob/ /skabs su 'grod pa yang yang skyed/ /de ltar mdzod dang don chen 'grub/ /ces gsungs nas lha lcam dang zhang gnyis ka brtse bas rjes su bzung ste/ snyan brgyad kyi gdams ngag gnang sgom du bcug pas zhang mdze nad las grol/ lha lcam la nyams rtogs bzang po skyes nas gzhan la phan pa'i rnal 'gyor ma bzang mo shig byung ba yin skarde/ dbus bzhud phyi ma'i skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi laras pa de nyid brin lha bro na yon bdag bkra shis brtsegs kyis zhabs tog phul te/ yon bdag mang pos

chos zhus pa'i dus su bkra shis brtsegs kyis rje btsun lags/ 'phral du ni chos bshad pa mang po byed pa 'di yang dga' dga' 'dra mo gda' ste/ bdag rang gis gnyis ka mi 'ong rung rje btsun sgom rang mdzad cing 'dug pas sgom la dad par byung / phugs rang sgom ka dga' ba lags sam zhus pas/ bshad pa rnams kyang sgom gyi phyir du gsungs shing bslabs pa yin pas ma bsgoms shing nyams su ma blangs na don med gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes serdzo/ /lar ma bsgoms bshad pa'i chos 'di nga rgyal yin/ /ma gserdzos rnyed pa'i bu dag phung 'dre yin/ /ma zhus dpe rul khres po khur ba de/ /lung med khram pa'i gnya' shing ci la phan/ /drang don theg pa'i mgo skor nyan tshe skyid/ /nges don bla ma'i gsung la nyan mkhan med/ /dad ldan yoni bdag bu slob lha chos gyis/ /khrel med khram pa'i kha 'dzin ma byed par/ /nyes med snyom chung gi bden tshig drang por ston/ /zhes gsungs nas

ra༅༅/ /nges par chos byed na mang po bslabs pa bas/ don thog tu dar cig bzhag na phan/ smra ba mang na gong mas 'og ma bsgribs nas yid la mi zin par legs legs mang pos mgo gsor du 'jug /'jig rten 'di la zhen pa ches na chos byas kyang kha chos yin/ yang chos pa la las longs spyod sna re la bltas nas yoni tan re re la khengs sems bskyed nas dam pa gong ma'i yod tan la mi dad na byin rlabs mi 'jug go/ /chos long yod sems la byas na long med par shi na ji ltar byed/ shes tshad kyi kha nang du bltas nas nyams len byed dgos/ bshad sgom gnyis gcig tu ma dril na mang po shes par byas nas bsgom dgos bsams te/ shes bya'i mtha' la chod dus med/ lar jo bo chos phyug po zhig dang gleng mo byas na mi dgos pa gcig kyang med de/ gdams ngag zab mo mang na gang sgrub ngo mi shes/ bsgrubs kyang gcig la rtags ma byung bas gzhan e drag

ra༅༅/ /nges par chos byed na mang po bslabs pa bas/ don thog tu dar cig bzhag na phan/ smra ba mang na gong mas 'og ma bsgribs nas yid la mi zin par legs legs mang pos mgo gsor du 'jug /'jig rten 'di la zhen pa ches na chos byas kyang kha chos yin/ yang chos pa la las longs spyod sna re la bltas nas yoni tan re re la khengs sems bskyed nas dam pa gong ma'i yod tan la mi dad na byin rlabs mi 'jug go/ /chos long yod sems la byas na long med par shi na ji ltar byed/ shes tshad kyi kha nang du bltas nas nyams len byed dgos/ bshad sgom gnyis gcig tu ma dril na mang po shes par byas nas bsgom dgos bsams te/ shes bya'i mtha' la chod dus med/ lar jo bo chos phyug po zhig dang gleng mo byas na mi dgos pa gcig kyang med de/ gdams ngag zab mo mang na gang sgrub ngo mi shes/ bsgrubs kyang gcig la rtags ma byung bas gzhan e drag

bsams nas 'grub dus med pas/ serdzo ma zhig slob ring la de gong shes pa brjed nas byis pa'i lag gi me tog dang 'dra zhes gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /yang nyon dang yon bdag dad pa can/ /las bden pa'i stobs de mi shes par/ /sdig can thar pa thob tu re/ /lo zla zhag song ba tshe la gzan/ /mi skyid pa lo zla song na dga'/ /nam zla e bzang e bzang zer/ /mi tshe song ba mi shes pa/ /blun po mi yi rnam dasad yin/ /khyed nges par dam chos mdzad dgongs na/ /mchod pa zhing sa dag la phul/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la zhus/ /zhabs tog bla ma rje la gyis/ /zhe sa pha ma gnyis la gyis/ /sbyin pa lan po med la thong / /phan 'dogs ma nus pa la gyis/ /rang rgyud chos dang bstun la spyod/ /chos nyams len byed na mang mi dgos/ /khas len mang po rdzun pa yin/ /de bzhin rgyud la e 'gyor ltos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ yang khong rnams na re de

ra༅༅/ /rnams bordzo sla la sems la phan par byung bas bka' bzhin sgrub par zhu/ da dung bdag cag rnams kyi blo tshod dang sbyar nas gang legs kyi chos dang zhal ta re gnang bar zhu zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyed rnams la ngas legs pa'i thabs bshad pa la nyan na mang po yerdzod de mi nyan nam gsungs pas/ cis kyang nyan pas gsung bar zhu zer bas/ 'o na khyed rang rnams la 'di phyi kun tu phan pas 'di ltar byas na legs zhes mgur 'di gsungs so/ /'o na yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /khyed gtan gyi so nam mdzad dgongs na/ /mi nga yi kha la nyan pa na/ /skyes pa thams cad nges par 'chi/ /de phyir dam chos mdzad na legs/ /sgya ma'i nor rdzas bsags kyang lus/ /de phyir sbyin pa btang na legs/ /'jig rten gnyen 'dun zab kyang 'bral/ /de phyir gnyis med bsgoms na legs/ //sgya ma'i sa mkhor brtsigs kyang 'jig /de phyir dben pa bsten na

legs/ /khams kyi bza' btung sris kyang 'dzad/ /de phyir tshogs gsog mdzad na legs/ /'dus byas las la zin pa med/ /de phyir bya ba btang na legs/ /bre mo'i gtam la zad pa med/ /de bas smra ba bcad na legs/ /gdams ngag pags pa snam skud 'dra/ /bla ma mkhas pa bsten na legs/ /nyams khyodang mun pa zla shar 'dra/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsgoms na legs/ /nges pa don gyi mdo don bcu/ /rnal 'gyor ras pa'i blo la shar/ /brin pa pho mo'i chos skal mdzod/ /ces gsungs nas yon bdag pho mo rnams la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bsngo ba smen lam gnang bas thams cad chos la snang ba 'gyur te/ de'i nang nas sgom byed mkhan yang mang po byung bas nyams skyes pa yang kha re byung ngo / /bkra shis brtsegs kyi skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid brin gyi brag mkhar na bzhugs dus mdzes se dang khu byug la sogs te nya ma'i yoni bdag kun gyis

ra༅༅/ /chos zhus pa las/ thon pa'i nyin par mdzes se 'bum gyis de ring 'dir tshogs kun la go bde ba'i chos shig gnang bar zhu zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyis de byed khyed rang rnams rna ba gtod la nyon cig gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes so/ /pha drin mchog mar pas byin gyis rlobs/ /dad 'dus kyi snang ba chos la bsgrar/ /ma yengs dar cig gsan par zhu/ /khyed pho rab rnams la chos shig dgos/ /pho rab rnams la chos med na/ /pho dang bya rgyal rgod po 'dra/ /sdod sa mtho yang don go rtsung / /pho 'bring de la chos shig dgos/ /pho 'bring de la chos med na/ /kho dang rgya stag khra bo 'dra/ /dpa' rtsal che yang don go chung / /pho tha ma de la chos shig dgos/ /pho tha ma de la chos med na/ /khodang tshong pa'i bong rgan 'dra/ /khur theg che yang don go chung / /mo rab rnams la chos shig dgos/ /mo rab de la chos med na/ /mo dang lha khang logs ris 'dra/ /

gzugs byad legs kyang don go chung / /mo 'bring de la chos shig dgos/ /mo 'bring de la chos med na/ /mo dang byi ba smug chung 'dra/ /gsog skrun mkhas kyang don go chung / /mo tha ma de la chos shig dgos/ /mo tha ma de la chos med na/ /mo dang a ce wa mo 'dra/ /cam cam mang yang don go chung / /khyed rgas 'khogs rnams la chos shig dgos/ /rgas 'khogs rnams la chos med na/ /sngerdzong po khong nas rul ba yin/ /stag shar rnams la chos shig dgos/ /stag shar rnams la chos med na/ /glang la 'khor gsum btags pa yin/ /dman shar rnams la chos shig dgos/ /dman shar rnams la chos med na/ /ba la nor bu btags pa yin/ /gzhon pa rnams la chos shig dgos/ /gzhon pa rnams la chos med na/ /dug gi me tog rgyas pa yin/ /byis pa rnams la chos shig dgos/ /byis pa rnams la chos med na/ /the'u rang sris la rku ba yin/ /gang ltar byas rung chos

ra༅༅/ /med na/ /don go yod pa gcig kyang med/ /don go yod pa mdzad dgongs na/ /thams cad dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ yon bdag mo khu byug na re/ rje btsun grwa pa bu slob 'di tsam zhig yod kyang da dung ri khrod la gcig pur bzhugs pa rang la dgyes par gda' ba/ de grogs bzang po gzhan zhig yod pa lags sam zhus pas yod gsung / ji 'dra yod lags zhus pas/ 'di 'dra yod gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes so/ /pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nged rnal 'gror ri khrod 'grim pa la/ /grogs bzang po nyi shu rtsa gcig bdog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /gsol ba 'debs pa'i grogs su bzang / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /skyabs gnas zhu ba'i grogs su bzang / /mdo dang rgyud dang bstan bcos gsum/ /slob gnyer byed pa'i grogs su bzang / /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum/ /thabs

ra༅༅/ /med na/ /don go yod pa gcig kyang med/ /don go yod pa mdzad dgongs na/ /thams cad dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ yon bdag mo khu byug na re/ rje btsun grwa pa bu slob 'di tsam zhig yod kyang da dung ri khrod la gcig pur bzhugs pa rang la dgyes par gda' ba/ de grogs bzang po gzhan zhig yod pa lags sam zhus pas yod gsung / ji 'dra yod lags zhus pas/ 'di 'dra yod gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes so/ /pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nged rnal 'gror ri khrod 'grim pa la/ /grogs bzang po nyi shu rtsa gcig bdog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /gsol ba 'debs pa'i grogs su bzang / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /skyabs gnas zhu ba'i grogs su bzang / /mdo dang rgyud dang bstan bcos gsum/ /slob gnyer byed pa'i grogs su bzang / /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum/ /thabs

lam sgom pa'i grogs su bzang / /bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum/ /mnyam par 'jog pa'i grogs su bzang / /dag snang mos gus snying rje gsum/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su bzang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gsum/ /bar chad sel ba'i grogs su bzang / /zhes gsungs pas/ yang mo na re ngo mtshar che bar gda'/ grogs rnams dang 'grogs nas thugs dam mdzad tshe dper bgyis na ji lta bu zhig 'ong zhing gda' lags zhus pas/ 'di 'dra zhig 'ong zhing 'dug gsungs nas mgur 'di bzhes so/ /rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas/ /sgra sgyur mar pa yan chad rdzi /grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs serdzo byin gyis rlobs/ /nga spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ /sgrub brgyud bla ma bzhugs pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /mu tig bstar la brgyus pa 'dra/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs blo re bde/ /nga rgyab rten dkon mchog gsum la byas/ /thugs

ra༅༅/ /rjes yengs med skyong ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /bu gces pang na 'tsho ba 'dra/ /skyo ngal med pa blo re bde/ /nga g.yas na dpa' bos byin brlabs pa/ /mi mthun rkyen rnams sel ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /mtshon snan klad la bskor ba 'dra/ /'gal rkyen med pa blo re bde/ /g.yon na dpa' mos byin brlabs pa/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis ster ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /ma sring byams mas bskor ba 'dra/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba blo re bde/ /nga mdun na chos skyong dam la 'du/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /bran g.yog las la 'gyed pa 'dra/ /ci bsam 'grub pa blo re bde/ /nga chos nyid lta ba'i rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /theg dman zil gyis gnon pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /seṅge gangs la 'gro ba 'dra/ /nyam nga med pa blo re bde/ /sgom pa thabs shes gzhog phrug

ra༅༅/ /rjes yengs med skyong ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /bu gces pang na 'tsho ba 'dra/ /skyo ngal med pa blo re bde/ /nga g.yas na dpa' bos byin brlabs pa/ /mi mthun rkyen rnams sel ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /mtshon snan klad la bskor ba 'dra/ /'gal rkyen med pa blo re bde/ /g.yon na dpa' mos byin brlabs pa/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis ster ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /ma sring byams mas bskor ba 'dra/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba blo re bde/ /nga mdun na chos skyong dam la 'du/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /bran g.yog las la 'gyed pa 'dra/ /ci bsam 'grub pa blo re bde/ /nga chos nyid lta ba'i rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /theg dman zil gyis gnon pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /seṅge gangs la 'gro ba 'dra/ /nyam nga med pa blo re bde/ /sgom pa thabs shes gzhog phrug

rgyas/ /chos nyid mkha' la lding ba de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /rgod po nam 'phang chod pa 'dra/ /ltung dogs med pa blo re bde/ /nga spyod pa sems la ngar 'don pa/ /bying rmugs sel ba'i gra 'dzum rgyas/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /rgya stag nags la rgya ba 'dra/ /'jigs skrag med pa :sna re bde/ /nga 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du gyur/ /sprul skus 'gro jon byed pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /nya gser mig chu la rtse ba 'dre/ /skyo ngal med pa blo re bde/ /nga skabs su rtogs pa'i dbyangs chung len/ /snang ba zil gyis gnyon pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /g.yu 'grug mab/ 'a la sgra sgrog 'dra/ /zhum pa med pa blo re bde/ /rnal 'gyor mi la ras pa nga / /ri khrod phyogs med 'grim pa de/ /dper na ci 'dra bgyis tsa na/ /ri la gnas pa'i ri dwags 'dra/ /'jigs pa med pa blo re bde/ /bde bde 'dra nas byas pa yin/ /glu dpe lnga don dang drug po 'di/ /khrom

ra༅༅/ /kho re bzhugs pa'i lha mi tsho/ /thugs ma yengs snyan gyi dbang po gtod/ /bsam mno rang gi sems la thong / /'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam zhig mdzod/ /bkra shis chos mthun smed lam 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas kun yid tshim nas dge ba la brtson par gyur cing / de rnams kyi nang nas gzhon pa 'ga' rje btsun gyi phyag phyir 'brangs pa la dbang dang gdams ngag gnang / sgom du bcug pas rtogs ldan re re byung ba lags so/ /mdzes se dang khu byug la sogs brin gyi nya ma spyi'i skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid brag dmar spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong na bzhugs dus/ brin ra lung gi nya ma rnams mjal du byung bas/ bdag cag rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams re gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyed rnams la chos dbosgos na nga bzhin chos 'gal rnams spangs na legs pas 〈snangs shig

ra༅༅/ /kho re bzhugs pa'i lha mi tsho/ /thugs ma yengs snyan gyi dbang po gtod/ /bsam mno rang gi sems la thong / /'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam zhig mdzod/ /bkra shis chos mthun smed lam 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas kun yid tshim nas dge ba la brtson par gyur cing / de rnams kyi nang nas gzhon pa 'ga' rje btsun gyi phyag phyir 'brangs pa la dbang dang gdams ngag gnang / sgom du bcug pas rtogs ldan re re byung ba lags so/ /mdzes se dang khu byug la sogs brin gyi nya ma spyi'i skor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid brag dmar spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong na bzhugs dus/ brin ra lung gi nya ma rnams mjal du byung bas/ bdag cag rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams re gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyed rnams la chos dbosgos na nga bzhin chos 'gal rnams spangs na legs pas 〈snangs shig

gsungs pas/ chos 'gal gang lags de ka gsung du gsol zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /kwa ye gsoni dang nya ma tsho/ /zin pa med pa'i las dang gcig /mgu med ngo srung 'di dang gnyis/ /skyo ngal med pa'i long gtam gsum/ /de gsum dam pa'i chos dang 'gal/ /mi nga yis de gsum rgyab tu bskyar/ /khyed kyang rgyab tu bskyar na legs/ /bdag tu bzung ba'i gnas dang gcig /kha lan re ba'i tshogs dang gnyis/ /ngo srung dgos pa'i g.yog dang gsum/ /de gsum dem pa'i chos dang 'gal/ she/mi nga yis de gsum rgyab tu bskyar/ /khyod kyang rgyab tu bskyar na legs/ /slob dpon mkhyen rgya chung dang gcig /slob ma dad pa med dang gnyis/ /dam tshig mi bsrung mched grogs gsum/ /de gsum dam༄ pa'i chos dang 'gal/ /rmo nga yis de gsum rgyab tu bskyar/ /khyed kyang rgyab tu bskyar na legs/ /bza' tsho rgyun du 'thab dang gcig /dgra bu tsha lus

ra༅༅/ /las chad dang gnyis/ /bskyangs shing 'khang ba'i 'khor g.yog gsum/ /de gsum dam pa'i chos dang 'gal/ /mi nga yis de gsum rgyab tu bskyar/ /khyod kyang rgyab tu bskyar na legs/ /zhes gsungs pas nya ma rnams dad bzhin song ngo / /de nas lan gcig rje btsun rlung zhig gis bskyod nas g.yang chen po zhig la lharjo ba dang / shing sdong ska laX grug pa ltar mdzad pas/ bu slob rnams sems las su song ba'i tshe/ rma med pa'i sku dngos bstan nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rlung gi rkyen rgyos g.yos pa las/ /tsums med shing gi gnod pa yis/ /'bras kyi zug rngu mi bzod pa/ /sman sbyor mkha' 'gro ma rnams byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang lan gcig rje btsun spo mtho'i brag de la lcang ba ltar mdzad byon pas/ bu slob rnams kyis pur gdan 'dren du phyin pa'i tshe/ bzhad cing bzhugs 'dug pa la ci lags zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs

so/ /zung 'jug thang dkar gzhog rgyangs nas/ /'phur ba brag dmar rtse nas 'phur/ /babs pa rong khung shod du babs/ /byas pa 'khor la bre mo byas/ /grol ba 'khor 'das gnyis su grol/ /'phrod pa bde stong rang ngo 'phrod/ /ces gsungs so / /yang lan gcig brag chen po zhig gi 'gram na bzhugs dus/ bud med gcig 'ongs nas 'dir ma bzhugs yang yang zer rung bzhugs pas/ brag de nyil byung bas lta stangs dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pas phyogs phyogs la 'thor/ bu slob rnams kyis rje btsun sku nong snyam phyin pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rnal 'gyor lus kyi me tog 'di/ /srog 'joms brag dmar gshed ma yis/ /bdud las mkha' 'gro ma yis drangs/ /nga ni bdud kyis khyer snyam med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas slob ma rnams kyis rje btsun brag nyil ba/ g.yang la byon pa/ sku shing gis phug pa rnams kyis mi skyon pa ci lags zhus pas/ phung

ra༅༄/ /po 'ja' lus su gyur/ nyon mongs ye shes su gyur/ ma skyes par shes pas mi 'chi bar thag chod/ chos brgyad rlung la bskur bas/ bdud bzhi kha skengs su bcug pa'i rtags yin gsung / 'o na bdud bzhi las rgyal ba lags sam zhus pas/ yin du'ang rung zhing / da phyin nga'i brgyud pa bcu gsum tshun la bdud kyis mi hūṃgs pa yin gsung ngo / /de nas rje btsun gyi drung du dbus phyogs kyi sngags pa zhig mjal du byung bas/ de la se ban ras pa na re/ khyed kyi dbus phyogs na grub thob ci 'dra yod zer bas/ mi ma yin gyis zhabs tog byed pa yod zer bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ de rang gis grub thob tu mi 'gro gsung ba la/ se ban na re/ rje btsun la yang yod lags sam zhus pas/ nga la 'di 'dra yod gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod lta bu/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi g.yos skol gyis/ /bkres skom zas kyi 'dun

pa dang / /bral bar mkha' 'gro ma rnams byed/ /de yang grub thob yin snyam med/ /ces gsungs pas/ sngags pa na re/ yi dam gyi zhal mthong ba yang yod lags sam zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /sems kyi ngo bo mthong gyur cing / /ma rig mun pa sangs pas na/ /zhal dag mkha' 'gro mas kyang stoni/ /chos nyid klong la lta rgyu med/ /dmigs med yid la mi byed cing / /rang nyid rang byung rang gsal sgo /chos rnams mkha' 'gro ma yis gsung / /bla ma'i gsung las gnyan pa med/ /mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i/ /dgos pa thams cad tshe 'di ru/ /'grub ces mkha' 'gro mas kyang gsung / /de yang grub thob yin snyam med/ /ces gsungs pas/ kho na re/ sems dpe ji lta bu zhig gis mtshon pa lags zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /sems nyid skye ba med pa 'di/ /dpe ni gang gis mtshon du med/ /sems nyid 'gag pa med pa 'di/ /ma

ra༅༅/ /rtogs pa la dngos kun dpe/ /rtogs pa rnams la sems nyid dpe/ /dpe don gnyis su ma phyed cing / /smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs ngo mtshar che/ /zhes gsungs pas/ kho bag chags sad pas/ rje btsun la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas phyag phyir 'brangs pa la/ dbang dang gdams ngag gnang nas bsgoms pas rtogs ldan khyad par can zhig byung ngo / /bdud bzhi las rgyal ba dang / sngags pa'i zhus lan gyi snyor ro// //na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid chu dbar na bzhugs pa'i dus su rje btsun zhag 'ga' la rigs kyis mi mthong ba dang / la las sku mthong rung zas kyi bya ba sogs mdzad spyod ci yang mi mdzad par mthong ba las/ yang kun gyis rje btsun res bzhums/ res bzhad cing 'dug pa mthong ba'i tshe/ zhi ba 'od kyis rje btsun kha sang nas mthong yang ma mthong / la las mthong yang ting nge

'dzin kho na la bzhugs pa byung 'dug /de bar la ci mdzad/ da res bzhums/ res bzhad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ nga la kha sang nas chos nyan mang po rang zhig byung ba yin te/ de rnams kyi bde ba mthong bas dgod shor/ sdug bsngal mthong bas ngu shor ba yin gsungs pas/ de'i rgyu mtshan ji ltar lags gsung du gsol zhus pas/ 'o na maṇ+ḍal zhig phul gsung / maṇ+ḍal phulanas zhus pas/ ngas kha sang nas rigs drug kun la choso bshad du phyin pa yin te/ lha mi'i bde ba dang dge ba sgrub mkhan rnams la bsams nas dgode shor/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang sdig pa gsog mkhan rnams la bltas nas ngu cerdzor ba yin gsungs pas/ 'o na rigs drug la bde ba dang sdug bsngal ji lta bu mchis/ khyad par lha la bde ba ji lta bu mchis zhus pas/ lha'i bde ba la'ang yid ma ches/ 'dug dag 'di ltar 'dug ste gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje bka'

ra༅༅/ /drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ /byin rlabs sems can yongs la khyab par shog /'jig rten lha dang mi yi bde ba yang / /g.yeng ni lha g.yag bzhin du che zhing 'dug /skad ni g.yu 'brug bzhin du cher bsgrags kyang / /de la snying po mi 'dug ste/ /gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi ni/ /bzang ngan yid la mi dran cing / /'du shes rmugs pas tshor ba med/ /ding sang dbang po brgyal ba bzhin/ /bskal pa mang por grangs rtsis kyang / /skad cig tsam zhig ma rtogs pa'i/ /de la snying po ye ma mchis/ /ltang dus bsam ngan skyes nas ltung / /de yi rgyu rkyen gnas lugs ni/ /stosnang lta kha lta skam pos byung / /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun kyang / /gtsang ma rigs lnga dnge po dang / /'og ma bcu gnyis ltung ba yang / /rgyu 'bras bsod nams ma zad par/ /de yi rgyu rkyen rnam smin yang / /phyogs cha can gyi dge ba dang / /zhe 'jigs can gyi rnyedam chen

dang / /chos brgyad bsgrigs pa'i chos spyodi rnams/ /khas len smras kyang sems ma dag /sa boni bag chags lus pa des/ /yun ring song tshe bsam ngan skyes/ /bsam ngan skyes dus bsode nams zad/ /bsede nams zad pas myur du ltung / /ltung byed lha yi sdug bsngal la/ /zhib tu bshad na snang ba 'grug /de go bar mdzod la sgom yun srings/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bu slob rnams skyo chod pa'i ngang nas/ lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal yang gsung du gsol zhes zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gserdzol ba 'debs/ /byang sems rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobes/ /lha min sdug bsngal mi che ru/ /gdug sems 'khrug pas rang gzhan brlag /sems nyid 'khrug pas rang mgo 'khor/ /tshor ba ngan pas 'du shes rags/ /gang snang dgra ru len pa la/ /bden pa skad cig yod thabs med/ /las ngan rang srog mi phangs par/ /gzhan la

ra༅༅/ /phan sems skye ba dka'/ /rtsod pa las kyis 'khrug 'khrugs pas/ /da dung kha la mi nyan 'dra/ /de yi rgyu rkyen bshad na yang / /rang bde gzhan sdag 'dod pa dang / /gnyen la byams shing dgra la sdang / /nga rgyal rang mthong spyod pa rnams/ /las kyi dbang gis log par skyes/ /lus ngan blangs pas sdig la dga'/ /rnam smin ngan pas 'gro la sdang / /yin patshomin te bya thabs dka'/ /khyed 'dir tshogs sgom yun shi dang snyoms/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nged rang mi rnams kyi sdug bsngal yang gsung du gsol zhes zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'o skol 'gro ba mi yi lus/ /dge sdig gang yang nus pa che/ /de khams drug tshang ba'i nus pa yin/ /khyed mkhas par 'dode pa'i ras chung rnams/ /'gag dang gnad dmigs mi shes na/ /mang po shes zer 'chal

ba yin/ /sems kyi rtsa ba ma rtogs na/ /lo mang sgom zer rdzun ma yin/ /zhing dang bsam pa ma 'brel na/ /rgyu mang po btang yang chud zos yin/ /phyogs med kun la mi phan na / /grerdzogs gang bzang mchode pa kha lan yin/ /gang la gang 'grerdzo mi shes pa'i/ /glen pa'i drang gtam ltung gzhi yin/ /gang la gang phan shes pa na/ /mkhas pas rdzun smras dge ba yin/ /nga la rgyu med zer ba na/ /rmongs pa'i rmongs gtam kun la gnod/ /dge ba sems la shar ba na/ /sa rdo rtsi shing dge ba'i rgyu/ /lar bsam shes mi las lod pa med/ /za 'dod khyi las stogs pa med/ /khrel med na dpon las 'jigs pa med/ khyug po thams cad yod sdug yin/ /dbul po thams ced med sdug yin/ /yod med gnyis ka sdug bsngal yin/ /bu dam chos nus na skyid dang mjal nas 'ong / /de go bar mdzod la yun du sgoms/ /zhes gsungs pas/ yang bu slob rnams na re/ mi lasdug bsngal de

ra༅༅/ /lta bu yod pa dang / rje btsun gyis gsungs pa mthun par 'dug /da ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bshad na bzod glags mi 'dug rung / skal ldan 'ga'i dge bskul du gda' bas/ dpyal bar skye ba'i rgyu dang bcas pa gsung du gaskurdzol zhes zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /skyabs bla ma rnams la gserdzol ba 'debs/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jiges pa sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ kho khrag zas su za byed cing / /gsod gcod las su song ba rnams/ /tsha dpyal brgyad du sreg par byed/ /de yang dge ba ma brjed na/ /thar pa'i dus ni srid par 'dug /zas su mi zas za byed cing / /rang zas lhag mar 'dzin sems pas/ /bcom zhing 'phrog 'joms brgyab pa rnams/ /grang dpyal brgyad du skyetshobar 'dug /chos la log lta ma skyes na/ /thar pa'i gnas skabs bshad par 'dug /daskad mchog yid la dran srid na/ /nam dran dus na thar dus bstan/ /las

ra༅༅/ /lta bu yod pa dang / rje btsun gyis gsungs pa mthun par 'dug /da ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bshad na bzod glags mi 'dug rung / skal ldan 'ga'i dge bskul du gda' bas/ dpyal bar skye ba'i rgyu dang bcas pa gsung du gaskurdzol zhes zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs serdzo/ /skyabs bla ma rnams la gserdzol ba 'debs/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jiges pa sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ kho khrag zas su za byed cing / /gsod gcod las su song ba rnams/ /tsha dpyal brgyad du sreg par byed/ /de yang dge ba ma brjed na/ /thar pa'i dus ni srid par 'dug /zas su mi zas za byed cing / /rang zas lhag mar 'dzin sems pas/ /bcom zhing 'phrog 'joms brgyab pa rnams/ /grang dpyal brgyad du skyetshobar 'dug /chos la log lta ma skyes na/ /thar pa'i gnas skabs bshad par 'dug /daskad mchog yid la dran srid na/ /nam dran dus na thar dus bstan/ /las

ngan yang yang spyad spyad pas/ /sdig sems log pa'i las dbang gis/ /rang nyid bde bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ /pha ma slob dpon gsod byed cing / /dkon mchog dkor nor 'phrog byed dang / /skur pa log pa'i tshig lce smra/ /chos la bden pa med zer ba/ /mnar med dmal ba sreg par byed/ /'di la thar dus dka' mor gda'/ /bu bsam zhing snying rlung ldang bar 'ong / /blo chos la gtod la 'bungs la sgoms/ /zhes gsungs pas/ yang ras pa rnams kyis zhus pa/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal thos pas 'jigs na/ myong na ji ltar 'gyur/ 'on kyang sems can gyi done du yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal yang gsung du gserdzol zhes zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs ses/ /rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa sel bar thugs rjes zungs/ /dpyal ba rang srog gcod spro bas/ /'jigs shing bros pas thar thabs med/ /yi dwags snang ba dgrar langs pas/ /gang la

ra༅༅/ /'bros dang gang la skyabs/ /dud 'gro gcig lagacig za bas/ /su yi le lan su la rtsod/ /khyad par yi dwags sdug bsngal de/ /bsam ngan ser sna can gyis lan/ /yod dus dge ba mi shes shing / /'jungs pas rang gis za mi phod/ /gzhan la ster ba mi srid cing / /yang yang blta zhing gsog pa yis/ /byi ba bzhin du chog shes med/ /rang gis sdug gsog gzhan gyis spyod/ /'chi dus ser sna'i snang bas 'chi/ /bar dor yi dwags snang ba skye/ /snang log las kyis bkres skom spyod/ /gzhan gyi longs spyod spyod mthong na/ /de la ser sna sdug sems skye/ /de yi las kyis yang yang lhung / /nga snying rus can gyi sgom chen gyis/ /yi dwags sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras rnams/ /mi khyod la glu ru blangs pa yin/ /'dir bzhugs ras pa bu slob rnams/ /gtam go bar gyis la sgom yun srings/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhi ba 'od kyis dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal

yang gsung du gsol zhes zhus pa la mgur 'di gsungs se1/ /rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa sel bar thugs rjes zungs/ /dud 'gro mi shes gti mug pa/ /blun po phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu/ /ma rig las ngan nus pa yis/ /chos la bden par ma rtogs shing / /dge sdig bzang ngan ma phyed pas/ /phyam phyam las la mi tshe zad/ /rtag dang rtogs dpyod mi shes shinge / /ha re long bzhin rmugs sbyod mang / /dge dang sdig pa mi shes pas/ /smyon pa bzhin du phung nyes spyod/ /dbugs dbyung dbang po ma skyes pas/ /de la bzang po yin zhes 'khrul/ /lar mi shes sdig pa gsod gcod rnams/ /gcan gzan dud 'gror skye bar mchi/ /bzang ngan med pa'i blun po rnams/ /phal pa'i dud 'gror skye bar mchi/ /bsam pa rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams/ /nam phugs dud 'gror skye ste mchi/ /lar dud 'gro'i rnam smin las rnams la/ /bshad pas lang thabs mi

ra༅༅/ /gda' bas/ /mgo ngo khug la sems rtsal sbyongs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ yang ras pa rnams kyis rje btsun gyi rigs drug la chos sa gcil /re bzhugs nas gsungs sam/ so sor byon nas gsungs zhus pas/ ngas kun gyi sar rang rang gi skal ba dang mthun pa'i lus bstan nas/ blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos bshad gsungs pas/ der 'dus pa'i grwa pa bu slob nya ma dang bcas pa'i chos nyan kun 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs te/ dam pa'i chos la snang ba 'gyur nas/ sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa la brtson par gyur to/ /de nas yang lan gcig gi tshe rje btsun nam mkhar byon nas/ sku du mar snang ba dang / gcig tu sdud pa dang / sku mi snang ba'i gsung sna tshogs kyis chos gsung ba dang / rdzu 'phrul dpag med bstan pa'i tshe/ se ban ras pas kyang rlung bzung ste/ nam mkhar 'phur bas rkang pa sa la ma reg por 'gro ba tsam las ma

byung bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga bzhin bla ma'i mosnas gus/ 'khor ba la zhen 'ordzog /sems can la snying rje/ mched grerdzogs la dag snang / nyams len la brtsoni 'grus rnams ma byas pa'i 'bad med kyi grub rtags 'di ma re mdzod/ gzhan yang bu slob rnams rgyu dge ba 'di lta bu ma byas pa'i 'bras bu bde legs 'di ma re mdzod ces mgur 'di gsungs so/ /las 'phro dang rkyen du ma 'dzom pa'i/ /tshe gcig gis byang chub 'di ma re mdzod/ /rang blo bla ma la mi gtod par/ /tshur la thugs 'dogs 'di ma re mdzod/ /rang rgyud slob mar mi sgrub par/ /gzhan gyi slob dpon 'di ma re mdzod/ /rang blo rang gis mi thub par/ /gzhan gyi blo gtad 'di ma re mdzod/ /brgyud pa rnal mar mi 'dzin pa'i/ /grub rtags dngos grub 'di ma re mdzod/ /sgom sgyab drag pos ma bcun par/ /yid smon gyi byang chub 'di ma re mdzod/ /rang zhen 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dang ma bral bar/ /

ra༅༅/ /phyogs med kyi thugs rje 'di ma re mdzod/ /dngos 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dang ma bral bar/ /mtha' bral gyi lta ba 'di ma re mdzod/ /cer mthong gi ngo sprod mi mnga' bar/ /don ngo 'o mthong ba 'di ma re mdzod/ /dri ma sel thabs mi shes par/ /sgom rgyun chad med pa 'di ma re mdzod/ /'khri ba nang nas ma chod par/ /tshogs drug lhug pa 'di ma re mdzod/ /nyamās ting 'dzin gyi bdar sha ma chod par/ /khyab gdal chen po 'di ma re mdzod/ /re dogs phra mo ma chod par/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'di ma re mdzod/ /rgyu 'bras rnal mar mi rtsi ba'i/ /gnas skabs kyi bde 'bras 'di ma re mdzod/ /tshogs gnyis rtse sperdzod du ma bsags par/ /stosnas mchog gi sangs rgyas 'di ma re mdzod/ /bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin mi nyan pa'i/ /mched lcam mnyes pa 'di ma re mdzod/ /rang rig dbang du ma 'dus pa'i/ /lha med 'dre med 'di ma re mdzod/ /snang ba dbang du

ma 'dus pa'i/ /srid gsum zil gnyone 'di ma re mdzod/ /rang rgyud tha mal las ma 'phags pa'i/ /las dge sdig med pa 'di ma re mdzod/ /dgone pa 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa po/ /rang sems dkar nag med pa 'di ma re mdzod/ /nyams rtogs drodi tshad mi shes pa'i/ /skal ldan gsal 'debs 'di ma re mdzod/ /gdams ngag gi sbyangs pa mi ldan par/ /bar dor grol ba 'di ma re mdzod/ /bslab sdom tshul bzhin mi bsrung bar/ /gyur shog gi smon lam 'di ma re mdzod/ /dam tshig gtsang ma mi bsrung bar/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong mnyes pa 'di ma re mdzod/ /lung rigs gdams ngag mi ldan pa'i/ /tha snyad chu la ma brgal mdzod/ /mngon shes lnga dang mi ldan pa'i/ /kha phyir bltas kyi zhal lce 'di ma re mdzod/ /sgom yengs su med par ma rtogs par/ /rang rgyud yal bar ma btang mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang lan gcig gi tshe/ rje btsun gyi drung du grwa pa su phyin kyang sku

ra༅༅/ /dngos mi snang bar/ gzims mal du la las 'edi/ la las mar me/ la las 'ja' tshon/ la las chu/ la las gser sbram bu/ la las rlung g.yo ba/ la las ci yang mi snang ba rnams byung bas/ ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis de ltar 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ de 'di ltar yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus rnam 'phrul mang bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bu nyon cig ras chung bzhin legs po/ /nga 'byung ba sa la dbang thob pas sa yang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /nga 'byung ba chu la dbang thob pas/ /chu yang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /nga 'byung ba me la dbang thob pas me yang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /nga 'byung ba rlung la dbang thob pas/ /rlung yang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /nam mkha'i stong nyid 'grongs tsa na/ /snang srid nga dang dbyer med 'dres/ /lus sems snang ba'i dbang thob pas /

ci ru sprul yang 'grub par 'dug /rdzu 'phrul lus kyi bkod pa la/ /khyed mos pa bskyed la gsol ba thob/ /rje grub thob rnams kyi byin rlabs 'jug khes gsungs so/ /yang nyin gcig rang la/ bu slob dang dad can gyi nya ma pho mo rnams kyi mdun du/ chos gsung mkhan re re dang / byis pa rnams kyi sar rtsed grogs re re ste/ mdor na sku'i sprul pa sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pas/ bu slobe rnams kyis rje btsun la de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ nga rnal 'gror pa sems kyi rang mtshang rig pas/ phyi rol gyisnang ba 'di la kha lo gang myur yin zhing / rang gi sems la spro bsdu ci byas kyang chog gsungs name mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs/༄/lus rdzu 'phrul 'grub pa sprulpopa'i sku/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ /ngag glu dbyangs len pas gdams ngag stod/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs/ /

ra༅༅/ /sems rtogs pa thob pas sangs rgyas 'grub/ /nga mes mi tshig cing chus mi khyer/ /spyod pa glang hān 'gros kyi gar/ /dag pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la / /tha dad kyi snang ba so so yis/ /nga yi sku mthong gsung thos shing / /bsode nams bsags pas nga mthong grol/ /ma dag 'gro ba las ngan gyis/ /nga yi lus kyang mi mthong zhing / /sdig pas sdug bsngal spyodi pa la/ /sangs rgyas mthu yis mi phan pas/ /khyed rnams choso la 'bungs shig ang / /ngas ni bshad kyang thug pa med/ /a tsa ma sdig can rnams snying re rje/ /log spyod mkhan thar mtha' mi gda' na/ /sdug bsngal mthong bas snying rlung langs/ /nged rang tsho sgom yun srings shig ang / /tshe 'dir 'di byed ma bsams par/ /phyi ma tsug yod bsam par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bu slob rnams dga' spro dpag tu med pa thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mor mdzad

cing / sems can rnams gnas skabs dang / mthar thug gi bde ba la bskardzod pa yin no// //rnal 'gyor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa de nyid kyis/ mnyam rjes dang snang sems 'dres te/ sems can gyi done du grub rtags bstan zhing mgur gsungs pa/ thugs sras rnams kyis mi brjed pa'i gzungs su bzung zhing yi ger bkod pa/ mi yul na yongs su grags pa phal cher 'dir 'dus pa yin zhing / mtha' dag ni brjod par nus pa ma yin no/ /bu slob rnams spro ba bskyed pa bkod pa sku'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i skor te/ kha 'thor sna tshogs kyi skor ro// //de ltar skor tsho gsum gyis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dang / sems can la phan btags pa'i mdzad pa brgyad pa rgyas par phye ba'o// lto/ //rab dkar rin chen sems kyi lha rdzas dar/ /thabs shes 'dab laXsnag rnam par rab bskyod de/ /chos nyid mkha' la rtsen pa'i zlos gar can/ /grub mchog mkha'

ra༅༅// /lding dbang po mi la rje/ /gang gi thugs bskyed rdo rje ltar brtan cing / /grub gnyis sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba yis/ /mi bskyod rdo rje dgyes shing bzhad pa'i sgra/ /srid zhi yongs la grags der gus pas 'dud/ /gang gi rnam thar mthong na don yod cing / /thos tsam gyis kyang srid zhi'i gdung 'phrog pa/ /dran pa'i mod la tshe gcig sangs rgyas mthu/ /ster mdzad yid bzhin nor gyi do zla min/ /kwa ye blo dang ldan pa su mchis kyang / /'di lta'i dam pa'i rnam thar legs mthong zhing / /rjes su 'jug la smon pa'i dam bca' tsam/ /'dzin pa de yang mthu chen dpa' bo'i rigs/ /mthong thos dran reg don ldan sar 'god phyir/ /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i phyi mo'i par/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan dad pas par bskyan dges/ /lus can ma lus mgone de'i gdul byar 3(ga /'brel thogs ma lus 'di nas byang chub bar/ /theg pa mchog gi rigs su legs skyes shing //

mtshan ldan bla ma mig gi 'bras bzhin du/ /bsten nas mi la'i rnam thar skyong nus 3(ga /mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa kun nas rgyas/ /ris med bstan 'dzin mchogo rnams sku tshe brtan/ /rig grol sde rnams thugs mthun chos spyod dang / /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang longs spyod 'phel/ /kun kyang thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ /thun min rdo rje theg pa'i lam mchog las/ /zung 'jug mkha' la spyodi pa'i pho brang du/ /myur sgrol stobes bcu'i rgyal sa 'dzin nus 〈snag/ //ces pa'i par byang smini tshig bkra shis rtags kyi grangs ldan 'di yang rnam dkar sgrub pa pos gserdzol 'debs bskul ma zhus pa ltar chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'jam dpal rol pa'i blo gros kyis smras pas gnas skabs mthar thug gi 'dod don rnams de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ //par 'di la stod ding ri'i nye 'dabs rang gnas bde skyid khang gsar du bzhugs pa'i ma phyi la gzhi bcol te/ slar
